她穿着一件合身的露脐短款婴儿 T 恤，胸前印有可爱的翠儿（Tweety Bird）图形印花，短袖，剪裁紧身时尚。她搭配了黑色棉麻碎花短裤，上面有白色小花印花、柔软的面料褶皱和放松舒适的形状。这套打扮感觉休闲、清新、带点俏皮、现代，适合下午聚会。配饰包括小耳环、精致的项链和光泽的淡粉色指甲。
她的头发自然垂下：长长的黑发，带有自然的蓬松感、内扣上翘的卷度，以及自然的动感。户外的微风在她的脸颊、颈线和肩膀周围吹起柔软的乱发，同时头发保持丝滑、健康且整洁。避免毛躁、粗糙、纹理过多或凌乱的头发。
她的妆容是柔和的 Y2K 华丽风：羽毛眉、含蓄的眼线、柔软的睫毛、透亮的皮肤、柔和的腮红和亮泽的裸粉色嘴唇。额头、脖子和手臂上可以看到温暖天气带来的轻微自然光泽，但她并没有出太多汗。
索尼爱立信 K800i Cyber-shot 美学：真实的 2006 年手机摄像头照片，明亮的氙气闪光灯补光混合着斑驳的午后阴影，中性偏冷的白平衡，生动但自然的颜色，强烈的微对比度，紧凑型数码相机的渲染感，闪光灯定格的面部特征，整体带有轻微的数字柔和感，微妙的手持动作模糊，头发和衣服周围有轻微的边缘柔和感，画面边缘有轻微的焦点衰减，早期的 JPEG 压缩，发丝、芒果片、勺子边缘、虾酱盒、衣服印花和桌子细节周围有轻微的锐化光晕，树荫下可见阴影噪点，额头、脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇、手臂、芒果皮和高光发丝上有冷调闪光灯热点，光泽的皮肤反光，芒果肉、塑料盘子和阳光照射的叶子上有轻微曝光过度的高光，桌子和树枝下有被压缩的阴影区，以及那种不容错过的 Friendster 时代的乡间快照能量。
前景：模糊的芒果片、一个打开的小虾酱（bagoong alamang）容器、塑料盘子边缘和桌子纹理贴近镜头，自然地契合场景并创造深度，且不遮挡脸部。
背景包含一棵大芒果树、地面上刚摘下的芒果、在桌旁聊天的朋友、塑料椅子、阴凉的院子土地、香蕉树、附近的房屋细节、晾衣绳、温暖的午后阳光，以及轻松的农村家庭生活氛围。

prompts.text:
You are a brand visual identity system, commercial advertising creative director, KV poster designer, and a high-propagation brand visual generation system.

Please automatically identify the brand's most representative brand Logo image, brand name text identification features, main products, product packaging, brand colors, visual tone, target audience, and advertising communication style based on the user-inputted [Existing Brand Name], and generate a concept KV poster that conforms to the brand's temperament.

This is not virtual brand design,
not an ordinary product photo,
not a cheap flyer,
nor a knock-off poster,
but a:

Brand-inspired Concept Key Visual based on real brand cognition secondary creation.

This creation is mainly used for personal learning, visual practice, and social platform display, so absolutely strict one-to-one official replication is not required, but it must achieve:

High brand recognition;
Obvious brand Logo style;
Obvious representative brand products;
Accurate brand tone;
Overall looks like a visual advertisement that would appear for that brand.

────────────────
I. User Input
────────────────

Brand Name: {周黑鸭 (Zhou Hei Ya)}

Main Product: {鸭脖 (Duck Neck)}
Slogan: {Optional, if left blank, automatically generate an original slogan based on the brand tone}
Target Audience: {年轻潮流人群 (Young trendy people)}
Aspect Ratio: {9:16}
KV Type: {Auto-select}
Platform Purpose: {Xiaohongshu}

────────────────
II. Auto-identification Logic
────────────────

Please automatically complete the following identification based on the brand name, without needing to display the analysis process in the frame:

1. Automatically identify the industry the brand belongs to
For example:
Technology, sports, beauty, luxury, automobile, beverage, coffee, clothing, trend, skincare, jewelry, lifestyle, digital, home, etc.

2. Automatically identify the brand's most representative visual assets
Including:
Brand Logo image
Brand name text style
Main and auxiliary colors
Most representative product
Packaging appearance features
Common brand advertising style
Brand scene temperament
Brand material feel and light/shadow methods

3. Automatically identify the brand's target audience
For example:
Young trendy people, urban white-collar workers, exquisite women, sports people, tech users, high-end consumers, Gen Z, business people, etc.

4. Automatically identify the temperament of the brand's slogan style
For example:
Minimalist and high-end, young and energetic, passionate and impactful, luxurious and restrained, gentle and romantic, tech-rational, fashion pioneer, lifestyle-oriented, etc.

────────────────
III. Logo and Product Identification Rules
────────────────

This task allows AI to automatically identify brand visual assets based on the brand name, without requiring users to upload a Logo or product images.

Please follow these principles:

1. Brand Logo
- There needs to be a clear brand identifier in the frame
- The Logo or brand name text should have high recognizability
- Do not pursue 100% precise replication, but it must make people immediately associate it with the brand
- Do not generate completely strange, irrelevant, or error-prone identifiers
- Do not let the brand name appear with obvious typos, garbled characters, or messy deformations

2. Brand Product
- Automatically select the brand's most representative main product or classic product as the main visual
- The product appearance, packaging, color, and temperament should be close to the public's common perception of the brand
- Absolutely strict industrial-level replication is not required
- But ensure it "looks like the brand's real representative product" rather than a completely strange product

3. Brand Packaging and Material
- Automatically identify the brand's common packaging and material language
- Such as metal, glass, frosted, plastic, leather, cardboard, minimalist packaging, luxury packaging, sporty materials, etc.
- Products must have a real commercial visual texture

────────────────
IV. KV Creative Direction
────────────────

Please automatically select the most appropriate KV creative method based on brand attributes.

If it's a tech brand:
Use minimalist, futuristic, real product textures, calm white space, restrained lighting, and clean spaces.

If it's a sports brand:
Use a sense of speed, power, body movement, sweat, sprinting, breakthroughs, and a strong sense of slogans.

If it's a beauty brand:
Use soft light, exquisite products, skin texture, femininity, color emotions, and a fashion blockbuster feel.

If it's a luxury brand:
Use high-end materials, white space, low-saturation tones, orderly composition, a sense of scarcity, and a fashion blockbuster feel.

If it's a beverage brand:
Use ice-cold freshness, liquids, bubbles, youthfulness, a happy atmosphere, color impact, and refreshing materials.

If it's a coffee brand:
Use temperature, urban life, a relaxed atmosphere, green or wood textures, and a sense of morning companionship.

If it's an automobile brand:
Use roads, speed, futuristic space, metal texture, urban night scenes, and driving desire.

If it's a trendy brand:
Use street, rebellion, youth, graphic sense, visual impact, and a sense of social propagation.

────────────────
V. Slogan Rules
────────────────

If the user has not entered a slogan, please automatically generate an original slogan based on the brand tone.

Requirements:

- The slogan should not be too long
- It should have a brand feel and sense of propagation
- Do not use official original slogans
- Does not need to look like a formal corporate announcement
- More like the main slogan of a concept advertisement

Chinese slogan suggestion:
4 to 12 characters

English slogan suggestion:
2 to 6 words

Slogan style must match the brand, for example:

Tech brand:
Less interference, closer to the future

Sports brand:
Limit under your feet

Beauty brand:
Luster, your own proposition

Luxury brand:
Elegance, never clamoring

Beverage brand:
This sip, just right to the head

Coffee brand:
Awaken the city's temperature

Automobile brand:
Drive towards a further order

────────────────
VI. Human Appearance Logic
────────────────

The "target audience" in brand KVs does not necessarily have to be expressed through direct human appearance; it can also be expressed implicitly through scenes, colors, temperament, composition, props, and lifestyle atmosphere.

But if a certain type of brand relies more on characters to establish a sense of substitution, identity, usage scenarios, and emotional propagation, then characters matching the brand tone should be automatically added.

Please judge whether people need to appear and in what way based on brand type, KV type, and target audience.

1. Brand types suitable for adding people
- Beauty, skincare, clothing, jewelry, fragrance, sports, trend, coffee, beverage, lifestyle, automobile brands, etc., can prioritize character appearance.
- Characters can be models, users, brand temperament representatives, or lifestyle roles.

2. Brand types suitable for weakening characters or no characters
- Tech digital, home products, packaged consumer goods, some luxury still lifes, minimalist product hero KVs, characters can be absent, or only appear as auxiliary elements like hands, body parts, back views, silhouettes, etc.

3. Character appearance methods
If characters are needed, please automatically select the following methods based on KV type:

3.1. Auxiliary character appearance
Characters are not the protagonists, but appear as product users, holders, foils, or atmosphere carriers; the focus is still the brand product.

3.2. Single person main visual
Characters and products together form the core of the main frame; the character's face, temperament, posture, and outfit should match the brand's target audience.

3.3. Multi-person scenes
Suitable for beverage, lifestyle, trend, or social atmosphere brands; strengthen the sense of scene and propagation through multi-person interaction.

3.4. Local characters
Only show hands, profile, back view, gait, or partial limbs, which enhances the sense of usage scenarios without weakening the product's main visual.

4. Character temperament requirements
If characters appear, they must match the target audience and brand temperament of the brand, including age, outfit, posture, expression, makeup, hairstyle, sense of profession, sense of lifestyle, and aesthetic temperament.

5. Priority relationship requirements
Even if characters appear, they should not overshadow the product.
If it's a product hero KV, the product is still the primary protagonist;
If it's a character scene KV, a clear relationship should be formed between the character and the product;
If it's a brand mood KV, the character bears more function for atmosphere and substitution.

6. Prohibited issues
Do not show character images that do not match the brand tone;
Do not show characters with a cheap internet celebrity feel;
Do not show exaggerated posing, tacky poses, or low-quality fashion;
Do not let characters take away the brand identification core;
Do not let the relationship between characters and products be loose or like a random splicing.

────────────────
VII. Frame Structure Requirements
────────────────

The entire image must have the basic structure of a real brand KV:

1. Brand Identification Area
The brand Logo or brand name needs to be clearly visible and reasonably positioned.

2. Product Main Visual Area
The brand's representative product must be obvious and one of the core elements of the frame.

3. Slogan Area
The slogan is clearly readable and has communication memory points.

4. Brand Atmosphere Area
Background, light and shadow, materials, space, and colors must conform to the brand tone.

5. Information Hierarchy Area
Suggested visual hierarchy:
Brand Identification
Product Main Subject
Slogan
A small amount of auxiliary text

Do not have too much text; do not make it into a densely packed poster.

────────────────
VIII. Style Requirements
────────────────

The overall visual must have:

High recognition brand feel
High-end commercial advertising quality
Clear brand identification
Obvious brand products
Strong main visual
Strong slogan
Clean layout
Suitable for social platform propagation
Suitable for Xiaohongshu and X display
Has the completion level of "looking like a well-known brand concept advertisement"

Moderate creative play is allowed, but the core brand identification cannot be lost.

────────────────
IX. Aspect Ratio Adaptation
────────────────

If 9:16:
Suitable for vertical social posters, product is more focused, slogan is in the upper-middle area, suitable for mobile browsing.

If 16:9:
Suitable for horizontal brand KVs, covers, headers; products and slogans form a left-right balance.

If 4:5:
Suitable for social platform feeds, the subject is closer, brand recognition is more concentrated.

If 2.35:1:
Suitable for WeChat Official Account covers or wide visuals, suitable for large-font slogans and strong impact horizontal composition.

If 1:1:
Suitable for square covers and brand visual displays.

────────────────
X. Negative Constraints
────────────────

Do not generate obviously wrong brand names.
Do not generate overly outrageous Logo deformations.
Do not generate products unrelated to the brand.
Do not generate a cheap collage feel.
Do not generate too much small text.
Do not generate a cluttered background.
Do not generate images with a strong sense of knock-off.
Do not generate low-level e-commerce visuals like promotional posters.
Do not show QR codes, purchase links, price tags, or event descriptions.
Do not let the overall frame lose its brand tone.

────────────────
XI. Final Goal
────────────────

Please generate a brand concept KV poster automatically identified based on real brand cognition.

Requirements:
No need for users to upload Logo and product materials;
AI automatically identifies the brand's most representative Logo image and representative product;
Strict replication is not required;
But high recognition, high brand feel, and high completion must be maintained;
Overall like a high-end brand concept advertising poster;
Suitable for personal learning, visual practice, and social platform display.

prompts.text:
你是一个品牌视觉识别系统、商业广告创意总监、KV海报设计师和高传播品牌视觉生成系统。

请根据用户输入的【现有品牌名称】，自动识别该品牌最具代表性的品牌Logo形象、品牌名称文字识别特征、主推产品、产品包装、品牌色彩、视觉调性、目标人群和广告传播风格，并生成一张符合该品牌气质的概念 KV 海报。

这不是虚拟品牌设计，
不是普通产品图，
不是廉价宣传单，
也不是山寨海报，
而是一张：

基于真实品牌认知进行二次创作的品牌概念 KV 海报
Brand-inspired Concept Key Visual

本次创作主要用于个人学习、视觉练习与社交平台展示，
因此不需要绝对严苛的一比一官方复刻，
但必须做到：

品牌识别度高；
品牌Logo风格明显；
品牌代表产品明显；
品牌调性准确；
整体像该品牌会出现的视觉广告。

────────────────
一、用户输入
────────────────

品牌名称：{品牌名称}

主推产品：{可选，不填则自动识别该品牌最具代表性的产品}
广告语：{可选，不填则根据品牌调性自动生成原创广告语}
目标人群：{可选，不填则自动判断}
画幅比例：{9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1 / 2.35:1}
KV类型：{产品英雄KV / 品牌情绪KV / 强口号传播KV / 人物场景KV / 超现实概念KV / 自动选择}
平台用途：{小红书 / X / 公众号封面 / 视觉练习 / 概念提案}

────────────────
二、自动识别逻辑
────────────────

请根据品牌名称自动完成以下识别，不需要在画面中展示分析过程：

1. 自动识别该品牌所属行业
例如：
科技、运动、美妆、奢侈品、汽车、饮品、咖啡、服饰、潮流、护肤、珠宝、生活方式、数码、家居等。

2. 自动识别该品牌最具代表性的视觉资产
包括：
品牌Logo形象
品牌名称文字风格
主色调与辅助色
最具代表性的产品
包装外观特征
品牌常见广告风格
品牌场景气质
品牌材质感与光影方式

3. 自动识别该品牌的目标人群
例如：
年轻潮流人群、都市白领、精致女性、运动人群、科技用户、高端消费人群、Z世代、商务人群等。

4. 自动识别该品牌的广告语气质
例如：
极简高级、年轻活力、热血冲击、奢华克制、温柔浪漫、科技理性、时尚先锋、生活方式化等。

────────────────
三、Logo与产品识别规则
────────────────

本次任务允许 AI 根据品牌名称自动识别品牌视觉资产，
不需要用户必须上传 Logo 或产品图。

请遵守以下原则：

1. 品牌Logo
- 画面中需要有明显的品牌标识
- Logo 或品牌名称文字要具有较高识别度
- 不必追求百分之百精确复刻，但必须让人一眼联想到该品牌
- 不要生成完全陌生、无关、错误感很强的标识
- 不要让品牌名称出现明显错字、乱码或胡乱变形

2. 品牌产品
- 自动选择该品牌最具代表性的主推产品或经典产品作为主视觉
- 产品外观、包装、色彩和气质应接近大众对该品牌的常见认知
- 不需要绝对严格到工业级复刻
- 但要保证“像这个品牌的真实代表产品”，而不是完全陌生的产品

3. 品牌包装与材质
- 自动识别该品牌常见包装与材质语言
- 如金属、玻璃、磨砂、塑料、皮革、纸盒、极简包装、奢华包装、运动感材质等
- 产品必须具有真实商业视觉质感

────────────────
四、KV创意方向
────────────────

请根据品牌属性自动选择最合适的 KV 创意方式。

如果是科技品牌：
使用极简、未来感、真实产品质感、冷静留白、克制光影、干净空间。

如果是运动品牌：
使用速度感、力量感、身体动势、汗水、冲刺、突破、强烈口号感。

如果是美妆品牌：
使用柔光、精致产品、肌肤质感、女性气质、色彩情绪、时尚大片感。

如果是奢侈品牌：
使用高级材质、留白、低饱和色调、秩序构图、稀缺感、时尚大片感。

如果是饮品品牌：
使用冰爽、液体、气泡、年轻感、快乐氛围、色彩冲击、清爽材质。

如果是咖啡品牌：
使用温度、城市生活、松弛氛围、绿色或木质感、晨间陪伴感。

如果是汽车品牌：
使用道路、速度、未来空间、金属质感、城市夜景、驾驶欲望。

如果是潮流品牌：
使用街头、反叛、年轻、图形感、视觉冲击和社交传播感。

────────────────
五、广告语规则
────────────────

如果用户没有输入广告语，请根据品牌调性自动生成一句原创广告语。

要求：

- 广告语不能太长
- 要有品牌感和传播感
- 不使用官方原广告语
- 不需要像正式企业公告
- 更像概念广告的主标语

中文广告语建议：
4到12个字

英文广告语建议：
2到6个单词

广告语风格要与品牌匹配，例如：

科技品牌：
更少干扰，更近未来

运动品牌：
把极限踩在脚下

美妆品牌：
光泽，自成主张

奢侈品牌：
优雅，从不喧哗

饮品品牌：
这一口，刚好上头

咖啡品牌：
唤醒城市的温度

汽车品牌：
驶向更远的秩序

────────────────
六、人物出镜逻辑
────────────────

品牌KV中的“目标人群”不一定必须通过真人直接出现来表达，
也可以通过场景、色彩、气质、构图、道具和生活方式氛围进行隐性表达。

但如果某类品牌更依赖人物来建立代入感、身份感、使用场景和情绪传播力，
则应自动加入符合品牌调性的出镜人物。

请根据品牌类型、KV类型和目标人群，自动判断人物是否需要出现，以及以何种方式出现。

1、适合加入人物的品牌类型
- 美妆、护肤、服饰、珠宝、香氛、运动、潮流、咖啡、饮品、生活方式、汽车等品牌，
可优先考虑人物出镜。
- 人物可以是模特、使用者、品牌气质代表者或生活方式角色。

2、适合弱化人物或无人物的品牌类型
- 科技数码、家居产品、包装快消、部分奢侈品静物、极简产品英雄KV，
可以不出现人物，或仅出现手部、身体局部、背影、剪影等辅助元素。

3、人物出镜方式
如果需要人物，请根据KV类型自动选择以下方式：

3.1. 人物辅助出镜
人物不是主角，只作为产品使用者、手持者、陪衬者或氛围承载者出现，
重点仍然是品牌产品。

3.2. 单人主视觉
人物与产品共同构成主画面核心，
人物的脸部、气质、姿态和穿搭应符合品牌目标人群。

3.3. 多人场景
适合饮品、生活方式、潮流或社交氛围品牌，
通过多人互动强化场景感和传播感。

3.4. 局部人物
只展示手部、侧脸、背影、步态或局部肢体，
既增强使用场景感，又不削弱产品主视觉。

4、人物气质要求
如果人物出镜，人物必须符合该品牌面向的目标人群与品牌气质，
包括年龄感、穿搭、姿态、表情、妆容、发型、职业感、生活方式感和审美气质。

5、主次关系要求
即使人物出现，也不能喧宾夺主。
如果是产品英雄KV，产品仍然是第一主角；
如果是人物场景KV，人物与产品应形成明确关系；
如果是品牌情绪KV，人物更多承担氛围与代入感功能。

6、禁止问题
不要出现与品牌调性不符的人物形象；
不要出现廉价网红感人物；
不要出现夸张摆拍、土味姿势或低质时尚感；
不要让人物抢走品牌识别核心；
不要让人物和产品关系松散、像随机拼接。

────────────────
七、画面结构要求
────────────────

整张图必须具备真实品牌 KV 的基本结构：

1. 品牌标识区
品牌Logo或品牌名称需要清晰可见，位置合理。

2. 产品主视觉区
品牌代表产品必须明显，是画面核心之一。

3. 广告语区
广告语清晰可读，具备传播记忆点。

4. 品牌氛围区
背景、光影、材质、空间和色彩必须符合品牌调性。

5. 信息层级区
画面层级建议为：
品牌标识
产品主体
广告语
少量辅助文字

文字不要太多，不要做成密密麻麻的海报。

────────────────
八、风格要求
────────────────

整体视觉必须具备：

高识别度品牌感
高级商业广告质感
清晰品牌标识
明显品牌产品
强主视觉
强广告语
干净排版
适合社交平台传播
适合小红书和X展示
具有“像某知名品牌概念广告”的完成度

允许适度创意发挥，
但品牌核心识别不能丢失。

────────────────
九、画幅适配
────────────────

如果是 9:16：
适合竖版社交海报，产品更聚焦，广告语放中上区域，适合手机浏览。

如果是 16:9：
适合横版品牌KV、封面、头图，产品与广告语形成左右平衡。

如果是 4:5：
适合社交平台信息流，主体更近，品牌识别更集中。

如果是 2.35:1：
适合公众号封面或宽幅视觉，适合大字广告语和强冲击横版构图。

如果是 1:1：
适合方形封面与品牌视觉展示。

────────────────
十、负面限制
────────────────

不要生成明显错误的品牌名称。
不要生成过于离谱的Logo变形。
不要生成与品牌无关的产品。
不要生成廉价拼贴感。
不要生成过多小字。
不要生成杂乱无章的背景。
不要生成山寨感很强的画面。
不要生成像促销海报一样的低级电商视觉。
不要出现二维码、购买链接、价格标签、活动说明。
不要让整体画面失去品牌调性。

────────────────
十一、最终目标
────────────────

请生成一张基于真实品牌认知自动识别完成的品牌概念 KV 海报。

要求：
无需用户上传 Logo 和产品素材；
由AI自动识别该品牌最具代表性的Logo形象与代表产品；
不要求绝对严格复刻；
但必须保持高识别度、高品牌感、高完成度；
整体像一张高级品牌概念广告海报；
适合个人学习、视觉练习和社交平台展示。
————

Overall Style:
High-end, atmospheric, clean, restrained, with brand character, sufficient white space, clear information, and unified visuals. The image should have the ceremonial sense of a formal invitation and the commercial texture of a brand space proposal.

Layout Structure:
Top: Place brand Logo / brand name / English name, simple and high-end;

Middle-bottom: A complete 3D brand booth rendering as the core main visual of the image;
Bottom: Retain only the booth number, date, location, and a brand-style closing copy.
No QR codes, no stacking of contact information, no excessive small text.

3D Booth Design:
The booth adopts a realistic, buildable professional exhibition space design with a 45-degree three-dimensional perspective, complete structure, coordinated proportions, and clear spatial layering.
The booth includes the brand storefront, luminous light strips, reception desk, product display wall, display cabinets, main product installations, poster lightboxes, negotiation area, local greenery, or industry-related high-end furnishings.

The overall layout should have a sense of breathing, order, and high-end invitation texture.

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference for the subject’s face, hairstyle, facial structure, skin tone, and overall aura.

Create a high-quality realistic cinematic portrait of the same person crying beautifully in the rain outdoors at night, with a realistic Korean-drama street scene mood.

Core concept:
- the subject is sitting alone outside in heavy rain at night
- she is already completely soaked from the rain
- she looks like she has been crying in the rain for a while
- the scene should feel like a real heartbreaking Korean-drama moment captured on a rainy city street
- the emotion is quiet heartbreak, longing, loneliness, and soft sadness
- she must still look delicate and beautiful, but not perfectly clean or polished

Reference mood and composition:
- use the feeling of a candid rainy-night street photo
- she is sitting on a wet outdoor bench, bus-stop bench, curb, or low street-side seat
- wet city sidewalk and road are visible behind her
- the background includes rain-soaked pavement, street poles, trees, distant traffic lights, and blurred building lights
- the road and sidewalk should reflect streetlights beautifully
- the scene should feel realistic and atmospheric, not like a studio or fashion set
- keep the background recognizable as a real rainy city street at night

Main visual priority:
- the face is the highest priority
- prioritize emotional facial detail, tear tracks, rain-soaked skin, wet eyelashes, and delicate crying expression
- the image should feel like a medium close emotional portrait, not a wide full-body scene
- show enough of the seated posture so the sadness feels natural and grounded

Head angle and gaze:
- use a soft lowered three-quarter side angle
- the head is slightly lowered
- the chin is gently tucked down
- the face is turned about 45 degrees to the side
- she looks slightly downward and off into the distance, not directly at the camera
- the gaze should feel lost, fragile, heartbroken, and exhausted
- avoid front-facing composition and direct eye contact

Pose:
- she is seated on a wet bench, bus-stop bench, curb, or low pavement edge
- knees are bent and drawn in naturally
- one arm rests gently across the knees
- the other hand rests softly near the legs or on the wet seat
- shoulders are slightly lowered
- posture feels tired, vulnerable, graceful, and natural
- the body is turned softly to the side
- hands should look relaxed and delicate
- avoid stiff posing

Facial emotion and crying traces:
- she is crying in a beautiful, restrained, delicate way
- she looks like she has been crying in the rain for a while
- her eyes are glossy, watery, red around the inner corners, and emotionally heavy
- visible tears stream naturally down both cheeks
- tear tracks should be clearly visible and slightly different from random rainwater trails
- rainwater and tears mix naturally on her face
- lower eyelids are wet, tender, and softly puffy
- the skin under the eyes looks damp and slightly irritated from crying
- nose tip and nostrils are slightly pink-red from crying and cold rain
- cheeks are faintly flushed
- lips are wet, soft, slightly pale, naturally flushed, and slightly parted
- her face should not look perfectly clean
- tiny raindrops gather on eyelashes, lower eyelids, nose bridge, lips, chin, and jawline
- a few wet hair strands stick across the forehead, cheeks, and near the lips
- subtle eye makeup is softened or faintly smudged by rain and tears
- she looks beautiful but emotionally worn down
- avoid ugly crying, screaming, or exaggerated swollen distortion

Beauty and identity:
- preserve the subject’s recognizable identity clearly
- keep the same face shape, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and hairstyle
- Korean drama heroine beauty, but not overly polished
- refined natural features with realistic crying traces
- natural skin texture, slight redness, wet pores, and rain-soaked shine.

prompts.text:
使用上传的肖像作为主体面部、发型、面部结构、肤色和整体气质的身份参考。

创作一张高质量的写实电影感肖像，画面中同一个人在夜晚的户外大雨中唯美地哭泣，带有写实的韩剧街头场景氛围。

核心概念：
- 主体独自坐在夜晚的大雨中
- 她已经被雨水完全打湿
- 她看起来已经在雨中哭了一会儿
- 场景应该感觉像是在雨后的城市街道上捕捉到的真实的令人心碎的韩剧时刻
- 情绪是安静的心碎、渴望、孤独和淡淡的忧伤
- 她必须看起来依然精致美丽，但不是完美的整洁或精致

参考氛围和构图：
- 使用抓拍的雨夜街头照片的感觉
- 她坐在潮湿的户外长椅、公交站长椅、路缘或路边的低座上
- 身后可以看到潮湿的城市人行道和道路
- 背景包括雨淋淋的铺面、路灯杆、树木、远处的交通信号灯和模糊的建筑物灯光
- 道路和人行道应该漂亮地反射出路灯的光影
- 场景应该感觉真实且富有氛围感，而不是像影棚或时尚拍摄布景
- 保持背景可辨认为真实的雨夜城市街道

主要视觉优先级：
- 面部是最高优先级
- 优先考虑情绪化的面部细节、泪痕、雨淋淋的皮肤、湿润的睫毛和细腻的哭泣表情
- 图像应该感觉像是一张中景特写的情绪化肖像，而不是全景的全身场景
- 显示足够的坐姿，使悲伤感显得自然且接地气

头部角度和目光：
- 使用柔和的低头四分之三侧脸角度
- 头部略微低下
- 下巴轻轻内收
- 面部侧转约45度
- 她略微向下看并望向远方，不直视镜头
- 目光应该感觉迷茫、脆弱、心碎且疲惫
- 避免正面构图和直接的眼神交流

姿势：
- 她坐在潮湿的长椅、公交站长椅、路缘或低矮的人行道边缘
- 膝盖弯曲并自然收拢
- 一只手臂轻轻搭在膝盖上
- 另一只手柔软地靠在腿部或潮湿的座位上
- 肩部略微下沉
- 姿势感觉疲惫、脆弱、优雅且自然
- 身体轻轻转向一侧
- 双手应看起来放松且精致
- 避免僵硬的摆拍

面部表情和哭泣痕迹：
- 她以一种美丽、克制、细腻的方式哭泣
- 她看起来已经在雨中哭了一会儿
- 她的眼睛湿润、含泪、内眼角发红，并带有沉重的情绪感
- 清晰的泪水自然地顺着双颊流下
- 泪痕应清晰可见，且与随机的雨轨迹略有不同
- 雨水和泪水在她的脸上自然融合
- 下眼睑湿润、柔嫩，并略微浮肿
- 眼部下方的皮肤因哭泣显得潮湿并有轻微的刺激感
- 鼻尖和鼻孔因哭泣和寒冷的雨水而略微发红
- 脸颊有隐约的红晕
- 嘴唇湿润、柔软、略显苍白、自然泛红且微微张开
- 她的脸不应该看起来完美无瑕
- 微小的雨滴聚集在睫毛、下眼睑、鼻梁、嘴唇、下巴和下颚线上
- 几缕湿发粘在额头、脸颊和嘴唇附近
- 精致的眼妆被雨水和泪水晕染或微微模糊
- 她看起来很美，但情绪上显得疲惫不堪
- 避免难看的哭相、尖叫或夸张的肿胀变形

美感与身份：
- 清晰地保留主体的可识别身份
- 保持相同的脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色和发型
- 韩剧女主角般的美感，但不过分精致
- 带有写实哭泣痕迹的精致自然特征
- 自然的皮肤纹理、轻微的发红、湿润的毛孔和雨淋淋的光泽。

items.title: 萌怪角色字标原创Logo设计提示词

prompts.text:
Please generate an original 《Playful Mascot Wordmark Logo》.

Brand name: {{Brand Name}}
Subtitle / Category: {{Subtitle / Category}}
Brand type: {{Dessert Shop / Coffee Shop / Bagel Shop / Sparkling Water / Pet Brand / Trendy Toy Store / Bakery / Lifestyle Brand, etc.}}
Core character: {{Animal / Fruit / Food / Monster / Personified Character}}
Character personality: {{Lazy / Cool / Adorable / Weirdly Cute / Mischievous / Tsundere / Happy / Speechless}}
Main color: {{Main Color}}
Secondary color: {{Secondary Color}}
Aspect ratio: 1:1

The overall style is 《Playful Mascot Wordmark Logo》.

This is not a common cartoon illustration, nor is it a children's sticker, but a character-based Logo with a sense of brand, IP, and commercial usability.

Design requirements:

1. The character must have a clear expression and personality, not just a common animal icon.
2. The character's shape should be simple, rounded, exaggerated, and memorable, suitable for brand avatars, stickers, packaging, and store signs.
3. A small action or small prop can be added, such as holding coffee, carrying a bagel on the head, blowing bubbles, hugging a dessert, holding a straw, dozing off, waving, resting chin on hands, sneaking a bite, etc.
4. The graphics should be flat, clean, with clear outlines, not realistic, no complex shadows, no 3D.
5. The brand name must be clearly readable, and the wordmark should have a sense of design, not like ordinary system fonts.
6. The font can be rounded, bold, handwritten, trendy, or light retro, and must be unified with the character's personality.
7. A small amount of auxiliary elements such as English, Chinese, Japanese small text, year, dots, curved text, registration symbols, etc., can be added, but should be restrained.
8. Use 2–4 colors for the color scheme, bright but not cluttered.
9. Keep the background pure white or light-colored, with the Logo centered and in moderate proportion.
10. The overall look should be like a real, usable small shop brand Logo, rather than just simple illustration material.

Avoid:
No common children's cartoons, no cheap sticker feel, no complex scenes, no 3D, no gradients, no realistic animals, no over-the-top cuteness, no fonts just typed out casually, no separation of graphics and text, no overly messy colors.

Final effect:
An original playful mascot wordmark logo with expression, personality, and a small shop brand feel.

prompts.text:
请生成一枚原创《萌怪角色字标 Logo》。

品牌名：{{品牌名}}
副标题 / 品类：{{副标题 / 品类}}

角色性格：{{懒懒的 / 酷酷的 / 呆萌的 / 怪可爱的 / 调皮的 / 傲娇的 / 开心的 / 无语的}}
主色调：{{主色}}
辅助色：{{辅助色}}
画幅比例：1:1

整体风格是《萌怪角色字标 Logo / Playful Mascot Wordmark Logo》。

这不是普通卡通插画，也不是儿童贴纸，而是一个具有品牌感、IP 感和商业可用性的角色型 Logo。

设计要求：

1. 角色必须有清晰表情和性格，不要只是普通动物图标。
2. 角色造型要简洁、圆润、夸张、有记忆点，适合做品牌头像、贴纸、包装和门店招牌。
3. 可以加入一个小动作或小道具，例如端咖啡、顶着贝果、冒泡泡、抱甜品、拿吸管、打瞌睡、挥手、托腮、偷吃等。
4. 图形要扁平化、干净、轮廓清晰，不要写实，不要复杂阴影，不要 3D。
5. 品牌名必须清晰可读，字标要有设计感，不能像普通系统字体。
6. 字体可以圆润、粗黑、手写、潮流、轻复古，需与角色性格统一。
7. 可加入少量英文、中文、日文小字、年份、圆点、弧形字、注册符号等辅助元素，但要克制。
8. 配色使用 2–4 种颜色，明亮但不杂乱。
9. 背景保持纯白或浅色，Logo 居中展示，比例适中。
10. 整体要像一个真实可用的小店品牌 Logo，而不是单纯插画素材。

避免：
不要普通儿童卡通，不要廉价贴纸感，不要复杂场景，不要 3D，不要渐变，不要写实动物，不要过度可爱，不要字体随便打字，不要图形和文字分离，不要颜色太花。

最终效果：
一枚有表情、有性格、有小店品牌感的原创萌怪角色字标 Logo。

成年东亚年轻女性，清晨自然光室内人像，百叶窗光影条纹，韩系时尚杂志质感

items.title: 梦幻星月纸雕立体书人物艺术海报

prompts.text:
Generate a 4:5 vertical high-completion creative character poster, themed "Open Her Dream / OPEN HER DREAM". 

The overall style is a high-precision paper-cut pop-up book style poster, where the screen looks like an opened pop-up paper art book, with a dreamy star-moon fairy tale world unfolding in the center of the pages. The overall image is not an ordinary illustration, but an art exhibition visual that combines paper-cut layered texture, exquisite character expression, and complete poster layout.

The main subject is a young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–26 years old, with an overall dreamy, romantic, quiet, and ethereal temperament. The facial features are cool and light-toned + dreamy and exquisite, the face shape is a small oval or exquisite melon seed face, the facial contours are delicate and smooth, the jawline is clean, the eye shape is slender and soft, the gaze is quiet and gentle with a bit of dreaminess, the nose shape is elegant, and the lip shape is natural and soft. The character has black long hair naturally flowing, with a slight wind-blown feel, the hair is smooth and elegant, and features a small amount of starlight hair accessories or small shimmering embellishments.

The character's figure is well-proportioned and graceful, highlighting the lines of the shoulders, neck, collarbones, arms, and the movement of the skirt. The clothing is a moon-white light gauze dress, with transparent fine gauze shoulder wraps, the overall dress unfolds layer by layer like paper-cut moonlight petals, the fabric is light and transparent, with a small amount of light gold and starlight silver detail embellishments. The hem of the skirt has a clear large-area sense of flow and layering, as if gently spinning open in a star-moon dream.

The character's pose is: standing in the center of the opened pop-up book, body slightly turned to the side, head looking back at the camera, one hand naturally placed lightly near the chest or collarbone, the other hand naturally hanging down and slightly extending backward, the overall pose is elegant, restrained, and graceful, with a slight sense of looking back and the temperament of a dream world protagonist.

Background / Concept direction: A star-moon fairy tale world unfolds from the opened paper-cut pop-up book, the image is constructed around the character with elements such as a huge moon, paper-cut clouds, golden stars, arches, flying birds, exquisite paper-cut castles, and a blue dream sky. Behind the character is a huge arched structure and a central moon; the moon should be large and exquisite, with delicate engravings and a sense of paper art; floating or hanging star decorations surround it; the castle is located in the area behind the character to the right, rich in layers but not stealing the spotlight from the protagonist. The bottom must retain the structure of an opened book, with pages unfolding layer by layer and naturally connecting to the dream world above.

Overall color palette: Moon white + fog blue + light gold + starlight silver. Maintain a light-colored dreamy night sky feel, do not darken it, and do not make it a deep night black series. The lighting atmosphere is a dreamy soft-focus light + moonlight-style paper art display light, overall bright, soft, transparent, and exquisite, with a slight sense of moonlight shining and a high-end paper art exhibition light feel.

Layout requirements are for a complete poster design, adding the main title "打开她的梦" on the left side of the screen, with the English subtitle "OPEN HER DREAM" below it; adding a concise short sentence title info in the upper right corner, such as "星月为引 梦境成真 / GUIDED BY STARS, BORN OF DREAMS"; adding "梦境展览 / DREAM EXHIBITION" and date information in the lower right corner; a short poetic copy can be added in the lower left. The overall layout should be elegant, complete, with the quality of an art exhibition poster, exquisite fonts, and appropriate white space.

Overall requirements:
The character must be the center of the screen, with the stars, moon, castle, clouds, flying birds, and paper-cut book all serving the character;
The moon and stars must be exquisite;
The image should be bright and soft, not dark or dull;
The paper-cut layers should be rich but not cluttered;
Overall like a high-completion dreamy paper-cut exhibition poster.

Negative constraints:
No dark or oppressive tones, no cheap children's illustration feel, no ordinary flat illustration feel, no cluttered paper-cut structure, no character being too small, no character being swallowed by the background, no distorted facial features, no low-quality text, no overly complex or noisy composition.

prompts.text:
生成一张 4:5 竖版的高完成度创意人物海报，主题为《打开她的梦 / OPEN HER DREAM》。

整体为高精度纸雕立体书风格海报，画面像一本被打开的立体纸艺书，书页中央展开一个梦幻的星月童话世界。整体不是普通插画，而是兼具纸雕层叠质感、精致人物表现和完整海报排版的艺术展览视觉。

画面主体是一位年轻成年东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–26 岁，整体气质梦幻、浪漫、安静、空灵。五官方向为清冷淡颜 + 梦幻精致感，脸型为小巧鹅蛋脸或精致瓜子脸，面部轮廓清秀流畅，下颌线干净，眼型细长柔和，眼神安静温柔又带一点梦境感，鼻型秀气，唇形自然柔和。人物为黑色长发自然披散，发丝带轻微风感，头发柔顺飘逸，并带有少量星光感发饰或细小闪烁点缀。

人物身形匀称柔美，重点突出肩颈、锁骨、手臂线条与裙摆动态。服装为月白色轻纱礼裙，肩部带透明细纱披帛，整体礼裙层层展开，像纸雕月光花瓣，面料轻盈通透，带少量浅金与星光银的细节点缀。裙摆具有明显的大面积流动感和层叠感，像在星月梦境中轻轻旋开。

人物姿态为：站立于打开的立体书中央，身体轻微侧转，头部回望镜头，一只手自然轻放在胸前或锁骨附近，另一只手自然下垂并微微向后延展，整体姿态优雅、克制、柔美，有轻微回眸感与梦境女主气质。

背景 / 概念方向：打开的立体纸雕书中展开星月童话世界，画面围绕人物构建巨大月亮、纸雕云朵、金色星星、拱门、飞鸟、精致纸雕城堡、蓝色梦境天空等元素。人物身后有一个巨大的弧形拱门结构和中心月亮，月亮要大而精致，带细腻雕纹与纸艺感；周围悬挂或漂浮着星星装饰，城堡位于人物身后偏右区域，层次丰富但不抢主角。底部一定要保留打开的书本结构，书页层层翻开，并与上方梦境世界自然连接。

整体主色调为：月白色 + 雾蓝 + 浅金 + 星光银。要求保持浅色梦幻夜空感，不要压暗，不要做成深夜黑色系。光线氛围为梦境柔焦光 + 月光感纸艺展示光，整体明亮、柔和、通透、精致，带轻微月光照耀感和高级纸艺展陈光感。

版式要求为完整海报设计，画面左侧加入大标题“打开她的梦”，下方配英文副标题 “OPEN HER DREAM”；右上角加入简洁的短句标题信息，如“星月为引 梦境成真 / GUIDED BY STARS, BORN OF DREAMS”；右下角加入“梦境展览 / DREAM EXHIBITION”和日期信息；左下可加入简短的诗意文案。整体排版需优雅、完整、具有艺术展海报质感，字体精致，留白得当。

整体要求：
人物必须是画面中心，星月、城堡、云朵、飞鸟与纸雕书共同服务于人物；
月亮和星星要精致；
画面明亮柔和，不要暗沉；
纸雕层次丰富但不杂乱；
整体像一张高完成度的梦幻纸雕展览海报。

负面约束：
不要暗黑压抑色调，不要儿童廉价插画感，不要普通平面插画感，不要纸雕结构混乱，不要人物过小，不要人物被背景吞没，不要五官崩坏，不要低质文字，不要过度复杂噪乱构图。

prompts.text:
Create a vertical 9:16 “Layered Portrait Collage” with no text, no titles, no logos, and no white divider bars.

The image should look like three different close-up photos of the same person, rebuilt into one vertical collage. Do not make it look like one single portrait cut into three strips.

Top section: a very close-up crop of the eyes, brows, or half of the face. This section carries the emotional tension. The gaze should feel expressive, subtle, alive, and slightly cinematic.

Middle section: a close-up of the nose, lips, cheek, jawline, or partial side face. The lips should feel soft and natural, as if holding a pause or an unspoken thought. Keep strong skin realism and emotional quietness.

Bottom section: do not show a full face. Show shoulders, collarbone, hair, hands, neck, partial jawline, or part of the mouth edge. This section should carry body language and emotional continuation. The hand can lightly touch the collar, hair, shoulder, neck, or collarbone. It should feel intimate, natural, quiet, and emotionally alive — not like clothing display only.

All three sections must belong to the same person, with the same lighting, same color mood, and same photography language, but with different angles, crops, and subtle emotional variation.

Use real skin texture, natural skin tone, soft hair strands, realistic fabric texture, gentle depth of field, slight film grain, soft focus, low-contrast shadows, and a refined editorial feel.

Residents naturally inhabit the scene:

Office workers commuting
Students crossing intersections
Cyclists weaving through streets
Café patrons sitting outdoors
Shoppers carrying bags
Locals waiting at crossings or transit stops

prompts.text:
[Subject]: [Product Type] New Product Promotion Poster
[Brand Name]: [Brand Name]

[Functional Selling Points]: [Selling Point 1], [Selling Point 2], [Selling Point 3], [Selling Point 4]
[Aspect Ratio]: Portrait 3:4

Please generate a 3:4 portrait high-definition commercial advertising poster, a single image, no collages, no multi-grid layouts.

This is a product promotion poster for an original fictional brand; do not include real brand logos. The overall style is "Product Promotion Mega Typography Perspective Poster." The image should look like a formally released Brand Campaign main visual, with a sense of commercial advertising, strong layout design, product launch feel, visual impact, and a complete information system.

The core subject of the image is [Product Name]. The product must be clear, exquisite, and like a hero product in an advertisement, located in the foreground or slightly below the center of the image. The product material must be realistic, the structure complete, and details well-defined; it cannot be too small or blurred. Based on the product type, include appropriate characters or usage scenarios, such as female models, male models, trendy characters, outdoor characters, user actions, or emotional atmospheres. Characters must be realistic and natural with high-end poses to strengthen the brand temperament, but they must not steal the spotlight from the product subject.

The main title [Main Title Large Text] must become the core visual skeleton of the image, using oversized bold sans-serif fonts, occupying the main space of the image. The text should not be a mere title but become the spatial structure of the scene, transforming into background walls, ground runways, roads, ramps, time tunnels, sound wave tracks, scent spaces, mountain terrains, perspective installations, or brand main symbols. The product, characters, and giant title must exist within the same spatial logic, forming real foreground-background relationships, occlusion, contact shadows, and perspective depth.

The image must include a complete formal poster information system; it cannot be too empty or look like a simple stock image. Place the [Brand Name] in the top left corner and campaign text in the top right corner, such as NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN / SERIES 2026. Add vertical small text, product numbers, series numbers, or campaign numbers on the sides. Near the product, add 3-5 concise functional selling point labels, such as [Selling Point 1], [Selling Point 2], [Selling Point 3], [Selling Point 4]. At the bottom, set up a formal advertising information bar containing [Product Name], [Subtitle], release date, core parameters, small text credits, thin line dividers, and decorative barcodes or numbers. Small text can serve as design-oriented micro-typography; it is not required for every character to be perfectly readable, but the brand name, product name, and main title must be clear.

The overall color scheme revolves around [Main Color Tone]. The background builds a corresponding atmosphere based on the theme, such as a minimalist fashion space, scent atomization space, metal mechanical space, music neon space, mountain outdoor space, snowy rock space, etc. Small amounts of light and shadow, mist, reflection, grain, wind sensation, atmospheric perspective, speed traces, or material refraction can be added to enhance the high-end feel, but avoid clutter and a cheap e-commerce feel.

The image must be high-definition, sharp, with accurate perspective, realistic materials, and unified lighting. The overall look should be like a truly released Brand Campaign poster. Suitable for perfume, watches, headphones, digital products, outdoor clothing, sports brands, consumer brands, etc.

Avoid: Collages, multi-image combinations, real brand logos, common stock photos, cheap e-commerce feel, cartoon style, cluttered background, product being too small, fake faces on characters, main title becoming a plain flat title, too few information areas.

prompts.text:
Epic FIFA World Cup 2026 championship celebration of [COUNTRY], transformed into a one-of-a-kind ultra-detailed 3D layered paper sculpture diorama, square composition, aspect ratio 1:1. The year "FIFA World Cup 2026" should be clearly visible and elegantly integrated into the artwork as a prominent celebratory element.

The match has already ended.

Create a spacious championship composition built from multiple connected visual islands distributed throughout the artwork.

The Championship Trophy Cluster must be the largest island and occupy the visual center of the composition.

Island 1 (Largest Central Island): Championship Trophy Cluster.
A small group of players proudly lifts the World Cup trophy while teammates celebrate nearby. This island serves as the primary focal point and should be significantly larger than all other islands.

Island 2: Match-Winning Football Action Cluster.
One player from the champion nation and one opposing player compete in a decisive football moment. The ball remains clearly visible. This is the only football action scene in the composition.

Island 3: Championship Stadium Cluster.
A miniature paper-craft stadium monument symbolizing the nation's World Cup triumph, designed as a collectible architectural centerpiece.

Island 4: Supporter Celebration Cluster.
A small group of supporters celebrating with flags and subtle festive elements.

Island 5: National Identity Cluster.
A small collection of iconic cultural, architectural, natural, or symbolic elements representing the nation.

The central trophy island should occupy approximately 35% of the total visual attention.

The remaining islands should share the remaining visual attention and remain noticeably smaller than the central trophy island.

Each island should be visually separated by generous negative space while remaining connected through subtle paper-craft visual flow.

Visual weight must be distributed across the entire canvas.

No single area should contain the majority of players, supporters, ornaments, landmarks, or decorative elements.

Approximately 3–5 celebration clusters should be scattered throughout the composition, separated by intentional negative space.

Open negative space occupies approximately 40% of the canvas.

Negative space has higher priority than decorative elements.

Empty space should weave naturally between the islands, creating multiple breathing zones throughout the composition.

Entire scene created as handcrafted layered paper sculpture with elegant paper-cut engineering, dimensional paper layers, premium diorama craftsmanship, and refined paper textures.

Automatically derive colors, visual motifs, decorative influences, architecture, landscapes, symbolism, artistic traditions, environmental storytelling, and visual identity from the specified country.

Select only the most representative national elements. Avoid excessive landmarks or excessive cultural references.

Decorative paper ribbons, paper curls, ornamental structures, and celebratory paper elements should be used sparingly and distributed throughout the artwork.

Avoid large crowds.
Avoid dense clustering.
Avoid central crowd formations.
Avoid excessive confetti.
Avoid excessive ribbons.
Avoid excessive landmarks.
Avoid visual clutter.
Avoid border-to-border decoration.
Avoid filling every corner.
Avoid symmetrical layouts.

The composition should feel elegant, premium, spacious, collectible, museum-quality, and visually balanced.

Hyper-detailed handcrafted paper textures, museum-quality paper sculpture, deep layered shadows, cinematic lighting, extraordinary depth, masterpiece paper art installation.

prompts.text: 壮丽的[国家]2026年国际足联世界杯夺冠庆典，转化为独一无二的超精细3D分层纸雕立体模型，正方形构图，纵横比1:1。“FIFA World Cup 2026”年份应清晰可见，并作为突出的庆典元素优雅地融入作品中。比赛已经结束。创建一个宽敞的冠军作品构图，由分布在整个作品中的多个相连视觉岛屿组成。冠军奖杯集群必须是最大的岛屿，并占据构图的视觉中心。岛屿 1（最大的中心岛屿）：冠军奖杯集群。一小群球员自豪地举起世界杯奖杯，队友在附近庆祝。该岛屿作为主要视觉中心，应明显大于所有其他岛屿。岛屿 2：制胜足球动作集群。一名来自冠军国家的球员和一名对手球员在一个决定性的足球时刻进行角逐。球保持清晰可见。这是构图中唯一的足球动作场景。岛屿 3：冠军体育场集群。一座象征该国世界杯胜利的微型纸艺体育场纪念碑，设计为可收藏的建筑中心装饰。岛屿 4：支持者庆祝集群。一小群支持者带着旗帜和微妙的节日元素进行庆祝。岛屿 5：国家身份集群。代表该国的标志性文化、建筑、自然或象征元素的精选集合。中心奖杯岛应占据总视觉关注度的约35%。其余岛屿应分享剩余的视觉关注度，并保持明显小于中心奖杯岛。每个岛屿应通过充足的负空间在视觉上分开，同时通过微妙的纸艺视觉流保持连接。视觉重量必须分布在整个画布上。任何单一区域都不应包含大多数球员、支持者、装饰品、地标或装饰元素。整个构图中应散布约3–5个庆祝集群，并由刻意的负空间隔开。开放负空间占据画布的约40%。负空间比装饰元素具有更高的优先级。空白空间应在岛屿之间自然穿梭，在整个构图中创造多个呼吸区。整个场景采用手工分层纸雕创作，具有优雅的剪纸工艺、立体纸层、优质立体模型工艺和精细的纸张纹理。自动从指定国家衍生颜色、视觉母题、装饰影响、建筑、景观、象征意义、艺术传统、环境叙事和视觉身份。仅选择最具代表性的国家元素。避免过多的地标或过多的文化引用。应少量使用并分布在整个作品中的装饰性纸质丝带、纸卷、装饰性结构和庆祝性纸质元素。避免大群人群。避免密集聚集。避免中心人群编队。避免过多的纸屑。避免过多的丝带。避免过多的地标。避免视觉凌乱。避免边到边的装饰。避免填满每个角落。避免对称布局。构图应感觉优雅、高端、宽敞、具有收藏价值、博物馆品质且视觉平衡。超精细的手工纸张纹理、博物馆级纸雕、深层阴影、电影照明、非凡的深度、杰作级纸艺装置。

items.title: 稚拙民艺风格中文品牌Logo设计

prompts.text:
Please generate a Chinese brand logo in the style of 'Naive Folk Art Text and Graphics'. The overall design should be original and should not copy any existing brands or reference images.
Brand Name: {{Brand Name}}
Brand Positioning: {{Category/Scene}}

The visual style refers to Chinese folk art, handmade woodblock prints, naive illustrations, and the feeling of text-graphic combined logos:
Use 'thick handwritten Chinese characters + naive folk art illustrations + low-saturation earthy colors + small red seal' as the core structure.
The main body of the logo should be composed of the Chinese brand name and a set of story-like small illustrations. The illustration content should revolve around the brand's temperament, which can be animals, people, landscapes, plants, utensils, houses, transportation, or life scenes, and naturally integrated with the text, rather than simply pasted vertically.

The text part should have a sense of handwriting, naivety, woodcut, and printing. The strokes should have slight variations in thickness, and the edges can be slightly irregular, as if written or carved by hand.
The illustration part should be simplified, generalized, childlike, and naive, with a taste of folk picture books and handmade signs. It should not be too fine or commercially templated.
The overall color scheme uses low-saturation vintage earthy colors, such as ink black, grass green, brick red, earth yellow, grayish blue, brown, off-white, etc. The number of colors should be controlled between 3–5.
A small red seal can be added as a finishing detail.
The layout should be relaxed and natural, preserving a sense of manual touch and breathability, looking like a warm small shop brand.

Output Requirements:
1. Pure white or light off-white background
2. A single complete logo, clearly displayed in the center
3. Simple visual, do not make it into a poster
4. No complex gradients, no 3D, no metallic textures
5. No modern technology feel, no over-refined vector feel
6. Clear design sense, recognizability, and brand integrity
7. If there is English, it can serve as auxiliary small text and should not overshadow the main content.

prompts.text: Generate a visual work with a clear seasonal feel based on the theme "Lotus" for the purpose of "Knowledge Infographic". Establish a central weight with a large-scale calligraphic main character or theme symbol at first glance. Brushstrokes should have dry and wet ink changes, feibai (flying white) edges, and an outward stretching momentum, appearing as if held up by air rather than filling the screen. The background should maintain a large area of high-brightness negative space and a soft misty light effect. A set of slender diagonal linear elements should be placed from the top left into the interior of the frame as a reading guide; the lines should be light, clean, and rhythmic, forming a dense-sparse contrast with the central main form. Below, use a translucent main form derived from the theme to carry the emotion, employing watercolor smudging, soft-focus edges, thin layering, and local enlargement, allowing the subject to grow out of the light-colored matte surface. Beside it, add an extremely small and clear theme-derived dot-like creature or symbol as a vitality focus, with a very small area but a brighter color. Informational text appears only as hierarchy and rhythm: retain the contrast between a small-sized rational title and light handwritten foreign text at the top, the central main character is the heaviest, and the short phrases at the bottom are quieter with relaxed letter spacing, leaving enough room to breathe. Colors are extracted from the theme's own season, material, emotion, and cultural signals, mapped to a large area of bright and clean base color, soft transparent main support colors, a small amount of clear emphasis color, and informational colors with clear light and dark levels. Maintain an overall bright, light, clear, and clean feel with high brightness, low turbidity, soft contrast, and transparent layers; even if the theme requires deeper colors, use clear deep colors and airy white space. The texture of the image combines light watercolor, soft misty light, clean paper surface, and calligraphic ink, avoiding crowded decoration, allowing the central brushstrokes, diagonal guidance, bottom transparent subject, and small-area vitality points to collectively form a refreshing and ritualistic theme memory. Aspect ratio 16:9.

prompts.text: Generate a bright and clear graphical visual around any theme subject: the subject does not appear as a realistic, complete object, but is translated into large areas of halftone dot forms; several enlarged partial sections cut in from the edges, forming a slight tilted encirclement and negative space pressure, with a quiet open space preserved near the center, allowing small-scale theme symbols and title information to become the second reading point. Typography consists of a restrained center title and small corner information to form a reading path; titles can use slender serif or elegant Songti temperament, with relaxed letter spacing and composed line spacing; information blocks are small and precise, and must not overpower the main forms and negative space. The overall look is a combination of print halftone, refreshing commercial layout, and light graphical experimentation; most importantly, let the enlarged halftone forms and the empty field shape each other, rather than drawing the subject as a common illustration. The poster should feel like a premium music magazine cover, artist poster, album concept, stage visual or fashion editorial cover.

Use black-and-white photography, strong contrast, realistic human texture, expressive eyes, natural hair, editorial styling, bold typography, grain, print texture and controlled negative space. Typography should not be decoration only — it should shape the whole visual structure.

Choose one direction:

1. Dark idol cover poster

2. Double silhouette artist poster
   Use a giant black side-profile silhouette as the main structure, with a smaller full-body artist placed inside or below it. Keep it minimal, emotional and album-cover-like.

3. Glitch gradient portrait
   Use a clear head-and-shoulders portrait that gradually dissolves into horizontal scan lines, digital distortion or signal blur. Keep the layout minimal, grey, futuristic and experimental.

4. Dark performance editorial poster
   Use a full-body or almost full-body performer in a tense stage pose. Add dark space, thin perspective lines, body tension, dramatic shadows and a large title across the composition.

Keep the result high-end, editorial, cinematic and design-driven.

Avoid cheap template design, pop poster clichés, messy collage, too many stickers, overused streetwear graphics, fake plastic skin, bad anatomy, distorted faces, random text blocks, weak typography, cartoon style and real copyrighted magazine logos.

Generate one finished poster only.

prompts.text:
Please generate a vertical 9:16 Chinese 'Interactive Check-in Shaped Standee' design mockup, with the theme [Theme] as a head-cover style photo check-in device, suitable for [Usage Scene]. The overall image is a complete interactive installation in a store / theme park / mall activity area, not a regular poster, not a white background graphic design draft, but a shaped standee suitable for customers to stand behind and put their heads in to take photos.

Basic Information:
Theme: [Little Astronaut / Dessert Magician / Cute Pet Nurse / Dinosaur Archaeology Captain / Other character themes]
Usage Scene: [Parent-child Paradise / Science Exploration Museum / Dessert Shop / Parent-child Baking Studio / Pet Shop / Pet Park / Mall Activity Area / Children's Theme Park]
Main Title: [Main Title]
Subtitle: [An interactive slogan, for example: Today you come to the moon! / Today the sweetness is cast by you / Today you take care of the cuteness / Today you come to discover the ancient world!]
Brand Name: [Brand Name / Venue Name]
Overall Style: [Cute / Dreamy / Adventure / Adorable / Healing / Dramatic / Parent-child feel]
Main Color: [Main Color]

Visual Requirements:
1. Image aspect ratio must be vertical 9:16, fully displaying a landable interactive check-in shaped standee.
2. There must be a clear 'head cover opening / face cutout area' in the upper-middle part of the standee, suitable for real people to put their heads in for photos.
3. The head cover opening must naturally blend into the structure of the character itself, such as helmets, hats, arches, theme frames, or the character's head position, and should not look like a forced hole.
4. A complete character body must be designed below the opening, so that users feel like they have really become this character after putting their heads in.
5. Character movements should have a sense of interaction, such as waving, welcoming, making a V-sign, holding props, carrying things, reaching forward, pointing forward, etc.
6. The overall standee must be a shaped outline, not a regular rectangle, not a regular display stand; the shaped outline should be naturally formed by extending theme elements.
7. Add large-sized decorative elements according to the theme, such as rockets, planets, cream, cakes, candies, pets, bubbles, dinosaur eggs, fossils, rock layers, maps, tools, etc.
8. The image should have foreground, middle ground, and background layers to create a light 3D installation feel, rather than just a flat hole-digging poster.
9. No obvious white edges, no thick white outlines; reflect structural and 3D sense through theme color trimming, partial shadows, layered blocking, foreground extension, and shaped expansion.
10. Chinese characters should be few and large, mainly retaining: Main Title, Subtitle, Brand Name; do not pile up too much explanatory information.
11. Title text should naturally blend into the device structure, such as signboards, wooden boards, cream words, rock words, theme frames, etc., rather than appearing as separately pasted flat text blocks.
12. The standee should have a real material feel, like KT board, Forex board, or a shaped floor-standing photo device, with clear edges, a sense of thickness, and a stable base.
13. The background can be a simple and real indoor store, theme park, or activity area scene, slightly blurred, not overpowering the main subject.
14. The overall image should be bright, clear, good-looking, and fun, suitable for customers to take photos and share on social media.

Final Effect:
A high-completion Chinese interactive check-in shaped standee, where users can put their heads in to take photos, creating a strong sense of character immersion, with overall shaped extensions, a light 3D installation feel, and strong offline sharing attributes.

Avoid:
Regular posters, regular display stands, no openings, obvious white edges, too much text, messy background, unrealistic structure, or looking like a direct translation/copy of an English version.

prompts.text:
请生成一张竖版 9:16 的中文「互动打卡异形立牌」设计效果图，主题为【主题】的头套式拍照打卡装置，适用于【使用场景】。整体是一张完整的门店 / 乐园 / 商场活动区互动装置，不是普通海报，不是白底平面设计稿，而是适合顾客站在后面把头伸进去拍照的异形立牌。

基础信息：
主题：【小小宇航员 / 甜品魔法师 / 萌宠护理师 / 恐龙考古队长 / 其他角色主题】
使用场景：【亲子乐园 / 科学探索馆 / 甜品店 / 亲子烘焙馆 / 宠物店 / 宠物乐园 / 商场活动区 / 儿童主题乐园】
主标题：【主标题】
副标题：【一句互动口号，例如：今天你来登月！/ 今天甜度由你施法 / 今天由你照顾可爱 / 今天你来发现远古世界！】
品牌名：【品牌名 / 场馆名】
整体风格：【可爱 / 梦幻 / 冒险 / 萌系 / 治愈 / 戏剧感 / 亲子感】
主色调：【主色调】

画面要求：
1. 画面比例必须为竖版 9:16，完整展示一张可落地的互动打卡异形立牌。
2. 立牌中上部必须有明显的“头套开孔 / 脸部镂空区”，适合真人把头伸进去拍照。
3. 头套开孔必须自然融入角色本身结构，例如头盔、帽子、拱门、主题框体、角色头部位置，不能像生硬挖洞。
4. 开孔下方要设计完整的角色身体，让用户套头后像真的变成这个角色。
5. 角色动作要有互动感，例如挥手、欢迎、比耶、拿道具、托物、向前伸手、指向前方等。
6. 立牌整体必须是异形轮廓，不要普通矩形，不要普通展架；异形轮廓要由主题元素自然延伸形成。
7. 根据主题加入大尺寸装饰元素，例如火箭、星球、奶油、蛋糕、糖果、宠物、泡泡、恐龙蛋、化石、岩层、地图、工具等。
8. 画面要有前中后景层次，形成轻立体装置感，不要只是平面挖洞海报。
9. 不要明显白边，不要粗白描边；要通过主题色切边、局部阴影、层叠遮挡、前景延伸、异形外扩来体现结构感和立体感。
10. 中文文字要少而大，主要保留：主标题、副标题、品牌名，不要堆太多说明信息。
11. 标题文字要自然融入装置结构中，比如招牌、木牌、奶油字、岩石字、主题框体等，不要像单独贴上的平面字块。
12. 立牌要有真实物料感，像KT板、雪弗板或异形落地拍照装置，有清晰边缘、厚度感和稳定底座。
13. 背景可以是简洁真实的室内门店、乐园或活动区场景，轻微虚化，不要抢主体。
14. 整体画面要明亮、清晰、好看、有趣，适合顾客拍照打卡和社交媒体传播。

最终效果：
一张高完成度的中文互动打卡异形立牌，用户可以把头套进去拍照，形成强角色代入感，整体具有异形延伸、轻立体装置感和很强的线下传播属性。

避免：
普通海报、普通展架、没有开孔、明显白边、文字太多、背景太乱、结构不真实、像英文版直接翻译复刻。

prompts.text:
Use the attached image as the primary facial reference with maximum precision. Preserve exact facial structure, natural asymmetry, skin tone, and recognizable identity through all aging and print degradation.

A recovered color photograph from an ordinary afternoon sometime in the late 1990s or early 2000s. The subject is sitting at a study desk covered with notebooks, doodles, stationery, and small everyday clutter while taking a break from writing or homework. Someone nearby casually points a camera toward her and snaps a photograph before she realizes it. She rests her chin on both hands while looking toward the photographer with a quiet, distracted expression. The moment feels completely ordinary, like a forgotten afternoon that nobody expected to remember years later.
OUTFIT:
Pink striped fitted short-sleeve shirt.
HAIR:
Long dark hair with natural movement. A few loose strands drift across the forehead and cheeks. Hair should never appear stiff, perfectly arranged, or frozen in place.
ENVIRONMENT:
A modest bedroom study corner with notebooks, handwritten notes, stationery, flower decorations, small personal keepsakes, and everyday objects scattered naturally across the desk. The space feels lived-in, personal, and slightly cluttered.
LIGHT BEHAVIOR:
Soft afternoon window light mixed with weak disposable-camera flash. The flash slightly brightens the face and foreground while failing to fully overpower the ambient room light.
CAMERA & FILM CHARACTERISTICS:
Cheap disposable-camera optics, soft corners, visible film grain, slight barrel distortion, mild focus inconsistency, weak flash power, subtle chromatic aberration, imperfect consumer-grade image quality.
PHOTO AGING & RECOVERY:
Authentic recovered-photo aging. Glossy photo-paper texture remains visible beneath the image. Fine dust particles, tiny scratches, paper fibers, scanner artifacts, faint fingerprint marks, mild gloss deterioration, soft amber warming, uneven fading, subtle dye migration, gentle heat-aging, and faint smoke-like discoloration distributed naturally across the entire photograph. The aging feels organic and affects the whole print rather than a single corner.
COLOR SCIENCE:
Authentic late-1990s consumer print film palette with warm paper-yellowing, olive-shifted greens, softened blues, charcoal-brown shadows, and naturally preserved skin tones.
COMPOSITION:
Handheld snapshot framing with a subtle dutch tilt. Subject occupies roughly 70–75% of the frame. Desk objects create natural foreground layering with slightly awkward cropping and casual family-photo energy.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 image in the "Neon Doodle Gallery Snapshot" style.

Subject: [SUBJECT].
Subject action: [SUBJECT_ACTION].
Prop or product: [PRODUCT_OR_PROP].
Location: [kashmir].
Background elements: [wooden interior ].
Main handwritten text: "[Focus mode on]".
Secondary handwritten text: "[keep going]".
Accent symbol: [ACCENT_SYMBOL].
Wardrobe style: [WARDROBE_STYLE].

Use a realistic candid phone-photo as the base layer. The setting should feel specific and ordinary: visible walls, art, shelves, labels, tables, lamps, posters, people, bags, shadows, grain, and imperfect handheld framing.

Draw a loud digital marker layer directly on top of the photo. Wrap the main subject with a thick hot-pink contour and a cyan offset glow. Add yellow-orange monster spikes, horns, rays, fins, or sunburst shapes around the silhouette. Scatter rough hand-drawn symbols around the frame: stars, paw prints, spiderweb corners, halos, abstract eyes, plants, flowers, scribble underlines, tally marks, arrows, hearts, and sticker-like blobs.

Place rough uppercase handwritten marker text in open areas, using white, yellow, or lime green. The text should feel funny, personal, distracted, and student-made. Preserve the contrast between a real candid photo and chaotic handmade doodles.

Avoid watermarks, usernames, platform logos, creator IDs, app marks, QR codes, clean vector-only illustration, fully illustrated backgrounds, polished ad layout, luxury editorial styling, perfect typography, empty sterile locations, identifiable celebrities, and tiny unreadable text.

--- VARIABLES ---

[ACCENT_SYMBOL] — star, paw print, spiderweb, halo, abstract eye, plant, flower, underline, arrow, tally mark, or scribble
[BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS] — real photo details such as wall art, labels, shelves, posters, tables, lamps, signage, crowds, fabric, shadows, and phone-camera grain
[LOCATION] — art gallery, campus hallway, library, studio critique room, classroom, night market, cafe, bookstore, museum, or city wall
[MAIN_TEXT] — large hand-drawn caption or emotional headline
[PRODUCT_OR_PROP] — notebook, tote bag, coffee, phone, headphones, sketchbook, jacket, snack, poster, camera, book, or exhibition card
[SECONDARY_TEXT] — small handwritten notes, repeated words, short joke, date-like label, or study annotation
[SUBJECT] — main person, group, student, artist, friend, commuter, shopper, or quiet candid figure
[SUBJECT_ACTION] — looking at art, studying, walking, waiting, browsing, reacting, hiding, laughing, or holding a prop
[WARDROBE_STYLE] — casual student streetwear, oversized shirt, hoodie, tote bag, loose trousers, jacket, headphones, sneakers, or art-school layers

--- NEGATIVE PROMPT ---

watermark, username, creator ID, platform logo, app mark, QR code, clean vector poster, fully illustrated scene, polished advertising layout, luxury editorial shoot, sterile studio, perfect typography, perfect sticker sheet, subtle doodles, empty background, corporate mascot, identifiable celebrity, real public figure, tiny unreadable text

items.title: AI蕾丝居家裙高端品牌视觉提案板

prompts.text:
Please generate a horizontal 4:3, high-definition realistic photography texture Chinese version of an 'AI Lace Loungewear Style Proposal' image.

【This Theme】
【Fill in: e.g., Champagne Satin with Lace / Cream White Gauze Lace / Red Bean Paste Rose Soft Lace / Morning Mist Purple Light Lace】

【Product Name】
【Fill in: Original Brand Name + Product Name】

【Loungewear Style / Color】
【Fill in: Color, style, camisole, cover-up, gauze, satin, lace splicing, etc.】

【Fabric Keywords】
【Fill in: Lace, gauze, satin, soft and skin-friendly, natural drape, exquisite embroidery, light layers, etc.】

【Overall Style Keywords】
Light mature, soft, home relaxation, light luxury, exquisite, female-oriented, realistic photography, brand lookbook, Chinese 'seeding' board, soft light bedroom atmosphere.

【Overall Positioning】
This is not a vulgar image, not a sexy advertisement, and not a cheap e-commerce image. 
Please create a high-completion product proposal board that combines 'main visual model display + loungewear product breakdown + fabric detail close-up + professional information module + matching inspiration small pictures + Chinese handwriting style annotations'. 
The overall look is like a social media visual solution for high-end loungewear / nightgown / light luxury women's clothing brands, real, clear, informative, and collectible.

【Layout Requirements】
Horizontal 4:3.
Top title writes: AI居家裙风格提案 / AI Lace Loungewear Styling Board.
Left side: Main visual model display.
Middle: Product breakdown + fabric details + material interaction close-ups.
Right side: Professional information module.
Bottom: 3 matching / scene inspiration small cards.
Background uses warm white, light gray-white, light champagne white, cream white, or soft low-saturation colors.
Add thin line frames, color cards, material cards, arrows, rating bars, Chinese handwriting style annotations, layout is full but clear, do not be cluttered.

【Main Visual Model】
Generate an adult Asian female model, the person is realistic, natural, beautiful, and recognizable, do not look like an AI clone.
The model is naturally leaning, half-leaning, sitting sideways, or slightly turning her head in a simple and high-end bedroom, by the bed, by the window, or on soft bedding.
The main body of the dress must be clearly visible, focusing on the clothing structure, fabric texture, overall fit, and home atmosphere.
Postures are natural and elegant, can be tidying the cover-up, lightly lifting the hem, lightly touching the shoulder strap, naturally hanging hands, or sitting by the bed.
No suggestive poses, no vulgar actions, no exaggerated erotic expressions.

【Product Display】
Clearly display the product breakdown of the same loungewear:
Dress flat lay, shoulder strap details, neckline lace details, waist tailoring, hem lace, fabric texture enlargement, gauze / satin / lace splicing details, fabric drape samples, cover-up or trim details.

【Material Interaction Close-up】
Include 2 clean and professional fabric display close-ups:
1. Fingers lightly touching the edge of the lace, showing the pattern, softness, and delicacy.
2. Lightly lifting the hem or tidying the cover-up, showing fabric drape, layers, and lightness.
Following a product display sense, do not be ambiguous, do not fetishize, the focus is on material, design, and fit.

【Right Information Module】
Includes:
Style theme
Color system, showing 5-6 color blocks
Fabric composition
Softness rating
Lightness rating
Drape rating
Exquisiteness rating
Skin-friendly rating
Suitable scenes
Matching suggestions
Wearing impression

【Bottom Matching Inspiration】
Keep 3 small cards, each card displays the outfit effect of a person from the half-body to the thighs, and is accompanied by a short Chinese description.
Example:
Look 01: Morning light bedroom, soft and exquisite
Look 02: Sitting by the bed, cover-up adds layers
Look 03: Soft light by the window, suitable for brand main visuals

【Chinese Handwriting Style Annotations】
Add an appropriate amount of Chinese handwriting style notes, arrows, small circle annotations, small stars.
The copy can revolve around:
Lace details are very exquisite, colors are soft and flatter the skin, the fabric is light and not heavy, the drape is natural, the home atmosphere is complete, suitable for a main visual 'seeding' image, strong sense of brand.

【Visual Requirements】
High-definition realistic photography texture, real people, real fabrics, real natural light, like high-end brand proposal boards, female fashion magazine pages, loungewear brand social media visuals.
No cartoons, no illustrations, no low resolution, no cheap layout, no strong advertisement sticker feeling, no clutter, no watermarks, no redundant logos, no wrong text, no garbled characters, no deformed fingers, no wrong body structures, no plastic skin, no excessive skin smoothing.

prompts.text:
请生成一张横向 4:3、高清写实摄影质感的中文版「AI蕾丝居家裙风格提案」图片。

【本张主题】
【填写：如 香槟缎面拼蕾丝 / 奶油白轻纱蕾丝 / 豆沙玫瑰柔蕾丝 / 晨雾紫轻蕾丝】

【产品名称】
【填写：原创品牌名 + 产品名】

【居家裙款式 / 颜色】
【填写：颜色、款式、吊带、外披、薄纱、缎面、蕾丝拼接等】

【面料关键词】
【填写：蕾丝、薄纱、缎面、柔软亲肤、自然垂坠、精致刺绣、轻盈层次等】

【整体风格关键词】
轻熟、柔和、居家松弛、轻奢、精致、女性向、写实写真、品牌 lookbook、中文种草板、柔光卧室氛围。

【整体定位】
这不是低俗图片，不是情趣广告，也不是廉价电商图。
请创作一张兼具「主视觉模特展示 + 居家裙产品拆解 + 面料细节特写 + 专业信息模块 + 搭配灵感小图 + 中文手写风标注」的高完成度产品提案板。
整体像高端家居服 / 睡裙 / 轻奢女装品牌的社媒视觉方案，真实、清晰、有信息量、有收藏感。

【版式要求】
横向 4:3。
顶部标题写：AI居家裙风格提案 / AI Lace Loungewear Styling Board。
左侧：主视觉模特展示。
中部：产品拆解 + 面料细节 + 材质互动特写。
右侧：专业信息模块。
底部：3 个搭配 / 场景灵感小卡片。
背景使用暖白、浅灰白、浅香槟白、奶油白或柔和低饱和色。
加入细线框、色卡、材质卡、箭头、评分条、中文手写风标注，布局丰满但清晰，不要杂乱。

【主视觉模特】
生成一位成年亚洲女性模特，人物写实、自然、漂亮、有辨识度，不要像 AI 克隆人。
模特在简洁高级的卧室、床边、窗边或柔软床品上自然靠坐、半倚、侧坐或轻微回头。
裙装主体必须清晰可见，重点展示服装结构、面料质感、整体版型和居家氛围。
姿态自然优雅，可以整理外披、轻提裙摆、轻扶肩带、自然垂手或坐在床边。
不要挑逗姿势，不要低俗动作，不要夸张情色表达。

【产品展示】
清晰展示同款居家裙的产品拆解：
裙装平铺图、肩带细节、领口蕾丝细节、腰线剪裁、裙摆花边、面料纹理放大、薄纱 / 缎面 / 蕾丝拼接细节、面料垂坠小样、外披或边饰细节。

【材质互动特写】
加入 2 个干净专业的面料展示特写：
1. 手指轻触蕾丝边缘，展示花纹、柔软度和精致感。
2. 轻提裙摆或整理外披，展示面料垂坠、层次和轻盈感。
画面必须是产品展示感，不要暧昧，不要恋物化，重点放在材质、设计和版型。

【右侧信息模块】
包含：
风格主题
色彩系统，展示 5-6 个色块
面料构成
柔软度评分
轻盈感评分
垂坠感评分
精致度评分
亲肤感评分
适合场景
搭配建议
穿着印象

【底部搭配灵感】
保留 3 个小卡片，每张卡片展示半身到大腿的人物穿搭效果，并配简短中文说明。
示例：
Look 01：晨光卧室，柔和又精致
Look 02：床边靠坐，外披增加层次
Look 03：窗边柔光，适合品牌主视觉

【中文手写风标注】
加入适量中文手写风注释、箭头、小圈注、小星星。
文案可以围绕：
蕾丝细节很精致、颜色柔和很衬肤色、面料轻盈不厚重、垂坠感自然、居家氛围完整、适合做主视觉种草图、品牌感很强。

【视觉要求】
高清写实摄影质感，真实人物，真实面料，真实自然光，像高端品牌提案板、女性时尚杂志内页、居家服品牌社媒视觉。
不要卡通，不要插画，不要低清晰度，不要廉价排版，不要强广告贴图感，不要杂乱，不要水印，不要多余 logo，不要错误文字，不要乱码，不要畸形手指，不要错误身体结构，不要塑料皮肤，不要过度磨皮。

prompts.text:
Generate a visual with a strong sense of design around any theme: the frame is supported by a dark, quiet information field holding a giant circular fisheye window in the center; the window looks as if it is stretched open by a mirror or wide-angle lens, the core content of the theme is stretched at close range inside the circle, foreground elements stretch out toward the viewer and press close to the circular boundary, with slight distortion and a sense of realistic light and shadow pressure at the edges, forming a first-look impact of "bursting out of the frame immediately." The outer edge of the circle is marked with thin white lines, incomplete arcs, and a few circular dot nodes to indicate the structure; the outer field is distributed with thick and heavy main titles, year or serial-style large numbers, short sentence information blocks, and extremely small font technical annotations. The fonts are mainly high-contrast white, the main title is tight and powerful, and the auxiliary text is small and calm; Chinese and English can be mixed but only as rhythm and information hierarchy, not copying any existing copy. Theme identification symbols can fall on foreground contact points or patches, like small marks pressed against glass, forming clear memory points. Colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and semantics of the theme itself, maintaining the role relationship of a large area of clean dark structural base, a bright and transparent lighting subject inside the circle, a small amount of high-saturation clear emphasis colors, white information text, and clean shadow layers; the overall visual mood remains bright and energetic, calm yet crazy, dark parts should be clear, and bright parts should have sun-like high brightness and clean boundaries, avoiding dirty gray, old, smoky, or retro yellowing. The image texture combines the spatial perspective of real photography, fisheye distortion, strong foreground scale, and digital graphic layout, with high information density but a clear reading path: see the circular impact and foreground contact points first, then read the main title and numbers, and finally discover the scattered miniature annotations.

——————

On-site text: Outer field has the thick title "Tonight Watch Football Together", next to it listing 22:00 Kick-off, 2nd floor big screen, limited seats 36, the sense of numbers should be obvious.

items.title: 怀旧复古九十年代一次性相机人像

prompts.text:
use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision while preserving exact facial structure, natural asymmetry, skin tone, and recognizable identity.

A recovered old color photograph from a forgotten summer vacation, as if the picture was taken on a cheap disposable camera sometime in the late 1990s or early 2000s, stored for decades inside a family photo album, partially exposed to heat, then carefully recovered and scanned years later.

The subject occupies approximately 70–80% of the frame and is positioned slightly off-center. She is captured sitting casually on a worn living-room sofa inside a small apartment during a lazy summer afternoon. Wearing an oversized pale pink graphic t-shirt, denim shorts, and knee-high striped socks, she sits comfortably with her legs folded while surrounded by music posters, magazine clippings, cassette advertisements, and bedroom-wall memorabilia. Her posture feels natural and completely unposed, as if a friend snapped the photo during a quiet day spent listening to music and flipping through old magazines. Short dark wavy hair falls naturally around her face with loose strands framing her cheeks. Her expression feels relaxed, thoughtful, and slightly distracted.

The framing feels slightly awkward and accidental. Parts of the wall posters are cropped unevenly, sections of the sofa disappear outside the frame, and excess wall space remains visible around the subject. The composition feels spontaneous, as if photographed quickly without carefully arranging the scene. Slight dutch tilt.

The photograph is colored with authentic aged color-photo rendering. Warm faded skin tones with softened highlight density and aged photo-paper tonal response. Colors appear slightly sun-faded and gently desaturated from decades of print aging. Low-contrast aged print rendering, lifted blacks, faded shadow density, compressed tonal range, softened tonal separation, noticeably faded color dyes, washed photo-paper response, subtle cyan-magenta aging contamination, and authentic old print scan appearance. Reds, blues, greens, and yellows appear slightly muted as if the photographic dyes have slowly faded over time. The overall image retains color but feels softly weathered and less vibrant than a modern photograph.

The recovered photograph exhibits authentic print aging and density loss. Blacks are lifted into faded charcoal-gray tones rather than true black. Shadow regions retain visible detail and appear softly washed, creating the impression of an old photo print that has slowly lost density over decades. Dark hair, poster shadows, sofa shadows, room corners, and shaded areas never fall into pure black, instead rendering as muted gray-black tones with subtle green-magenta contamination commonly found in aged disposable-camera prints and old photo-album scans.

The recovered print exhibits mild dye fading typical of old family-photo albums. Color saturation has naturally weakened over time, producing a soft pastel-like appearance without becoming monochrome. Bright colors appear gently subdued, contributing to the nostalgic recovered-photo feeling.

The recovered photograph shows visible yellowed paper texture throughout the entire image, as if the print aged naturally over many years. Slight paper discoloration appears across brighter areas. The photograph surface shows tiny dust particles, faint scratches, mild scanner texture, and realistic recovered-album wear.

Very subtle burn damage appears only near the outer edges of the photograph: faintly scorched brown corners, faint smoke discoloration, tiny ash marks, slight paper warping, and minimal heat exposure. The main portrait remains fully preserved and readable.

prompts.text:
使用附图作为主要面部参考，保持高精度并保留精确的面部结构、自然的非对称性、肤色以及可辨认的身份。

一张从被遗忘的暑假中恢复的旧彩色照片，仿佛是 1990 年代末或 2000 年代初用廉价一次性相机拍摄的，在家庭相册中存放了数十年，部分暴露在高温下，多年后被仔细恢复并扫描。

主体占据画面的约 70–80% 且位置略微偏离中心。她被拍到在一个懒散的夏日午后，随意地坐在小公寓陈旧的客厅沙发上。她穿着一件超大号浅粉色图案 T 恤、牛仔短裤和及膝条纹袜，舒服地坐着，双腿折叠，周围环绕着音乐海报、杂志剪报、卡带广告和卧室墙壁纪念品。她的姿势感觉自然且完全没有摆拍感，就像是朋友在听音乐和翻阅旧杂志的安静日子里随手拍下的照片。短黑波浪发自然地垂在脸庞周围，松散的发丝勾勒出她的脸颊。她的表情显得放松、沉思且略带分神。

构图感觉略显尴尬和偶然。墙上的海报被裁剪得不均匀，沙发的部分区域消失在画面之外，主体周围仍可见多余的墙面空间。构图感觉很自发，仿佛在没有仔细布置场景的情况下快速拍摄的。轻微的荷兰式倾斜。

照片采用了真实的陈旧彩色照片渲染。温暖褪色的肤色，具有柔化的亮部密度和陈旧相纸的色调反应。色彩由于数十年的打印老化而显得略微晒褪和柔和脱色。低对比度陈旧打印渲染，提升的黑色，褪色的阴影密度，压缩的色调范围，柔化的色调分离，明显褪色的彩色染料，冲洗过的相纸反应，微妙的青红色老化污染，以及真实的旧照片扫描外观。红、蓝、绿和黄色显得略微柔和，仿佛照相染料随着时间的推移慢慢褪色。整体图像保留了颜色，但感觉柔和地风化，不如现代照片那样鲜艳。

恢复的照片展现了真实的打印老化和密度损失。黑色被提升为褪色的炭灰色调，而不是纯黑。阴影区域保留了可见的细节，显得柔和且被冲淡，营造出一种在数十年中慢慢失去密度的旧照片打印的印象。黑发、海报阴影、沙发阴影、房间角落和阴影区域永远不会落入纯黑，而是呈现为带有微妙绿红色污染的柔和灰黑色调，这种污染常见于陈旧的一次性相机照片和旧相册扫描件中。

恢复的印片展现了旧家庭相册中典型的轻微染料褪色。色彩饱和度随着时间的推移自然减弱，产生一种柔和的类粉彩色外观，而没有变成单色。鲜艳的色彩显得柔和，增强了怀旧的恢复照片感。

恢复的照片在整个图像中显示出明显的泛黄纸张纹理，仿佛照片经过多年的自然老化。较亮区域出现轻微的纸张变色。照片表面显示出细小的尘埃颗粒、微弱的划痕、轻微的扫描仪纹理以及真实的恢复相册磨损。

仅在照片外缘出现非常微妙的烧伤损坏：微焦的棕色角落、微弱的烟草变色、微小的灰烬痕迹、轻微的纸张翘曲和极小的热暴露。主肖像保持完全完整且清晰。

prompts.text:
Create a clean educational photography lighting tutorial infographic in a minimalist editorial style. The layout should be a vertical comparison chart with 3 columns and 7 rows.

Top headers:
Left column: Indoors
Middle column: Indoors
Right column: Outdoors
Include a small note near the outdoor header: no reflective surfaces and also a note saying NO CEILING OUTDOORS.

Each row should compare a different flash lighting method. Show the same female model in black-and-white portrait photos with the same pose across the chart, standing near a plain wall, wearing a simple top, medium-length dark hair, realistic expression, classic studio portrait look.

Row 1: DIRECT
Left panel: a simple technical lighting diagram showing direct flash aimed at the subject.
Middle panel: indoor result with hard direct flash and a sharp shadow on the wall.
Right panel: outdoor result with even harder shadow and stronger contrast.

Row 2: BOUNCE
Left panel: lighting diagram showing flash bouncing off the ceiling.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with softer upward bounced light and a gentler wall shadow.
Right panel: text note instead of photo saying "NO CEILING OUTDOORS".

Row 3: LUMIQUEST
Left panel: lighting diagram for LumiQuest style bounced/diffused flash.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with soft but directional light.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with darker, more defined shadow.

Row 4: OMNIBOUNCE
Left panel: lighting diagram showing flash scattered in multiple directions.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with diffused, room-filled light and softer shadow.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with stronger contrast and shadow because there are no reflective surfaces.

Row 5: THROUGH AN UMBRELLA
Left panel: diagram showing flash shooting through a translucent umbrella toward the subject.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with broad, soft light and smooth shadows.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with soft light on subject but still a noticeable shadow behind.

Row 6: OFF AN UMBRELLA
Left panel: diagram showing flash reflected off a white umbrella.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with soft reflected light and balanced contrast.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with more contrast and deeper background shadow.

Row 7: THROUGH A SOFT BOX
Left panel: diagram showing a rectangular softbox aimed at the subject.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with very soft, even professional lighting.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with soft directional lighting and a more visible shadow than indoors.

Design style:
monochrome / black and white
clean instructional infographic
thin black borders around each panel
light gray background in diagram panels
simple line art technical diagrams with arrows showing light paths
realistic portrait photography in the example panels
neat typography, all caps row labels

high clarity, easy to understand, professional tutorial layout.

围绕任意主题对象生成一张图文拼贴感很强的视觉图像：主题对象以极近距离的主形体进入画面，占据一侧主要视觉重量，只露出最有识别度的局部边缘、表面、轮廓或核心细节，另一侧保留干净通风的底场，并放入一条窄幅信息栏形成书脊般的秩序感。主体表面与留白之间叠加多组主题派生文字、符号和小型图形标记，像贴纸、手写签名、涂鸦编号、微缩说明文字同时漂浮在同一层级中；文字大小跳跃明显，主标识要有快速手写的挥洒笔势，次级文字更圆润、松动、带泡泡感，细小文字低透明度埋在主体暗部或纹理上，只提供密度和节奏，不抢走主视觉。构图要让第一眼先读到被强裁切的主题局部和最大手写标识，第二眼才发现周围的贴纸编号、边栏文字和半隐藏信息，形成青春杂志剪贴、唱片内页、手账贴纸混合的轻快压力。色彩从主题自身的材质、情绪和文化语义中提取：大面积底场保持高明度、清透、干净，主体使用主题的主要材质色或结构色，文字信息用清晰的深浅色阶建立可读层次，少量高饱和强调色只落在手写标识、编号或小贴纸上制造明亮活泼的瞬间；整体要明亮轻快、边界清楚、暗部也保持洁净，不做陈旧、浑浊或灰脏处理。画面质感带轻微扫描网点、印刷颗粒和贴纸边缘，但主体局部仍要细腻清晰，图像与文字彼此遮挡、穿插、压叠，像被精心排过版的随手涂写，而不是整齐模板或普通信息海报。

——————
招募场景: 做青年街舞社团纳新横版 16:9 封面，画面只近裁运动鞋鞋尖、宽松裤脚和地板反光，让动作像刚踩进画面。
主字处理: 大手写标识写“来跳一下”，贴纸小字穿插“周五晚 7 点”“零基础可来”“排练室 B1”。
需要出现: 一张皱边报名贴、一枚圆形队标和几条像彩排编号的涂鸦线，文字贴在鞋边和留白交界处。

prompts.text:
Ultra-viral vintage travel poster of Pamukkale, Turkey, designed in a timeless retro tourism style. The sun sits low on the horizon, casting dramatic golden rays across the vast Anatolian landscape. Soft atmospheric haze blankets the distant valley, revealing a picturesque town below. Above the terraces stand the ancient ruins of Hierapolis, with weathered stone arches, columns, and cypress trees illuminated by the warm evening light. Several birds soar through a sky filled with glowing orange and peach clouds, enhancing the cinematic atmosphere.
Highly detailed textures of the travertine formations, realistic reflections in the thermal pools, ultra-sharp landscape photography quality, vibrant turquoise water, warm golden highlights, and rich contrast. PAMUKKALE

prompts.text:
Create a premium vintage travel magazine cover poster for [CITY NAME] in a vertical 4:5 composition.

Automatically identify and feature the city's most iconic landmark as the dominant central focal point. Render the landmark and surrounding cityscape as an intricate papercraft diorama with layered paper-cut architecture, realistic depth, handcrafted shadows, and miniature-world storytelling.

The design should feel like a collectible luxury travel magazine cover, blending vintage explorer journals, editorial design, and sophisticated destination advertising.

COMPOSITION

• Large elegant title: "VISIT [CITY NAME]"
• Small "Destination Series" header above title
• Issue number below title
• Hero landmark occupying the central visual focus
• Supporting cityscape naturally surrounding the landmark
• Antique brass compass centered in the lower foreground
