• Most recognizable landmark

FOREGROUND STORYTELLING

BOTTOM SECTION

STYLE

• 大而优雅的标题：“VISIT [CITY NAME]”
• 标题上方的小标题“目的地系列”
• 标题下方的期号
• 英雄地标占据中心视觉焦点
• 地标周围自然环绕的辅助城市景观
• 居中于下前景的古董黄铜指南针
• 指南针周围稀疏的黑白旅行涂鸦

自动目的地研究

仅根据城市名称，智能地包含：

• 最具辨识度的地标
• 地道的当地建筑
• 著名的交通工具
• 文化符号
• 传统咖啡馆、市场或街道场景
• 当地植物或自然元素
• 地区艺术图案
• 作为单色线条草图的次要地标
• 准确的经纬度

前景叙事

包含：

• 2–3 名正在探索目的地的微型旅行者
• 1–2 名在指南针附近研究地图的微型探险家
• 1 辆自行车或当地合适的交通工具
• 1 名咖啡馆员工、摊贩或当地人的剪影
• 一些用于展示比例的微小行人
• 3–5 只适合该地点的鸟类

旅行日记元素

使用极简且精致的：

• 复古邮票
• 护照盖章
• 手绘路线图
• 位置图钉
• 旅行素描
• 小手写旅行笔记

保持充足的留白，避免杂乱。

色彩处理

• 温暖的黄金时刻或日落照明
• 高级编辑色彩分级
• 略微柔和的饱和度
• 具有丰富深度的氛围天空
• 最强的细节和对比度保留给英雄地标
• 背景元素经过软化以体现视觉层级

底部区域

包含：

• 城市准确的坐标
• “梦想 • 探索 • 发现”标语
• 次要当地地标的极简单色草图

风格

奢华旅游海报、收藏级目的地系列、纸雕透视模型、微型世界、手工建筑、复古探险日记、编辑杂志封面、高级旅游宣传、电影级照明、分层纸艺、精致印刷设计、适合 Instagram 的构图、高度详细且整洁。

最终的作品应能立即传达该城市的身份、文化、氛围和精神，同时保持统一的高级旅游海报美学。

prompts.text:
Edit foto wanita tersebut menjadi potret High Angle Sinematik dari seorang wanita muda yang cantik dari sudut pandang belakang. Fokus utamanya adalah pada bahu, lengan, dan sebagian wajahnya yang menghadap ke samping dengan ekspresi tenang. Ia mengenakan atasan sweater rajut dengan model sabrina berwarna cokelat muda. Tekstur kulitnya terlihat sangat halus di bawah siraman cahaya matahari yang terfilter. Latar belakang di outdoor buram (bokeh). Wajahnya menoleh ke samping melihat ke sikataran dengan ekspresi tenang dan sendu. 

Pencahayaan dan Warna :
Foto ini menggunakan teknik pencahayaan yang kontras (terang-gelap). Cahaya matahari jatuh di bagian bahu dan wajahnya, sementara bagian lainnya tenggelam dalam bayangan. Terdapat bayangan siluet dedaunan atau ranting yang jatuh di punggung dan wajah wanita tersebut, memberikan kesan ia berada di bawah pohon saat matahari mulai terbenam (golden hour).
Palet Warna: Didominasi oleh warna-warna hangat seperti oranye, golden hour, cokelat yang dikontraskan dengan latar belakang yang redup. 

Komposisi dan Estetika
Depth of Field: Latar belakangnya sangat buram (bokeh), membuat subjek wanita menonjol. Kesan yang ditampilkan adalah kelembutan, ketenangan. Foto ini tidak terasa seperti foto potret biasa, melainkan lebih seperti potongan adegan dari sebuah film drama puitis.
Foto ini memiliki atmosfer yang sangat melankolis, artistik, dan sinematik. Komposisinya bermain dengan kontras antara cahaya hangat dan bayangan yang dalam, menciptakan kesan misterius namun intim.

景深：背景非常模糊（虚化），使女性主体脱颖而出。展现出的感觉是柔和、宁静。这张照片感觉不像普通的肖像照，而更像是一部诗意剧情电影中的场景片段。

items.title: 乱序美感手写笔记视觉构图

prompts.text:
Create a composition inspired by messy handwritten notes, while maintaining clear visual hierarchy and readability.

Core Structure:
- Establish a clear focal element (text or object)
- Position focal near center or slightly offset (rule of thirds)
- Ensure it occupies the largest visual weight

Elements:
- Handwritten-style text blocks (vary size and importance)
- Arrows, circles, highlights, underlines
- Small doodles and icons (stars, lines, simple shapes)

Hierarchy Control:
- Primary: focal element (largest, clearest)
- Secondary: supporting notes (medium size)
- Tertiary: small doodles and accents (smallest scale)

Chaos Control:
- Use clustered messiness, not full-frame randomness
- Keep clear breathing space around focal
- Avoid overlapping critical content

Structure:
- Hidden grid alignment underneath
- Intentional spacing between clusters
- Guide the eye using directional elements (arrows, lines)

Color System:
- Base: white / paper tone
- Ink: black or dark grey
- Accents: maximum 1–2 colors only

Style:
- Imperfect, human, slightly chaotic
- Controlled, not cluttered
- Sketch-like but readable

Mood:
- Personal, expressive, slightly playful

Balance Rule:
- 60–70% structured space
- 30–40% “messy” expression

prompts.text:

核心结构：
- 确立一个清晰的焦点元素（文本或物体）
- 将焦点置于中心附近或稍微偏移（三分法）
- 确保其占据最大的视觉权重

元素：
- 手写风格的文本块（改变大小和重要性）
- 箭头、圆圈、高亮、下划线
- 小涂鸦和图标（星星、线条、简单形状）

层级控制：
- 一级：焦点元素（最大、最清晰）
- 二级：辅助笔记（中等大小）
- 三级：小涂鸦和装饰（最小比例）

混乱控制：
- 使用集群式的凌乱，而非全屏的随机感
- 在焦点周围保持清晰的留白空间
- 避免重叠关键内容

结构：
- 底层隐藏网格对齐
- 簇群之间有意图的间距
- 使用方向性元素（箭头、线条）引导视线

色彩系统：
- 基色：白色/纸张色调
- 墨水：黑色或深灰色
- 强调色：最多仅使用 1–2 种颜色

风格：
- 不完美、人文、略显凌乱
- 受控而非杂乱
- 草图感但可读

情绪：
- 个人化、富有表现力、略带俏皮

prompts.text:
use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision while preserving recognizable identity essence, exact facial proportions, natural asymmetry, skin tone, and facial structure. Use the reference only for the half-hidden face, curtain obstruction, floral foreground elements, intimate window light, and quiet emotional mood. Do not copy the reference image’s rendering style. Transform everything into dreamy smeared hazy memory photography.

A forgotten afternoon memory hiding behind curtains, flowers, and fading sunlight. The subject appears only partially visible, as though someone accidentally glimpsed her through a doorway years ago and never forgot the moment. The image feels intimate, fragile, and emotionally unfinished.

The camera observes from behind layers of translucent fabric and flowers. A large linen curtain occupies nearly half of the frame, physically obscuring part of the face. Only fragments of the subject emerge through the opening between curtain folds. The viewer feels as though they are discovering a memory rather than observing a portrait.

The face remains only approximately 30–40% readable. Identity survives through the visible eye, lips, nose contour, cheek structure, jawline, and emotional presence rather than full facial visibility. Parts of the face dissolve into shadow, curtain texture, haze, and soft exposure overlap.

The visible eye becomes the strongest emotional anchor. It emerges quietly from darkness and fabric, holding a distant, almost unreachable gaze. The lips remain softly visible beneath warm shadow and atmospheric softness.

Flowers become a major storytelling element. Warm coral, peach, amber, and faded rose blossoms occupy much of the foreground. Some flowers remain recognizable while others dissolve into bloom, motion softness, translucent layering, and memory contamination. Branches and petals partially cross the face and body.

Long dark hair drifts softly around the visible side of the face. Loose strands catch warm sunlight before disappearing into haze. Hair feels physically woven into the surrounding atmosphere.

Skin appears luminous, creamy, and naturally textured beneath diffusion. Warm peach-gold highlights bloom across the cheekbone, eyelid, nose bridge, lips, and collarbone. Visible pores survive beneath the softness.

Lighting behaves like a forgotten late-afternoon memory. Warm sunlight enters through an old window, filtered by curtains, flowers, and dust in the air. Bright highlights bloom heavily while shadows remain rich and dimensional. Light and shadow drift across the curtain fabric, creating soft organic patterns.

Color punch: richer honey-gold sunlight, stronger peach-rose skin glow, deeper amber shadows, luminous coral flowers, warm terracotta highlights, vibrant but film-like saturation, nostalgic warmth without appearing digital or oversaturated.

prompts.text:
使用附带的图像作为主要的面部参考，具有高精度，同时保留可识别的身份本质、精确的面部比例、自然的非对称性、肤色和面部结构。仅将参考用于半掩的面部、窗帘遮挡、前景的花卉元素、亲密的窗光和安静的情绪氛围。不要复制参考图像的渲染风格。将一切转化为梦幻、涂抹、模糊的记忆摄影作品。

一个躲在窗帘、鲜花和褪色阳光背后的被遗忘的午后记忆。主体仅部分可见，仿佛某人在多年前透过门口偶然瞥见她，并从未忘记那一刻。图像感觉亲密、脆弱且在情感上未完成。

相机从层层半透明织物和鲜花后面进行观察。一幅巨大的亚麻窗帘占据了近一半的画面，从物理上遮挡了部分脸部。只有主体的碎片从窗帘褶皱间的开口中显现。观众感觉自己是在发现一段记忆，而不是在观察一幅肖像。

面部仅保留约 30–40% 的可辨识度。身份通过可见的眼睛、嘴唇、鼻子轮廓、脸颊结构、下颚线和情感存在而存续，而非完整的面部可见度。脸部的部分区域消融在阴影、窗帘纹理、薄雾和柔和的曝光重叠中。

可见的眼睛成为最强的情感锚点。它从黑暗和织物中悄然出现，带着一种遥远的、几乎无法触及的目光。嘴唇在温暖的阴影和大气柔和感下依然隐约可见。

鲜花成为主要的叙事元素。温暖的珊瑚色、桃色、琥珀色和褪色的玫瑰花占据了前景的大部分。一些花朵保持可辨识，而另一些则消融在盛开、运动柔和、半透明分层和记忆污染中。树枝和花瓣部分穿过面部和身体。

长长的黑发在脸部可见的一侧轻轻飘动。松散的发丝在消失在薄雾中之前捕捉到了温暖的阳光。头发感觉在物理上编织进了周围的氛围中。

皮肤显得明亮、乳白且具有自然纹理。温暖的桃金色高光在颧骨、眼睑、鼻梁、嘴唇和锁骨上绽放。可见的毛孔在柔和感之下依然存在。

光线表现得像一段被遗忘的傍晚记忆。温暖的阳光穿过旧窗户，经过窗帘、鲜花和空气中的尘埃过滤。明亮的高光剧烈绽放，而阴影保持丰富且具空间感。光影在窗帘织物上漂移，创造出柔和的有机图案。

色彩冲击：更丰富的蜂蜜金色阳光，更强烈的桃红肤色光泽，更深的琥珀色阴影，明亮的珊瑚色花朵，温暖的赤陶色高光，充满活力但具有电影般的饱和度，怀旧的温暖而不显数字感或过度饱和。

使用柯达 Portra 400 胶片通过复古漫射光学镜片拍摄。自然的胶片色彩表现。温暖的肤色渲染。柔和的高光衰减。柔和的模拟色彩分离。

光学行为：强烈的 Black Pro-Mist 柔光，窗户高光周围沉重的光晕，大气薄雾，镜头绽放，柔和的曝光重叠，轻微的重影，旧玻璃的柔和感，漂移的光污染，半透明窗帘层叠，浅焦过渡，胶片颗粒，尘埃颗粒，微小划痕，陈旧的摄影纹理，有机光散射。

构图：窗帘、鲜花、薄雾、阳光和氛围占据了约 70% 的情感叙事。面部的可见碎片占据了约 30%。观众应该感觉像是偶然想起了几十年前的一个夏日午后站在窗帘后的某人。

情绪：被遗忘的午后记忆，梦境般的亲密，情感渴望，褪色的回忆，脆弱的美丽，花卉忧郁，安静的神秘，永恒的脆弱感。

items.title: 手绘涂鸦与写实主体融合插画设计

prompts.text:
Create a cheerful, creative composition that blends a realistic subject with playful hand-drawn doodles and a subtle micro-story.

Subject:
[insert object / person / product — keep simple and recognizable]

Layout:
- Invisible clean grid system underneath
- Balanced, airy spacing (avoid clutter)
- Clear hierarchy: subject first, doodles second, micro details third

Doodles (IMPORTANT):
- Playful, expressive, slightly exaggerated
- Include: smiley faces, stars, sparkles, arrows, motion lines, cute icons
- Doodles must INTERACT with the subject (touching, pulling, lifting, reacting)

Micro Story:
- Add a tiny, fun narrative (e.g., doodle characters using the object, reacting to it)
- Keep it subtle and discoverable on second glance

Typography:
- Friendly sans-serif + handwritten notes
- Casual tone (not serious, not corporate)
- Include small fun labels or thoughts

Color:
- Base: white / soft cream
- Ink: soft black / dark grey
- Accents: 2–3 cheerful colors (yellow, sky blue, soft red, mint, etc.)

Lighting:
- Bright, soft, uplifting
- No harsh shadows

Style:
- Clean + playful + slightly imperfect
- Feels human, warm, and creative

Constraints:
- Do NOT overcrowd
- Every doodle must have purpose or interaction
- Keep subject clearly visible (no obstruction)
- Maintain breathing space

Mood:
[cheerful / curious / lighthearted / imaginative]Add a consistent visual signature:
- same doodle style across all designs
- same color accent system
- recurring tiny character

Introduce a “main doodle character” that appears in every composition interacting with different subjects.

Keep composition consistent across series:
- same framing
- same spacing logic
- same typography style

Goal:
Make the design instantly recognizable as part of a series.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
创建一个愉快且具有创意的构图，将写实的主体与俏皮的手绘涂鸦和微妙的小故事融合在一起。

主体：
[插入物体 / 人物 / 产品 — 保持简单且易于识别]

布局：
- 底层采用无形的整洁网格系统
- 平衡且通透的间距（避免拥挤）
- 清晰的层级：主体第一，涂鸦第二，微观细节第三

涂鸦（重要）：
- 俏皮、富有表现力、略微夸张
- 包含：笑脸、星星、火花、箭头、运动线、可爱图标
- 涂鸦必须与主体互动（触摸、拉动、举起、反应）

微型故事：
- 添加一个微小、有趣的情节（例如，涂鸦角色使用该物体或对其做出反应）
- 保持微妙，在第二次观看时才会被发现

排版：
- 友好的无衬线字体 + 手写笔记
- 休闲语调（非严肃，非企业风格）
- 包含有趣的小标签或想法

颜色：
- 底色：白色 / 柔和奶油色
- 墨水：柔和黑色 / 深灰色
- 强调色：2–3 种愉快的颜色（黄色、天蓝色、柔和红色、薄荷绿等）

光影：
- 明亮、柔和、令人振奋
- 无生硬阴影

风格：
- 整洁 + 俏皮 + 略带不完美感
- 具有人情味、温暖且富有创意

约束条件：
- 请勿过度拥挤
- 每个涂鸦必须有目的或互动
- 保持主体清晰可见（无遮挡）
- 保持呼吸感

氛围：
[愉快 / 好奇 / 轻松 / 富有想象力]

添加一致的视觉签名：
- 所有设计采用相同的涂鸦风格
- 相同的强调色系统
- 重复出现的微小角色

引入一个在每个构图中与不同主体互动的“主要涂鸦角色”。

保持系列构图的一致性：
- 相同的构图
- 相同的间距逻辑
- 相同的排版风格

目标：
使设计能够被立即识别为系列的一部分。

items.title: 高端日韩街头时尚蓝底摄影

prompts.text:
Create image Create a high-end studio fashion portrait inspired by the uploaded blue-background reference photograph. Recreate the original composition with matching framing, focal length feel, camera position, subject scale, perspective, and overall visual balance while maintaining a realistic photographic appearance.

Replace the reference model with a beautiful young Japanese/Korean woman. Preserve authentic East Asian facial features, natural proportions, realistic skin texture, eye shape, facial structure, and cultural authenticity. Avoid exaggerated beauty filters, unrealistic facial modifications, or doll-like features. Maintain a natural, believable fashion-model appearance.

Match the original body language closely: upper torso visible, shoulders relaxed, chin slightly elevated, eyes directed upward beyond the camera, conveying quiet confidence, sophistication, and contemplation. Maintain the same sense of presence and spatial positioning within the frame.

Retain the rich cobalt-blue studio backdrop and the refined editorial atmosphere. Reproduce the original lighting setup with soft directional illumination, subtle facial highlights, realistic reflections on eyewear and jewelry, and smooth shadow transitions around the jawline, neck, and clothing folds. Preserve depth, dimensionality, and professional studio realism.

Appearance:

Young Japanese/Korean woman in her early-to-mid 20s

Clear luminous skin with natural texture

Soft almond-shaped eyes

Elegant facial structure

Healthy natural makeup with subtle editorial refinement

Glossy neutral lips

Long dark hair styled in soft layers or gentle waves

Sophisticated yet approachable expression

Style the model in contemporary luxury street-fashion apparel. Use an oversized premium knit sweater, relaxed-fit sweatshirt, or fashion-forward minimalist streetwear silhouette with natural fabric draping. Layer with a delicate silver necklace, subtle rings, and lightly tinted translucent eyewear. Wardrobe should feel premium, modern, and suitable for a luxury fashion campaign.

Keep the image tightly composed with the same portrait crop and subject placement. Ensure identical camera-to-subject distance and visual weight in the frame. The final result should feel indistinguishable from a genuine professional fashion photoshoot captured in this exact studio environment.

Photorealistic editorial photography, luxury fashion campaign, premium Korean/Japanese streetwear styling, deep monochromatic blue backdrop, realistic skin texture, subtle film-grade contrast, detailed fabric rendering, natural lighting falloff, commercial advertising quality, shallow depth of field, magazine-cover aesthetics, fashion-editorial realism, luxury street-fashion branding.

Negative Prompt:

Do not alter the background color or studio environment. Do not change the framing, crop, perspective, subject distance, or lighting direction. Avoid anime styling, illustration effects, CGI appearance, excessive retouching, artificial skin smoothing, exaggerated facial features, unrealistic eye size, porcelain skin effect, text overlays, logos, watermarks, duplicate subjects, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, or unrealistic clothing physics.

prompts.text:
创建图像 参考上传的蓝底参考照片，创作一张高端影棚时尚肖像。重现原始构图，匹配取景、焦距感、相机位置、主体比例、透视和整体视觉平衡，同时保持真实的摄影外观。

将参考模型替换为一位美丽的年轻日韩女性。保留地道的东亚面部特征、自然比例、真实的皮肤纹理、眼睛形状、面部结构和文化真实性。避免夸张的美颜滤镜、不真实的面部修改或娃娃般的特征。保持自然、可信的时尚模特外观。

紧密匹配原始肢体语言：上半身可见，肩膀放松，下巴微扬，眼睛向上注视相机上方，传达出安静的自信、精致和沉思。在画面内保持相同的存在感和空间定位。

保留浓郁的钴蓝色影棚背景和精致的编辑氛围。重现原始照明设置，采用柔和的有向照明、细微的面部高光、眼镜和珠宝上真实的反射，以及下颌线、颈部和衣物褶皱处平滑的阴影过渡。保持深度、维度和专业的影棚真实感。

外观：

20岁出头的年轻日韩女性
清透明亮的皮肤，带有自然纹理
柔和的杏仁形眼睛
优雅的面部结构
带有细微编辑精致感的健康自然妆容
润泽的中性唇色
修剪成柔软层次或轻微波浪的长黑发
精致而亲切的表情

为模特搭配当代奢侈街头时尚服饰。使用超大号高级针织毛衣、宽松卫衣或具有自然面料垂坠感的前卫极简街头服饰轮廓。搭配精致的银色项链、细微的戒指和浅色透明眼镜。服装应具有高级感、现代感，并适用于奢侈时尚大片。

保持图像构图紧凑，采用相同的肖像裁剪和主体位置。确保相同的相机到主体距离和画面视觉权重。最终结果应与在这种特定影棚环境下拍摄的真实专业时尚摄影作品无异。

逼真编辑摄影，奢侈时尚大片，高级韩式/日式街头风造型，深单色蓝色背景，真实皮肤纹理，细微电影级对比度，细腻面料渲染，自然光衰减，商业广告质量，浅景深，杂志封面美学，时尚编辑真实感，奢侈街头时尚品牌。

负面提示词：

不要更改背景颜色或影棚环境。不要更改取景、裁剪、透视、主体距离或光照方向。避免动漫风格、插图效果、CGI外观、过度修图、人造皮肤平滑、夸张的面部特征、不真实的眼睛大小、瓷肌效果、文本叠加、徽标、水印、重复主体、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的肢体或不真实的服装物理效果。

Generate a 9:16 realistic pure desire style female lifestyle photo. 

The main subject is a 20–28-year-old young adult Oriental woman, with natural and clear Oriental female characteristics, not overly Westernized, not appearing too old, and with no sense of being a minor. The overall temperament of the character is cold, restrained, private, storytelling, and "pure desire," while presenting quietness, softness, restraint, and clear female attractiveness. She does not have an internet celebrity face, nor is it an overly retouched photo face, but rather like a young woman in real life who is quiet, clean, and natural, yet possesses clear physical attractiveness. 

The character's facial features direction is "cold and elegant." The face shape is a narrow oval or slightly long oval face, with clean and sharp facial contours; the eye shape is a slightly slender apricot eye or a reserved phoenix eye feeling, with clear and quiet eyes and a slight sense of distance; the nose shape is delicate and straight, and the lip shape is natural and restrained. Since the character stands in front of a mirror with her back to the camera, her face is mainly presented through the faint reflection in the floor-to-ceiling mirror; therefore, the profile in the mirror needs to maintain a clear but restrained cold recognition. The overall facial features must be pure, clean, natural, and real, not internet-celebrity-like, not mask-like, and not infantile. 

The character's body shape direction is a sense of waist-back-hip curves, with a medium intensity of physical attractiveness. The overall proportions are realistic and coordinated, with smooth and soft back lines, natural transitions between shoulders and waist/back, faintly visible back dimples, good waist-to-hip ratio, and the overall body contour has clear female attractiveness and a soft, natural S-curve. Focus on highlighting the back of the neck, shoulder line, scapula, back dimples, and waist-to-hip ratio, but it must remain restrained, realistic, and clean, not vulgar, and not intentionally sexualized. 

The overall style is a cinematic lifestyle still feeling, namely realistic sensual lifestyle portrait / naturalistic intimate portrait / cinematic everyday body portrait. The image is like a minimalist, clean, and restrained realistic pure desire lifestyle photo, real, soft, and quiet, with a slight private space atmosphere and clear physical attractiveness, but it is not erotic photography, not cheap fetish style, not studio blockbuster, and not CG or AI illustration style. 

The scene is set in a real private cloakroom. The image includes a floor-to-ceiling mirror, warm white lights inside the cabinet, and a half-open wardrobe. The environment is clean, simple, and restrained, with traces of life but not cluttered. The half-open wardrobe and the mirror surface together create a sense of private space, making the character's back and waist-hip lines the visual focus. 

The clothing is a black silk backless camisole top and grey low-rise triangle shorts, with the back significantly exposed. The overall material should be simple, real, and textured. The black silk top emphasizes the shoulder and back lines and the backless structure, and the grey low-rise shorts naturally reflect the waist-to-hip ratio and low-rise contour. The overall clothing must be tight-fitting, restrained, and clean, not vulgar, not cheap, not exaggerated, and not fetishized. 

The pose adopts the character standing in front of the mirror with her back to the camera, one hand tidying her hair, and her face faintly visible in the mirror. The character stands naturally, with her center of gravity slightly shifted, one side of her hip slightly relaxed, shoulders and neck stretched out, the back of the neck naturally exposed, the shoulder line and scapula clear but soft, the waist and back naturally tucked in, and the back dimples and waist-to-hip ratio faintly appearing. The movements are simple and stable, not complicated, not high-difficulty posing, and not intentionally sexualized. 

The lighting atmosphere is soft cool white main light + warm white spot light inside the cabinet. The overall image uses soft cool white main light to maintain a cold, low-contrast, and transparent base. The warm white spot light inside the cabinet serves as a local atmospheric supplement, slightly outlining the edges of the hair, back contour, mirror frame, and wardrobe layers, making the image feel more like a lifestyle still and a private emotional mood. The shadows are soft, the edges of the body curves are clear but not too hard, and the skin retains realistic and delicate texture and a slight soft glow. 

The whole applies a cool white pure desire lifestyle photo filter + a slight sense of private life. The image uses a system of low-saturation cool white, soft grey-white, light beige-grey, and clean skin tones. The overall look is minimalist, restrained, transparent, and quiet. Do not use high-saturation warm yellow, do not use obvious cyan-orange grading, and do not use vintage color shifts. The whole highlights the cold facial features, back, and waist-hip curves, as well as the quiet atmosphere in the private space of the cloakroom. 

The lens is at eye level or slightly looking down, using a 50mm or 35mm real photography perspective to avoid ultra-wide-angle distortion. The composition uses the back view of the character and the faint face in the mirror as the main subject of the image, highlighting the back, waist-back, and waist-hip lines, while ensuring that the character's facial features and body proportions are realistic and coordinated, and the structures of arms, fingers, legs, and joints are natural and accurate.

prompts.text:
Transform the uploaded photo into a whimsical childhood sketchbook illustration, as if lovingly drawn by a creative child using wax crayons, colored pencils, and playful marker doodles. Preserve the original pose, composition, clothing, expressions, and overall scene layout while reimagining everything through a charming handmade art style.

Convert the subjects into adorable storybook-style characters with oversized expressive eyes, rosy cheeks, simple facial features, and joyful childlike proportions. Use layered crayon strokes, rough pencil textures, visible scribbles, imperfect outlines, and intentionally uneven coloring on textured sketchbook paper.

Recreate the environment with imaginative childlike interpretation: fluffy doodle clouds, colorful rolling hills, playful trees, sparkling lakes, hand-drawn flowers, and whimsical details that feel like pages from a treasured children's art journal. Add small doodles such as stars, hearts, birds, swirls, and smiling suns scattered naturally around the scene.

Color palette should be vibrant, cheerful, and nostalgic, featuring rich crayon colors, soft pastel accents, and warm handmade textures. Maintain a clean composition while embracing the imperfect charm of authentic children's artwork.

Include a small rounded-corner "memory snapshot" inset of the original photo in the bottom-right corner, framed with a white hand-drawn border, subtle paper shadow, and scrapbook-style placement, making it feel like a keepsake pasted onto the page.

Style: luxury children's book illustration, handmade sketchbook aesthetic, premium crayon artwork, playful storytelling, textured paper surface, colorful scribble art, heartwarming nostalgic mood, ultra-detailed handcrafted appearance.

Negative Prompt: photorealism, realistic skin textures, digital painting look, smooth vector art, CGI rendering, dark colors, horror elements, messy composition, blurry details, low resolution, harsh shadows, oversaturated neon colors, artificial plastic textures.

prompts.text:
将上传的照片转换为异想天开的童年素描本插图，就像是由一个富有创造力的孩子用蜡笔、彩色铅笔和俏皮的马克笔涂鸦精心绘制而成。在保留原始姿势、构图、服装、表情和整体场景布局的同时，通过迷人的手工艺术风格重新构思一切。

将主体转换为可爱的故事书风格角色，拥有夸张的表现力大眼睛、红润的脸颊、简单的面部特征和充满喜悦的童趣比例。在有质感的素描纸上，使用分层的蜡笔笔触、粗糙的铅笔纹理、可见的乱涂乱画、不完美的轮廓以及故意涂抹不均匀的上色。

用富有想象力的童趣解读重新创造环境：蓬松的涂鸦云朵、五彩斑斓的起伏山丘、俏皮的树木、闪烁的湖泊、手绘的花朵，以及感觉像是珍藏的儿童艺术日记页面的奇幻细节。在场景周围自然地散布星星、爱心、小鸟、漩涡和微笑的太阳等小涂鸦。

配色方案应充满活力、愉悦且令人怀旧，以浓郁的蜡笔色彩、柔和的粉彩点缀和温暖的手工纹理为特色。在保持干净构图的同时，拥抱真实儿童艺术作品不完美的魅力。

在右下角包含一个带圆角的原始照片“记忆快照”插图，配有白色手绘边框、细微的纸张阴影和剪贴簿风格的摆放，使其感觉像是贴在页面上的纪念品。

风格：奢华儿童读物插图、手工素描本美学、优质蜡笔艺术作品、俏皮的叙事、有质感的纸张表面、色彩斑斓的乱涂艺术、温馨怀旧的情绪、超精细的手工外观。

负向提示词：写实主义、真实的皮肤纹理、数字绘画感、平滑的矢量艺术、CGI渲染、暗色调、恐怖元素、混乱的构图、模糊的细节、低分辨率、刺眼的阴影、过饱和的霓虹色、人造塑料纹理。

items.title: 品牌新店开业预告高清商业海报

prompts.text:
Please generate a vertical high-definition commercial poster with the theme [Brand New Store Opening Teaser Poster]. 
Note: This is a single independent poster, not a four-grid, do not collage. If making a series, please generate each image independently.

[Basic Information]
Brand Name: [Brand Name]
Brand Type: [Coffee Shop / Light Food Shop / Bakery / Milk Tea Shop / Flower Shop / Fragrance Shop / Nail Salon / Pet Living Hall / Bookstore Cafe / Other]
Store Name: [Store Name]
Main Title Copy: [OPENING SOON / COMING SOON / GRAND OPENING / Soon to Open / New Store Opening]
Subtitle: [City Name + Store Name]
Opening Date: [Date]
Address Information: [Full Address]
Top Left Small Text: [Brand Keywords]
Top Right Small Text: [Brand Philosophy / Auxiliary Phrase]

[Visual Style]
The overall visual should present a [Creamy Style / Minimalist / Light Luxury / Gentle / High-end / Clean / Strong Brand Sense] commercial visual style, like a new store opening poster released by a real brand, not a common renovation rendering, nor a cheap promotional advertisement. The image should have a strong sense of brand, social media shareability, and lifestyle brand temperament.

[Color Setting]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Auxiliary Color: [Auxiliary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
The overall colors are low-saturation, soft and unified, clean and restrained, do not use too many colors, and do not make it excessively vivid. The background is mainly based on cream white, off-white, light khaki, warm gray, light wood color, etc., or it can be replaced with low-saturation palettes like matcha green, cherry blossom pink, mist gray-blue, or caramel brown based on the brand type.

[Background Requirements]
Keep the background clean and simple, with slight paper texture, faint grain, soft gradients, and high-end white space. The background should not be complex, not cluttered, without large areas of pattern stacking, and should have a brand poster and light magazine feel.

[Main Visual]
Place a fully visible high-quality 3D store space rendering main visual in the center of the screen. The space format is [Street-side Store / Mall Counter / Pop-up Kiosk / Island Store / Flagship Store Facade / Community Small Shop]. 
The storefront must clearly display the brand name [Brand Name]. 
The interior or exterior of the space may include: cash register, display cabinets, product displays, light boxes, windows, counters, shopping bags, signature drinks / bread / bouquets / fragrance / product props, etc., matching the [Brand Type]. 
Materials must be realistic, including [Light Wood Grain / Stone / Micro-cement / Glass / Metal / Acrylic / Warm Light Strips], etc. 
The overall needs to have real commercial space proportions, real perspective, delicate materials, real lighting and shadows, and architectural visualization-level texture. It should not look like a toy model, should not be cartoonish, and should not be an illustration.

[Typography Structure]
The overall layout adopts brand poster style typography, with a clear structure and sufficient white space. 
Place the brand logo / brand name [Brand Name] in the top middle. 
Place [Top Left Small Text] in the top left corner and [Top Right Small Text] in the top right corner. 
Enlarge the main title copy [Main Title Copy] in the upper middle area. The title needs to be clear, grand, and have a sense of design, using high-end serif or modern bold sans-serif styles. 
Place the [Subtitle] below the title. 
The middle part highlights the main visual of the store space. 
The [Opening Date] is clearly displayed below. 
Address information is placed at the bottom: ADD: [Address Information]. 
Clear reading path: Brand Name → Opening Title → Store Name → Store Main Visual → Date → Address.

[Image Texture]
The overall should look like a warm-up poster released by a real brand, high-definition and exquisite, with strong commercial design sense, real 3D rendering feel, soft lighting, clear materials, and professional typography, suitable for use on Xiaohongshu, Public Accounts, WeChat Moments, brand social media, investment proposals, and store opening publicity.

[Adaptation Suggestions]
If it's a coffee shop: can add coffee machines, takeout cups, dessert displays. 
If it's a light food shop: can add salad bowls, fruit and vegetable displays, freezers. 
If it's a bakery: can add croissants, baguettes, cake cabinets, bread trays. 
If it's a flower shop: can add bouquets, flower buckets, window displays. 
If it's a fragrance shop: can add candles, perfumes, diffuser bottles, scent testing stations. 
If it's a nail salon: can add front desk, nail tables, display walls, soft light mirrors.

[Output Requirements]
Output one complete vertical poster, ratio is [4:5 / 3:4 / 9:16]. 
Recommendation: Prioritize 4:5. 
Please ensure the store is fully visible, text layout is clear, visuals are unified, and the brand sense is strong. 
If making a series, please maintain the same layout logic, but generate each image independently, do not merge them.

[Avoidance Items]
Avoid spelling errors, avoid logo deformation, avoid messy store structures, avoid spatial perspective errors, avoid low resolution, avoid plastic-like materials, avoid messy colors, avoid cartoon style, avoid illustration style, avoid cheap e-commerce feel, avoid promotional poster feel, avoid excessive decoration, avoid toy model feel.

prompts.text:
请生成一张竖版高清商业海报，主题是【品牌新店开业预告海报】。  
注意：这是单张独立海报，不是四宫格，不要拼图。如果要做系列，请每张图片独立生成。

【基础信息】
品牌名：【品牌名】
品牌类型：【咖啡店 / 轻食店 / 烘焙店 / 奶茶店 / 花店 / 香氛店 / 美甲店 / 宠物生活馆 / 书店咖啡 / 其他】
门店名称：【门店名称】
主标题文案：【OPENING SOON / COMING SOON / GRAND OPENING / 即将启幕 / 新店开业】
副标题：【城市名 + 门店名】
开业日期：【日期】
地址信息：【完整地址】
顶部左侧小字：【品牌关键词】
顶部右侧小字：【品牌理念 / 辅助短语】

【视觉风格】
整体画面要呈现【奶油系 / 极简 / 轻奢 / 温柔 / 高级 / 干净 / 品牌感强】的商业视觉风格，像真实品牌即将发布的新店开业海报，而不是普通装修效果图，也不是廉价促销广告图。画面要有强品牌感、社媒传播感、生活方式品牌气质。

【色彩设定】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
点缀色：【点缀色】
整体色彩低饱和、柔和统一、干净克制，不要五颜六色，不要过度鲜艳。背景以奶油白、米白、浅卡其、暖灰、浅木色等体系为主，也可以根据品牌类型替换为抹茶绿、樱花粉、雾灰蓝、焦糖棕等低饱和配色。

【背景要求】
背景保持干净简洁，有轻微纸张肌理、淡淡纹理、柔和渐变和高级留白。背景不要复杂，不要杂乱，不要大面积图案堆砌，要有品牌海报感和轻杂志感。

【主视觉】
画面中心放置一个完整可见的高质量 3D 门店空间渲染主视觉，空间形式为【街边门店 / 商场柜台 / 快闪亭 / 岛台店 / 旗舰店外立面 / 社区小店】。  
门头要清晰显示品牌名【品牌名】。  
空间内部或外部可包含：收银台、展示柜、产品陈列、灯箱、橱窗、吧台、包装袋、招牌饮品 / 面包 / 花束 / 香薰 / 产品道具等，内容要和【品牌类型】匹配。  
材质要真实，包括【浅木纹 / 石材 / 微水泥 / 玻璃 / 金属 / 亚克力 / 暖光灯带】等。  
整体需要有真实商业空间比例、真实透视、细腻材质、真实光影、建筑可视化级别质感，不要像玩具模型，不要卡通，不要插画。

【排版结构】
整体采用品牌海报式排版，结构清晰，留白充足。  
顶部中间放品牌 logo / 品牌名【品牌名】。  
顶部左上角放【顶部左侧小字】，右上角放【顶部右侧小字】。  
中上方放大号标题【主标题文案】，标题需要清晰、大气、有设计感，可以使用高级衬线体或现代粗体无衬线风格。  
标题下方放【副标题】。  
中部重点展示门店空间主视觉。  
下方明显展示【开业日期】。  
底部放地址信息：ADD: 【地址信息】。  
阅读路径清晰：品牌名 → 开业标题 → 门店名称 → 门店主视觉 → 日期 → 地址。

【画面质感】
整体要像真实品牌发布的开业预热海报，高清精致，商业设计感强，真实 3D 渲染感，柔和光线，材质清晰，排版专业，适合小红书、公众号、朋友圈、品牌社媒、招商提案、门店开业宣传使用。

【适配建议】
如果是咖啡店：可以加入咖啡机、外带杯、甜品展示。  
如果是轻食店：可以加入沙拉碗、果蔬展示、冷柜。  
如果是烘焙店：可以加入可颂、法棍、蛋糕柜、面包托盘。  
如果是花店：可以加入花束、花桶、橱窗陈列。  
如果是香氛店：可以加入蜡烛、香水、扩香瓶、试香台。  
如果是美甲店：可以加入前台、美甲桌、展示墙、柔光镜面。

【输出要求】
输出一张完整的竖版海报，比例为【4:5 / 3:4 / 9:16】。  
推荐优先使用 4:5。  
请确保门店完整可见，文字排版清晰，视觉统一，品牌感强。  
如果做系列，请保持同一套版式逻辑，但每张图独立生成，不要合并。

【避免项】
避免文字拼写错误，避免 logo 变形，避免门店结构混乱，避免空间透视错误，避免低清晰度，避免塑料感材质，避免颜色杂乱，避免卡通风，避免插画风，避免廉价电商感，避免促销海报感，避免过度装饰，避免玩具模型感。

THE MURALIST

8 SHOTS · BOLD · EXPRESSIVE · ALIVE

→ Wall discovered — muralist stands before massive blank wall, eyes wide with creative vision
→ Sketching the concept — marker flies across paper thumbnail, bold confident composition forming
→ Grid transfer — chalk grid drawn on wall, design scaled up with precision and energy
→ Base colors blocked in — large roller applies bold background color in sweeping dramatic strokes
→ Main figures painted — large brush strokes bring central figures to life, bold and expressive
→ Detail and linework — fine brush adds crisp outlines, expressions, intricate detail layers
→ Final color pops — brightest accent colors added last, mural suddenly vibrating with energy
→ Mural complete — muralist steps back, crowd has gathered, everyone staring up in pure awe

LIGHT & STYLE: bright outdoor daylight, electric cobalt blues, vibrant yellows, deep magentas, bold greens, crisp whites, shallow depth of field, Pixar explosive vivid colors

prompts.text:
Create a museum-quality handcrafted 3D paper-collage botanical travel poster of [CITY/LOCATION], [COUNTRY], reimagined as a dreamy [BOTANICAL THEME] garden paradise.

CORE CONCEPT
Represent the [seasonal/cultural] spirit of [LOCATION] through its famous [botanical features], charming garden atmosphere, and 2-3 iconic botanical elements. Each overlapping [leaf/petal/plant element] creates a distinct paper-cut layer, emphasizing the natural depth of botanical collage art.

STYLE
- Minimal pastel paper-collage illustration
- Layered paper-cut artwork with emphasis on overlapping [botanical elements]
- Paper diorama aesthetic with subtle 3D relief
- Flat geometric color shapes with clean silhouettes
- Soft tactile paper texture, visible paper grain, matte gouache finish
- Gentle cut-paper shadows
- Storybook botanical-poster mood
- Premium editorial illustration
- Whimsical garden atmosphere
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO glossy rendering

COMPOSITION
- Wide landscape or portrait format
- Large open pastel sky (35-45% of composition)
- Clear foreground, midground, background layers
- Generous breathing space, balanced negative space
- Relaxed, elegant, cheerful composition (never overcrowded)

FOREGROUND (35-40% of composition)
Place 2-3 representative botanical features as primary subjects:

[BOTANICAL FEATURE 1] = [Main flower/plant field with overlapping layered petals/leaves]
[BOTANICAL FEATURE 2] = [Garden market stall/greenhouse/structure with botanical displays]
[BOTANICAL FEATURE 3] = [Secondary botanical element - herb garden/tree grove/water feature]

Add location-specific garden objects:
- [Cultural garden items: e.g., flower market stall, garden tools, pottery, bicycle, watering cans, benches, etc.]

MIDGROUND
Create simplified [location]-themed botanical garden environment:
- Winding garden pathways
- Layered paper trees with seasonal foliage
- Tiny paper people (families, couples, children, gardeners)
- Festival bunting
- Decorative fences
- Waterways if appropriate
Keep all elements minimal, graphic, clean, paper-crafted

BACKGROUND
Feature simplified paper-cut versions of:
[PRIMARY LANDMARK] = [Main iconic landmark]
[SECONDARY LANDMARKS] = [Supporting landmarks - 2-4 items]

Landmarks should support the botanical narrative without dominating
Keep architecture elegant, simplified, instantly recognizable

SKY
- Large pastel sky
- 2-5 simple paper clouds
- Tiny paper birds/butterflies
- Optional small paper elements floating
- Calm, airy, cheerful atmosphere

COLOR PALETTE
Base colors:
soft sky blue, warm cream, light beige, off-white, powder mint, sage green, dusty coral, soft peach, pale stone gray, butter yellow

Plus location-specific accent colors:
[CITY ACCENT COLORS] = [3-5 signature colors of the location]

BOTANICAL COLORS
Use soft garden-inspired pastel tones (never hyper-saturated)
Keep colors refined, nostalgic, editorial
Each petal/leaf is a separate paper layer with visible edges

TYPOGRAPHY
Upper-left corner:
[CITY NAME in English]
Below: [Local Language Name] · [English Name]
Below: [Botanical Garden Series Title]

White geometric sans-serif typography
Wide letter spacing, minimal, elegant, poster-like

DOODLE TEXT
Add 3-5 small handwritten white doodle captions naturally integrated:
Examples: "[Greeting]!", "Hello [City]!", "[Botanical element] Dreams!", "[Season/Theme] Magic!", "Bloom Day!"

Use playful handwritten white doodle style
Keep doodles small, airy, charming (not overcrowded)

LIGHTING
Bright soft [time of day] daylight
Warm ambient illumination
Clean atmosphere, soft shadows, gentle paper depth
Optimistic [season/mood] garden mood

MOOD
dreamy, collectible, travel-inspired, cultured, optimistic, whimsical, refined, premium, editorial, botanical, nostalgic, family-friendly

AVOID
photorealism, crowded garden scenes, heavy outlines, advertisements, brand logos, watermarks, neon colors, dark lighting, messy details,

风格
- 极简柔和色调纸拼贴插图
- 强调重叠 [植物元素] 的分层剪纸艺术
- 带有微妙 3D 浮雕的纸质透视模型美学

- 大面积开阔的柔和天空（占构图的 35-45%）
- 清晰的前景、中景、背景层

前景（占构图的 35-40%）

[植物特征 1] = [具有重叠分层花瓣/叶子的主要花卉/植物田]

- [文化花园物品：例如，花卉市场摊位、园艺工具、陶器、自行车、浇水罐、长椅等]

中景
创建简化的以 [地点] 为主题的植物园环境：
- 蜿蜒的花园小径
- 带有季节性树叶的分层纸树
- 微型纸人（家庭、情侣、儿童、园丁）
- 节日旗帜
- 装饰性围栏
- 如果合适，加入水道
保持所有元素极简、图形化、整洁、纸艺感

背景
包含以下元素的简化剪纸版本：
[主要地标] = [主要标志性地标]
[次要地标] = [辅助地标 - 2-4 个项目]

地标应支持植物叙事而不占主导地位
保持建筑优雅、简化、辨识度高

天空
- 大面积柔和天空
- 2-5 朵简单的纸云
- 微型纸鸟/蝴蝶
- 可选的小型漂浮纸元素
- 平静、通风、愉悦的氛围

调色板
基础色：
柔和天蓝色、暖奶油色、浅米色、乳白色、粉薄荷色、鼠尾草绿、尘土珊瑚色、柔和桃色、淡石灰色、黄油黄

加上特定地点的点缀色：
[城市点缀色] = [地点的 3-5 种招牌颜色]

植物颜色
使用柔和的花园灵感柔和色调（绝不高度饱和）
保持颜色精致、怀旧、社论感
每个花瓣/叶子都是一个边缘可见的独立纸层

排版
左上角：
[城市名称 英文]
下方：[当地语言名称] · [英文名称]
下方：[植物园系列标题]

白色几何无衬线字体
宽间距，极简，优雅，海报风格

涂鸦文本
添加 3-5 个自然融合的小型手写白色涂鸦标题：
例如："[问候语]!"、"你好 [城市]!"、"[植物元素] 之梦!"、"[季节/主题] 魔法!"、"绽放日!"

使用俏皮的手写白色涂鸦风格
保持涂鸦微小、轻盈、迷人（不拥挤）

光照
明亮的柔和 [一天中的时间] 日光
温暖的环境照明
洁净的氛围，柔和的阴影，温和的纸张深度
乐观的 [季节/情绪] 花园心情

情绪
梦幻、收藏级、旅行启发、有文化底蕴、乐观、奇异、精致、高端、社论感、植物感、怀旧、家庭友好

避免
照片写实、拥挤的花园场景、粗重轮廓、广告、品牌徽标、水印、霓虹色、阴暗光线、凌乱细节

Clothing elements can revolve around: white tennis skirts, pleated short skirts, white sports vests, cropped polos, tennis dresses, yellow V-neck knitted sweaters, white sports jackets, headbands, wristbands, white socks, vintage tennis shoes. The facial expressions, gazes, angles, camera positions, and actions of the 8 images must be significantly different and not repetitive. Actions should be natural with a snapshot feel, including swinging a racket, sitting, lying down, leaning on the net, throwing a ball, looking back, walking, close-up styling, etc. Body proportions, fingers, limbs, and racket structures must be normal and realistic.

05 | Lying Contrast Shot

High-angle shot, body naturally stretched, one hand holding a tennis ball, the other hand resting on the racket. Full-body or seven-tenths composition, like a moment of being called out to, real snapshot feel, relaxed and bright.

items.title: 清晨酒店房间内整理头发的生活感随拍

prompts.text:
## Creative Direction

### Overall Tone
A casual social media photo taken in a hotel room in the early morning right after waking up.

### Reason for Shooting
Woke up in the morning, about to re-tie hair, saw the beautiful natural light by the window, so took a photo to post on social media Stories.

### Image Style
Daily snapshot, mobile phone photo texture.

### Subject Type
A fashion selfie full of life.

### Constraints
- Adult female.
- No explicit sexual suggestions.
- No AI portrait look.
- No excessive skin retouching.

## Mood
- Quiet morning.
- Slightly sleepy.
- An atmosphere of not being fully awake in a travel hotel.

## Person
- Adult female in her late twenties.
- Original face.
- Does not imitate specific real people.
- Natural body shape.
- Realistic body proportions.

## Facial Expression
- Slightly lowered head, a somewhat sleepy expression.
- Relaxed corners of the mouth.
- Not a deliberate smile, but a hazy, relaxed expression from just waking up in the morning.

## Hairstyle
- Chin-length dark brown bob.
- Hair ends slightly flipped out after waking up.
- Forehead bangs slightly resting against the cheeks.
- Due to humidity and being messy from sleep, the hair is completely unstyled, looking naturally messy.

## Body and Pose
- Do not directly emphasize body parts.
- The upper body silhouette is naturally formed through the sitting posture and the drape of the fabric.
- Sitting on the bed, one knee slightly raised.
- Upper body leaning slightly to the side.
- Arms raised, in the middle of re-tying hair.
- Therefore, natural tension is created between the shoulders and the top's fabric.
- The posture causes natural indentations in the fabric.
- Body silhouette naturally formed by gravity, sitting posture, and fabric drape.

## Skin
- Skin that is not excessively smooth.
- Cheeks and shoulders have a slight natural flush after just waking up in the morning.
- Maintain natural pore texture.
- Avoid the plastic-looking skin common in AI-generated images.

## Clothing
- Light cream loose camisole top.
- Thin cotton texture.
- No cleavage exposure.
- Conveys a real sense of three-dimensionality through fabric drape and natural wrinkles.
- A white hotel bedsheet lightly draped around the waist.
- Exposure level remains within the range of natural casual wear.

## Accessories
- Simple thin chain necklace.
- Small stud earrings.
- Phone charging cable by the bed.

## Scene Objects
- White hotel bed.
- Slightly messy bedsheets.
- Curtains by the window.
- Bedside table.
- A half-drunk plastic water bottle.
- A hair tie that has been taken off.
- A tote bag slightly peeking out from the morning luggage.

## Pose
- Sitting on the bed.
- Both hands in the middle of re-tying hair.
- Not paying much attention to the camera.
- Gaze slightly downward.
- Not a perfect model pose, but a feeling of being accidentally captured while getting ready in the morning.

## Lighting
- Morning window light.
- Soft natural light seeping in from the right window.
- Interior shadows are slightly dark.
- White bedsheets reflect the light.
- Face and shoulders have elegant reflected light.
- Slightly overexposed near the window, with minor highlight clipping.

## Image Effects
- Natural mobile phone HDR effect.
- Slight soft focus.
- Texture of a social media image after compression.
- Highlights near the window are slightly overexposed.

## Camera and Shooting Method
- Shot with a mobile phone's rear camera.
- Shot by a friend from the bedside in a vertical composition.
- Has the look of a standard mobile phone lens, close to a 35mm equivalent perspective.
- Shooting distance is somewhat close.
- A subtle sense of perspective between the shoulders and the bedsheets.
- Not a studio shoot.
- Natural shooting height of a handheld mobile phone.

## Realistic Flaws
- Composition is slightly tilted.
- The edge of the bedsheet is cropped unevenly.
- Hair is a bit messy.
- Slight out-of-focus around the hands.
- Slight highlight clipping at the window edges.

## Background
- Simple hotel white walls.
- Large window.
- The view outside the window is almost invisible due to overexposure.
- The area around the bed has a slight lived-in feel, but is not messy or dirty.

## Overall Atmosphere
- A sense of tranquility on the morning after traveling.
- Sleepy.
- Faint light from outside the window seeping into the room.
- A preparation atmosphere of simply tidying oneself up before heading out.

## Composition
- Vertical mobile phone photo.
- The face, arms, top, bedsheets, and window light appear naturally and coherently in the frame.
- The image does not just crop a part of the body; it must include the face, movement, and the hotel room context.
- The visual flow is:
    - Slightly messy bedsheets → sitting posture → arms tidying hair → slightly lowered head expression.

## Exclusions
- No AI portrait look.
- No excessive skin retouching.
- No plastic skin.
- No explicit sexual suggestions.
- No deliberate sexy poses.
- No excessive emphasis on body parts.
- Do not only crop body parts.
- No studio feel.
- No commercial photography feel.
- No over-sharpening.
- No overly perfect hairstyle.
- No overly retouched skin.
- Do not let the image look like an advertisement or an AI-generated image.

prompts.text:
## 创作方向

### 整体基调

清晨的酒店房间内，一张刚睡醒后随手拍下的社交平台照片。

### 拍摄缘由

早上醒来，正准备重新扎头发时，看到窗边的自然光很美，于是拍了一张准备发到社交平台限时动态里的照片。

### 影像风格

日常随手快照，手机照片质感。

### 题材类型

生活感十足的时尚自拍。

### 限制条件

- 成年女性。
- 无露骨性暗示。
- 无人工智能写真感。
- 无过度皮肤修饰。

## 情绪

- 宁静的早晨。
- 略带睡意。
- 旅行地酒店中尚未完全清醒的氛围。

## 人物

- 二十多岁后半的成年女性。
- 原创面容。
- 不模仿特定现实人物。
- 自然体型。
- 现实的身体比例。

## 面部神态

- 微微低头，略显困倦的表情。
- 嘴角放松。
- 不是刻意微笑，而是早晨刚醒时朦胧、放松的神态。

## 发型

- 下巴长度左右的深棕色波波头。
- 睡醒后发尾微微外翘。
- 前额刘海稍稍搭在脸颊边。
- 因为湿度与睡乱的原因，头发完全没有整理，显得自然凌乱。

## 身体与姿态

- 不直接强调身体部位。
- 通过坐姿与布料自然垂落形成上半身轮廓。
- 坐在床上，单膝微微抬起。
- 上身略向侧边倾斜。
- 手臂抬起，正处在重新扎头发的途中。
- 因此肩部与上衣布料之间产生自然张力。
- 姿势导致布料产生自然压痕。
- 身体轮廓由重力、坐姿和布料垂落自然形成。

## 肌肤

- 不过度光滑的肌肤。
- 脸颊与肩部带一点早晨刚醒后的自然红润。
- 保留自然毛孔感。
- 避免人工智能生成图常见的塑料感皮肤。

## 服装

- 浅奶油色宽松吊带上衣。
- 薄棉质地。
- 胸口不露骨。
- 通过布料垂落与自然褶皱传达真实的立体感。
- 腰间轻披白色酒店床单。
- 暴露度保持在自然休闲服饰范围内。

## 配饰

- 细链简约项链。
- 小巧耳钉。
- 床边手机充电线。

## 场景物件

- 白色酒店床铺。
- 稍乱的床单。
- 窗边窗帘。
- 床头桌。
- 喝了一半的塑料水瓶。
- 取下来的发圈。
- 早晨行李中稍微露出的托特包。

## 姿势

- 坐在床上。
- 双手正处在重新扎头发的途中。
- 不太在意镜头。
- 视线略微向下。
- 不是完美的模特姿势，而是早晨打扮途中偶然被拍到的感觉。

## 光线

- 早晨窗光。
- 柔和的自然光从右侧窗户渗入。
- 室内阴影稍暗。
- 白色床单反射光线。
- 脸部与肩部带有淡雅的反射光。
- 窗边稍微过曝，有轻微白飞。

## 影像效果

- 自然的手机 HDR 效果。
- 轻微柔焦。
- 社交平台图片压缩后的质感。
- 窗边高光轻微过曝。

## 相机与拍摄方式

- 手机后置摄像头拍摄。
- 由朋友从床边以纵向构图拍摄。
- 具有手机标准镜头的观感，接近三十五毫米等效视角。
- 拍摄距离稍近。

prompts.text:

The camera is positioned slightly above the subject from a first-person perspective, looking down at a close diagonal angle. Do not make it a flat top-down shot. The image should clearly show the subject’s face, hair, shoulders, neckline, upper body posture, hands, and the bouquet interaction.

A young adult East Asian woman stands on a quiet night street, near a sidewalk, street corner, convenience store entrance, or wet asphalt road. She is gently holding a bouquet being offered from the camera’s point of view. Her head is slightly lowered, but her eyes softly look up toward the lens, as if she has just received the flowers. Her expression should feel quiet, emotional, natural, and slightly heart-fluttering, not overly posed or exaggerated.

She has natural black hair with soft volume and realistic loose strands. Some hair falls around her face, shoulders, and neckline, creating natural layers and a candid street-photo feeling. Her facial features are soft and refined, with clear eyes, natural skin texture, subtle highlights on the cheeks, nose bridge, lips, and collarbone area. Keep the skin realistic and luminous, not plastic or overly retouched.

Outfit: refined summer styling with a light sleeveless top, camisole, halter top, square-neck knit top, or an open thin shirt layered over a simple inner top. The outfit should create an elegant neckline and shoulder structure, with natural adult proportions and a tasteful feminine silhouette. Pair it with high-waisted jeans or dark trousers. The styling should feel clean, modern, cinematic, and non-vulgar.

Bouquet: place a bouquet in the lower foreground, occupying about 18% to 25% of the frame. Use flowers such as red roses, white roses, pink tulips, or purple lisianthus, wrapped in translucent cream, white, black, or soft-toned floral paper. The bouquet should feel close to the camera, but it must not block the subject’s face, hands, or main body posture.

Lighting: warm street lights, convenience store light, car headlights, or mixed night lighting softly illuminate her face, eyes, hair edges, shoulders, hands, outfit texture, and the bouquet. Add subtle catchlights in the eyes. The wet asphalt or dark pavement should have soft reflections, creating a cinematic night atmosphere. Use low-saturation warm tones, gentle contrast, slight film grain, and realistic smartphone photography texture.

Composition: close high-angle diagonal POV, slight wide-angle perspective, natural handheld framing, centered subject, bouquet in the foreground, emotional eye contact as the visual focus. The image should feel like a candid first-person moment, not a staged studio portrait.

Style: highly realistic, cinematic night street photography, real smartphone photo quality, intimate first-person interaction, soft emotional tension, natural hair, realistic skin, detailed fabric texture, clear bouquet material, clean background, premium but understated.

Negative prompt: no smoking, no cigarette, no alcohol, no exaggerated sexy pose, no vulgar styling, no overexposure, no plastic skin, no excessive retouching, no distorted face, no deformed body, no unnatural proportions, no extra fingers, no broken hands, no messy background, no crowd, no readable text, no watermark, no logo, no anime, no illustration, no CGI look.

prompts.text:
Create a cinematic fashion editorial photograph in a bright minimal bedroom, presented as a cinematography composition analysis frame.

Main Image: A young adult female model kneeling on a soft white bed beside a large window with sheer white curtains. She is positioned on the left third of the frame, body aligned with the vertical rule-of-thirds grid line. Her body leans slightly backward, facing toward the glowing window light with a calm, distant, introspective expression. The right side of the image is filled with a large bright white luminous mass from overexposed daylight through sheer curtains, balancing the darker subject on the left.

Lighting: Strong natural window light from the right side creates high contrast on the model’s face, upper body, waist, and silhouette. Add subtle secondary fill light from the left side to reveal shadow areas without flattening the contrast. Warm hazy morning atmosphere, soft highlights, realistic skin texture, gentle shadows, soft bloom near the curtains.

Composition Overlay: Add visible cinematography composition guide graphics over the image, like a film school analysis frame.

Include:
- Rule of thirds grid lines in thin green.
- A red vertical line showing the model’s body aligned on the left rule of thirds grid.
- Green circular focus markers around:
  1. Waist and hip area as Focus Point 1.
  2. Face area as Focus Point 2.
  3. Bright curtain/window mass as Focus Point 3.
- Yellow eye-trace arrows moving from the face to the waist/hip, then toward the glowing window.
- Red leading-line arrows following the bed edge and wall panel lines toward the main focus point.
- A cyan arrow showing secondary fill light coming from the left side.
- Text labels placed cleanly around the frame:
  “Body aligned on the grid of thirds”
  “High contrast Focus Point 2”
  “Eye Trace”
  “Focus Point 3”
  “High contrast Focus Point 1”
  “Secondary light source for dark parts”
  “Lines lead to the main focus point”
  “The white mass is aligned on the grid of thirds to balance the left side of the image”

Style: Luxury fashion editorial photography, soft cinematic realism, warm beige and white color palette, minimal bedroom, cream wall panels, white bedding, sheer curtains, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, elegant composition, educational cinematography breakdown overlay.

Camera: 35mm lens, medium wide framing, eye level camera angle, 16:9 widescreen.

prompts.text:
Please generate a 9:16 vertical original Oriental fashion illustration, with the theme [Theme Name]. Overall style fusion: Modern Oriental Haute Couture, Chinese ink wash, pale watercolor, delicate calligraphic lines, rice paper white space, high-end fashion poster feel. The visual temperament should be [Temperament Keywords: such as Ethereal / Cold and Elegant / Light Luxury / Elegant / Dynamic / Quiet / Modern Oriental].

【1. Character Setting】
The subject is a slender and elegant Oriental woman with exquisite features and a calm expression, possessing the muse temperament of a high-end fashion illustration. The hairstyle is [Hairstyle: such as Low Bun / Half-tied Hair / Structured Updo / Soft Bun], with a small amount of natural loose strands. The posture is [Posture: such as Sitting / Standing Quietly / Looking Back / Lightly Dancing / Turning / High Fashion Standing Pose], with the composition maintaining sufficient breathing space, not too crowded.

【2. Clothing Setting】
The clothing is an original New Chinese Haute Couture gown, modern Oriental long dress, or high-end fashion inspired by Qipao. The overall silhouette is slender, light, and flowing, including [Clothing Elements: such as Translucent Gauze Layers / Ribbons / Water Sleeves / Trailing Hem / High Collar / Slits / Structured Waistline / Asymmetric Cut]. The main clothing color is [Main Clothing Color Palette: such as Moon White + Light Mist Blue-Grey + Soft Gold / Ink Black + Deep Indigo + Cold White / Celadon Green + Jade White + Light Silver / Rice White + Low-saturation Cinnabar Red + Light Gold]. The clothing naturally merges with Oriental imagery, which includes [Main Imagery: such as Moon Ring / Water Ripples / Flower Shadows / Feathers / Cranes / Clouds / Mountain Mists / Silk Ribbons / Wind Traces]. These imageries should be integrated into the hem, trailing train, shawl layers, background atmospheric layers, and local details, rather than being rigid decorations.

【3. Stockings Setting】
The legs are paired with ultra-thin, translucent, misty, and light high-end stockings; the material is delicate and skin-hugging, with a soft and restrained micro-luster, not heavy, not high-gloss, and not cheap-looking. The stocking color is [Stocking Color: such as Moon White Grey / Smoky Black Grey / Light Mist Blue Grey / Pale Celadon Grey / Ivory Grey / Deep Indigo Grey]. The surface of the stockings features very restrained precision patterns, such as [Stocking Pattern: such as Ultra-fine Gold Thread Water Ripples / Flower Petal Line Art / Feather Veins / Vine Secret Patterns / Moon Patterns / Cloud Patterns / Light Ink Gradient / Cinnabar Fine Line Patterns]. The stockings should naturally blend into the overall clothing and ink style, highlighting the slender feeling of the legs and the exquisite sense of fashion, but must not overshadow the main subject, nor have a vulgar photorealistic feel.

【4. Lines and Details】
Overall lines should be thin, light, and exquisite. The main contours use ink lines with a brush calligraphy feel, featuring slight thickness variations, 'flying white' (fei-bai), brush strokes, and elegant flow. Locally add restrained precision details, such as: fine gold lines, light silver lines, edge outlines, feather veins, petal textures, fine water ripples, translucent gauze overlapping shadows, slight embroidery secret patterns, and internal fold lines. Requirement: Looks light and transparent from afar, with details upon close inspection.

【5. Background and White Space】
The background uses [Background Base Color: such as Light Warm White / Rice White / Rice Paper White / Cold White]. Do not use pure dead white; it should have extremely subtle rice paper textures, light mist feel, pale ink atmospheric layers, and slight light-dark transitions, achieving 'white but not empty.' Retain a large amount of white space; do not crowd the background, and do not make the frame too full.

【6. Ink Wash Performance】
The ink wash parts should be free-spirited but controlled, with primary and secondary elements, thickness and light shades, smudging, flying white edges, and white space interspersing. Do not be messy or disorganized, do not clump into a large messy mass, and do not have a heavy splashed-ink feel.

【7. Overall Requirements】
The entire image should look like a high-end Oriental fashion visual poster, combining precision details with ink wash charm. The visual should be exquisite, elegant, modern, light luxury, Oriental, and artistic. Do not include text, signatures, logos, watermarks, or copyright information. Do not copy existing works. Do not use thick lines, do not have a cheap costume feel, do not have excessive patterns, do not be overly realistic, and do not have an overcrowded background. Generate each image independently, do not merge them.

整体廓形修长、轻盈、流畅，包含【服装元素：如 半透明纱层 / 飘带 / 水袖 / 拖尾 / 高领 / 开衩 / 结构化腰线 / 不对称剪裁】。  
服装主色为【服装主配色：如 月白 + 浅雾蓝灰 + 柔金 / 墨黑 + 深靛蓝 + 冷白 / 青瓷绿 + 玉白 + 浅银 / 米白 + 低饱和朱砂红 + 浅金】。  
服装与东方意象自然融合，意象包括【主意象：如 月环 / 水波 / 花影 / 羽毛 / 仙鹤 / 云气 / 山岚 / 丝带 / 风痕】。  
这些意象应融入衣摆、拖尾、披层、背景气层和局部细节中，而不是生硬装饰。

【3. 丝袜设定】  
腿部搭配极薄、半透明、雾感轻盈的高级丝袜，材质细腻贴肤，带柔和而克制的微光泽，不厚重、不高亮、不廉价。  
丝袜颜色为【丝袜颜色：如 月白灰 / 烟黑灰 / 浅雾蓝灰 / 淡青灰 / 象牙灰 / 深靛灰】。  
丝袜表面带有非常克制的精工纹样，例如【丝袜纹样：如 极细金线水波纹 / 花瓣线稿 / 羽毛脉络 / 藤蔓暗纹 / 月纹 / 云纹 / 淡墨渐变 / 朱砂细线纹】。  
丝袜要自然融入整体服装与水墨风格，突出腿部修长感和时装精致感，但不能喧宾夺主，也不要艳俗写真感。

【4. 线条与细节】  
整体线条要细、轻、精致，主体轮廓使用带毛笔书法感的墨线，具有轻微粗细变化、飞白、收笔和优雅走势。  
局部加入克制的精工细节，例如：细金线、淡银线、衣缘描边、羽毛脉络、花瓣纹理、水波细纹、透明纱层叠影、轻微刺绣暗纹和内部褶皱线条。  
要求远看轻盈通透，近看有细节。

【5. 背景与留白】  
背景使用【背景底色：如 浅暖白 / 米白 / 宣纸白 / 冷白】。  
不要纯死白，要带有极轻微的宣纸纹理、淡雾感、浅水墨气层和轻微明暗过渡，做到“白而不空”。  
保留大量留白，不要背景拥挤，不要画面太满。

【6. 水墨表现】  
水墨部分要洒脱但受控，有主次、有浓淡、有晕染、有飞白边缘、有留白穿插。  
不要脏乱无序，不要大面积糊成一团，不要厚重泼墨感。

【7. 整体要求】  
整张图要像一张高级东方时装视觉海报，兼具精工细节与水墨气韵。  
画面要精致、优雅、现代、轻奢、东方、艺术感。  
不要出现文字、签名、logo、水印、版权信息。  
不要照搬已有作品。  
不要粗线条、不要廉价戏服感、不要过度花纹、不要过度写实、不要背景太满。  
每张图片独立生成，不要合并。

男士穿着一件超大号的校队风格夹克，叠穿在合身的白色T恤外面，搭配宽松的工装裤、潮流运动鞋、手表和斜挎旅行包。女士穿着一件时尚的超大号飞行员夹克、阔腿牛仔裤、时尚运动鞋、层搭配饰和一顶休闲帽。两人都有着自然的微笑，兴奋地看着对方，仿佛在讨论他们的下一个目的地。
在每个人身边都站着一个可爱的微缩3D卡通版自己。这些小人物拥有夸张的富有表现力的眼睛、高级动画电影的品质、与现实生活中的本人高度匹配的极其详尽的服装，以及迷人的皮克斯风格比例。这对迷你情侣正在嬉戏互动——指着一张微型旅行地图，为他们自己的微型旅程做准备。
两只可爱的柯基幼犬陪伴在场景中，每只都背着微小的旅行背包。一只小狗坐在微型情侣附近，而另一只则兴奋地望向列车站台。行李、护照夹、相机配件和目的地贴纸等小型旅行道具增添了叙事细节。
主题：“冒险开始”。构图强调陪伴、探索和共同发现世界的兴奋。奢华街头时尚摄影融合温馨的动画同伴，电影般的黄金时段照明，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，高级服装细节，真实的旅行氛围，鲜艳的色彩，专业的社论造型，超详细的纹理，高端商业活动美学，动态叙事，8K超高清，杂志封面品质，清晰聚焦，全身构图。

prompts.text:
Please generate a set of "Dark New Chinese High-end Portraits" based on the clear single-person portrait reference image I uploaded, a total of 9 images, all in 3:4 vertical composition, must generate 9 separate images individually, no nine-grid, no collage, no poster layout.

## Character Consistency
Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the reference person: face shape, facial features proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, hairline, skin tone, age feeling, temperament, and overall recognizability. 
No face-swapping, no becoming a stranger, no internet celebrity face, no anime style, no plastic doll face. 
The reference image is only used for character identity; do not retain the coffee shop, daily clothes, paper cups, or daily life scenes from the original photo.

## Overall Style
Dark New Chinese, black-gold Oriental aesthetics, gold foil bamboo shadow screens, dark red carpets, night cinematic feel, high-end fashion magazine blockbusters. 
The visual should be cold and glamorous, restrained, dangerous, noble, with a sense of Oriental suspense. 
The background is mainly gold foil textured screens, bamboo leaf projections, black gold borders, dark brown, and dark red transitions. No large areas of dead black, no flat painted gold, there must be mottled textures, light spots, and layers.

## Makeup, Hair, and Clothing
Hairstyle: New Chinese high bun or low bun, with relaxed loose hairs, the bun embellished with red hairpins, dark red flower decorations, or fine hairpins. 
Makeup: Cold and glamorous fashion makeup, upturned black eyeliner, clear eyelashes, slight smoky eyeshadow, clean base makeup, nose bridge highlights, deep red-brown or wine-red lip color. 
Clothing: Black lace improved cheongsam, stand collar, frog buttons, cinched waist, high slit, lace dark patterns, clear jacquard texture. Can expose neck and shoulders, arms, and leg lines, but must be high-end and restrained, not vulgar. 
Accessories: Black gold folding fan, slender black gold tobacco pipe, gold geometric earrings, gold bracelets, red hairpins, few but exquisite.

## Lighting and Texture
High-budget studio photography texture, combined with warm gold hard light, side light, back light, rim light, and local fill light. 
Facial features must be clear, eyes must be bright, black clothing cannot be dead black, lace, dark patterns, folds, and edge highlights must be visible. 
Preserve real skin texture, real body structure, real fabric, and real light and shadow. 
No oil painting feel, no illustration feel, no 3D modeling feel, no AI excessive skin smoothing feel. 
Natural character proportions, correct hand structure, no deformed limbs.

---

## 01 | Full-body Opening with Gold Foil and Bamboo Shadows
Full-body standing posture, character standing in front of a gold foil bamboo shadow screen, body slightly sideways, one leg naturally extended from the black high-slit cheongsam, wearing black stilettos. One hand lightly touching the screen frame, the other hand hanging naturally or lightly on the waist. Looking at the camera, eyes cold, detached, and oppressive. Warm gold hard light + side rim light, background has bamboo shadows and dark red-brown transitions.

## 02 | Near-shot with Black Gold Folding Fan Covering Face
Half-body to 3/4 body composition. Character holding a black gold embroidered folding fan, the fan half-opened, lightly covering the lower half of the face, revealing only clear, cold, and glamorous eyes. Eyes staring directly at the camera, cold, sober, slightly provocative. Fan gold threads, fan ribs, and black lace cheongsam details are clear. Face softly brightened, background bamboo shadow hard light.

## 03 | Cold and Glamorous Close-up with Tobacco Pipe
Upper body close-up. Character holding a slender black gold tobacco pipe, the pipe lightly against the lips or chin, elegant and restrained movement, no exaggerated smoke. She looks slightly away from the camera, expression cold and detached, as if having secret thoughts. Side warm gold hard light creates the light and shadow relationship of the face, lip color is deep red-brown, lace collar and frog buttons are clear.

## 04 | Sitting Pose with Folding Fan
Character sitting on a dark red carpet or low seat, body leaning slightly back, one leg naturally bent, holding a large black gold embroidered folding fan in her hands, the fan horizontal across the chest or knees. Eyes looking at the camera, cold with a sense of distance. Emphasize the lines of the neck and shoulders, collarbone, arms, and legs, pose is high-end, not vulgar. Background is a gold foil bamboo shadow screen.

## 05 | Side Profile Looking Back with Tobacco Pipe
Medium-shot side profile standing posture. Character's body is sideways to the camera, face looking back at the camera, one hand holding a slender black gold tobacco pipe near the neck and shoulder, the other hand lightly on the waist. The cheongsam emphasizes the waistline, hip line, and side slit design. Foreground can have a blurred black screen frame, forming foreground, middle ground, and background layers. Back-side light outlines the face, shoulder line, and waistline.

## 06 | Emotional Shot Leaning Against Wall with Head Down
Character near a gold foil bamboo shadow wall, one hand lightly touching the wall or screen frame, the other hand hanging naturally. She lowers her head slightly, not looking at the camera, eyes looking down or to the side-down, expression quiet, cold, with a bit of fatigue and a sense of story. The overall feel is like a movie still, not sexy provocation. Warm light from behind + soft fill light on the face, black cheongsam retains details.

## 07 | Strong Light Oppressive Standing Pose
Full-body strong aura standing posture. Character standing in the center of the gold foil bamboo shadow screen, body leaning slightly back, one hand on the waist or lightly holding a black gold folding fan, the other hand hanging naturally. She stares directly at the camera, not smiling, eyes sober, sharp, and oppressive. Frontal controlled key light + left side strong hard light + background bamboo shadow projection, the image is like a high-end fashion cover candidate.

## 08 | Low Angle Leg Line Shot
Slightly low angle, 3/4 body to full-body composition. One leg naturally extended from the cheongsam slit, the other leg supporting steadily, body in a slight S-shape transition. One hand holding a black gold tobacco pipe hanging by the side, the other hand touching the wall or raised near the neck and shoulder. Expression cold and detached, natural body proportions, do not over-lengthen. Strong warm light from behind + side rim light.

## 09 | Cover-level Closing Shot
Formal, minimalist, strong cover-level closing photo. Character standing in the center of the black gold bamboo shadow background, being the unique visual center. One hand holding a black gold embroidered folding fan hanging by the leg, the other hand lightly on the waist or naturally relaxed. Staring directly at the camera, eyes calm, restrained, with a strong sense of self-control. Main frontal light + side rim light + background bamboo shadow hard light, with delicate transitions between black, gold, dark brown, and dark red.

## Unified Prohibitions
Don't generate nine-grid, don't generate collage, no text, no watermark, no logo. 
No dead black background, no cheap studio style, no AI doll face, no oil painting feel, no illustration feel, no 3D feel. 
No extra characters, no deformed fingers, no strange limbs, no excessive lengthening of the body.

prompts.text:
请基于我上传的清晰单人人像参考图，生成一组「暗黑系新中式高级写真」，共 9 张，全部为 3:4 竖构图，必须分别生成 9 张单独图片，不要九宫格，不要拼图，不要海报排版。

## 人物一致性
严格保留参考人物本人的真实身份特征：脸型、五官比例、眼睛形状、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、发际线、肤色、年龄感、气质和整体辨识度。  
不能换脸，不能变成陌生人，不能网红脸，不能动漫化，不能塑料娃娃脸。  
参考图只用于人物身份，不要保留原照片里的咖啡店、日常衣服、纸杯或生活场景。

## 整体风格
暗黑新中式、黑金东方美学、金箔竹影屏风、暗红地毯、夜色电影感、高级时尚杂志大片。  
画面要冷艳、克制、危险、贵气，有东方悬疑感。  
背景以金箔质感屏风、竹叶投影、黑金边框、深棕、暗红过渡为主。不能大片死黑，不能平涂金色，必须有斑驳肌理、光斑和层次。

## 妆发服装
发型：新中式高盘发或低盘发，带松弛碎发，发髻点缀红色发簪、暗红花饰或细发钗。  
妆容：冷艳时尚妆，上扬黑色眼线、清晰睫毛、微烟熏眼影、干净底妆、鼻梁高光、深红棕或酒红唇色。  
服装：黑色蕾丝改良旗袍，立领、盘扣、收腰、高开衩、蕾丝暗纹、提花纹理清晰。可以露肩颈、手臂和腿部线条，但必须高级克制，不低俗。  
配饰：黑金折扇、细长黑金烟杆、金色几何耳环、金色手镯、红色发簪，少而精。

## 光影与质感
高预算棚拍质感，暖金硬光、侧光、逆光、轮廓光、局部补光结合。  
脸部五官必须清晰，眼神要亮，黑色服装不能死黑，要看见蕾丝、暗纹、褶皱和边缘高光。  
保留真实皮肤纹理、真实身体结构、真实布料和真实光影。  
不要油画感、插画感、3D 建模感、AI 过度磨皮感。  
人物比例自然，手部结构正确，四肢不要畸形。

---

## 01｜金箔竹影全身开场图
全身站姿，人物站在金箔竹影屏风前，身体微侧，一条腿从黑色高开衩旗袍中自然伸出，脚穿黑色细高跟。一只手轻扶屏风边框，另一只手自然垂落或轻扶腰侧。看向镜头，眼神冷静、疏离、有压迫感。暖金硬光 + 侧轮廓光，背景有竹影和暗红深棕过渡。

## 02｜黑金折扇遮面近景图
半身到 3/4 身构图。人物手持黑金刺绣折扇，折扇半展开，轻遮下半张脸，只露出清晰冷艳的眼神。眼神直视镜头，冷淡、清醒、略带挑衅。折扇金线、扇骨、黑色蕾丝旗袍细节清晰。面部柔和提亮，背景竹影硬光。

## 03｜烟杆冷艳特写
上半身近景特写。人物手持细长黑金烟杆，烟杆轻靠唇边或下巴，动作优雅克制，不要夸张烟雾。她微微偏视镜头外，表情冷淡疏离，像有隐秘心事。侧面暖金硬光打出脸部明暗关系，唇色深红棕，蕾丝领口和盘扣清晰。

## 04｜折扇坐姿造型图
人物坐在暗红地毯或低矮座位上，身体微微后靠，单腿自然曲起，手中抱着一把大号黑金刺绣折扇，折扇横在胸前或膝前。眼神看向镜头，冷淡有距离感。突出肩颈、锁骨、手臂和腿部线条，姿态高级，不低俗。背景为金箔竹影屏风。

## 05｜侧身回望烟杆图
中景侧身站姿。人物身体侧向镜头，脸部回望镜头，一只手持细长黑金烟杆横在肩颈附近，另一只手轻扶腰侧。旗袍强调腰线、臀线和侧开衩设计。前景可有虚化黑色屏风边框，形成前景、中景、背景层次。逆侧光勾勒脸部、肩线和腰线。

## 06｜靠墙低头情绪图
人物靠近金箔竹影墙面，一只手轻触墙面或屏风边框，另一只手自然垂下。她微微低头，不看镜头，眼神向下或侧下方，表情安静、冷淡，带一点疲惫和故事感。整体是电影剧照感，不是性感挑逗。背后暖光 + 面部柔和补光，黑色旗袍保留细节。

## 07｜强光压迫感站姿图
全身强气场站姿。人物站在金箔竹影屏风中央，身体略微后靠，一只手扶腰或轻握黑金折扇，另一只手自然垂落。她直视镜头，不笑，眼神清醒、锋利、有压迫感。正面控制面光 + 左侧强硬光 + 背景竹影投射，画面像高级时尚封面候选图。

## 08｜低机位腿部线条图
略低机位，3/4 身到全身构图。人物一条腿从旗袍开衩中自然伸出，另一条腿稳定支撑，身体轻微 S 形转折。一只手持黑金烟杆垂在身侧，另一只手轻触墙面或抬至肩颈附近。表情冷淡疏离，身体比例自然，不要过度拉长。背后强暖光 + 侧面轮廓光。

## 09｜封面级收束图
正式、极简、强烈的封面级收束照。人物站在黑金竹影背景中央，是唯一视觉中心。一只手持黑金刺绣折扇垂于腿侧，另一只手轻扶腰间或自然放松。直视镜头，眼神冷静、克制、自我掌控感强。主面光 + 侧轮廓光 + 背景竹影硬光，黑、金、深棕、暗红之间有细腻过渡。

## 统一禁止
不要九宫格，不要拼图，不要文字，不要水印，不要 logo。  
不要死黑背景，不要廉价影楼风，不要 AI 娃娃脸，不要油画感，不要插画感，不要 3D 感。  
不要多余人物，不要畸形手指，不要奇怪四肢，不要过度拉长身体。

prompts.text:

prompts.text:
Ultra-premium black-and-white editorial fashion collage featuring a stunning young woman whose facial features, identity, and likeness are faithfully preserved from the reference image. Only her facial structure, eyes, lips, and distinctive beauty are retained; her hairstyle, makeup, wardrobe, pose, and styling are completely transformed.

She appears alongside a handsome young European man with captivating blue eyes, sharp jawline, elegant facial features, and charismatic presence. The couple radiates intense chemistry, sophistication, and romantic tension.

The woman wears a luxurious European-inspired fashion ensemble: an oversized tailored black blazer draped elegantly over a fitted white silk corset-style top, paired with a sleek high-waisted skirt featuring a tasteful slit. Her styling includes glamorous soft waves, glossy hair, luminous skin, sculpted makeup, smoky eyes, defined lashes, subtle contouring, and natural glossy lips. Modern high-fashion jewelry accents complete the look.

The man wears a refined luxury office-inspired suit: tailored black trousers, fitted black waistcoat, crisp white shirt partially unbuttoned at the collar, sleeves casually rolled up, luxury watch, elegant styling, polished yet effortlessly attractive. His appearance is sophisticated, chic, masculine, and editorial-fashion worthy.

Multiple artistic compositions arranged across a dramatic torn-paper collage layout on a deep black background:

• Intimate close-up portrait with foreheads nearly touching
• Romantic seated pose on the floor with relaxed body language
• Genuine laughter and affectionate embrace
• Standing face-to-face with intense eye contact

prompts.text:
PASTEL PAPER-COLLAGE STYLE META PROMPT

Create a refined wide landscape illustration of Pakistan, naturally featuring Faisal Mosque as the main recognizable visual anchor.

CORE STYLE:
Depict Pakistan as a calm, elegant, highly stylized scene in a toned-down pastel paper-collage poster style. The scene should feel minimal, clean, poetic, modern, cultured, leisurely, and softly cheerful rather than realistic.

COMPOSITION:
Use a spacious horizontal composition. Place Faisal Mosque as the central focus, clearly recognizable through its iconic triangular tent-like architecture and soaring minarets rising above the layered landscape. Surround it with simplified representations of the Margalla Hills, Hunza Valley mountains, Badshahi Mosque silhouettes, Lahore Fort elements, traditional villages, winding rivers, terraced fields, and regional cultural details. Reinterpret everything in highly stylized illustrated forms using clean geometric shapes, layered color planes, soft curves, crisp silhouettes, and paper-like cutout forms. Avoid photorealism.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
Include minimal charming details: tiny strolling figures, cyclists, traditional market scenes, colorful trucks, boats on the Indus River, flowering trees, grazing animals, and small architectural accents inspired by Pakistan's diverse regions. Use a calm open sky with generous breathing space and clean horizontal layered divisions suggesting depth and atmosphere.

COLOR PALETTE (Toned-Down Pastels):
Soft sky blue, hazy blue-gray, pale cobalt, muted sage green, powder mint, warm cream, light beige, pale stone gray, dusty coral, soft peach, muted yellow, off-white, with subtle accents of emerald green, turquoise, terracotta, and deep navy inspired by Pakistani art, textiles, and landscapes.

TACTILE QUALITY:
The image should feel tactile and handmade, like carefully arranged colored paper and gouache-painted poster board. Add subtle paper grain, matte printed texture, soft raised edges, delicate embossing, slight cut-paper shadows, and gentle surface roughness. Keep the surface refined and minimal, not messy.

VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Minimal paper collage, pastel travel poster, flat graphic shapes, subtle 3D paper relief, clean silhouettes, simplified architecture, soft matte texture, crisp color fields, gentle shadows, minimal linework, refined editorial illustration, modern South Asian cultural poster mood. Wide landscape format, balanced negative space, strong graphic layering, clear focal area, simplified zones arranged harmoniously, airy, composed, and visually restful.

LIGHTING & MOOD:
Bright soft daylight, clean atmosphere, gentle shadows, warm relaxed tone, cultured and optimistic mood, quiet and sophisticated travel-poster feeling.

TYPOGRAPHY (Upper-left corner):
Main title "PAKISTAN" in geometric uppercase sans-serif font with wide letter-spacing, solid white color. Below: smaller native text "پاکستان · Pakistan" and English subtext "Faisal Mosque & Northern Landscapes", all in matching white, left-aligned, thin stroke weights with airy spacious tracking.

AVOID:
Photorealism, realistic photography, over-detailed buildings, heavy outlines, messy brushwork, neon cyberpunk style, dark gloomy lighting, excessive gradients, crowded scenes, readable signage, logos, watermarks.

FINAL RESULT:
A polished minimal pastel paper-collage landscape illustration of Pakistan, with Faisal Mosque as the main recognizable visual anchor, featuring tactile paper texture, soft shadows, clean geometric color blocking, generous negative space, and a refined modern travel-illustration mood that celebrates the country's natural beauty, cultural heritage, mountains, rivers, and iconic architecture.

prompts.text:
粉彩纸质拼贴风格元提示词

创建一张精致的巴基斯坦宽画幅风景插画，自然地以费萨尔清真寺作为主要的视觉锚点。

核心风格：
将巴基斯坦描绘成一个宁静、优雅、高度风格化的场景，采用色调柔和的粉彩纸拼贴海报风格。场景应具有极简、干净、诗意、现代、人文、休闲且轻快愉悦的感觉，而非写实风格。

构图：
使用宽广的横向构图。将费萨尔清真寺作为中心焦点，通过其标志性的三角形帐篷式建筑和矗立在层叠景观之上的尖塔清晰可辨。周围环绕着马尔加拉山脉、洪扎山谷山脉、巴德夏希清真寺剪影、拉合尔古堡元素、传统村庄、蜿蜒的河流、梯田和区域文化细节的简化表现。使用简洁的几何形状、分层的色彩平面、柔和的曲线、清晰的剪影和类纸质剪裁形式，将一切重新演绎为高度风格化的插画形式。避免写实。

视觉元素：
包含极简而迷人的细节：散步的微小人物、骑行者、传统的市场场景、色彩鲜艳的卡车、印度河上的船只、开花的树木、放牧的动物以及灵感来自巴基斯坦不同地区的微小建筑点缀。使用平静开阔的天空，留出充足的呼吸空间，并使用清晰的横向分层划分来暗示深度和氛围。

调色板（淡雅粉彩）：
柔和的天蓝色、朦胧的蓝灰色、浅钴蓝、淡雅的鼠尾草绿、粉末薄荷绿、温暖的奶油色、浅米色、浅石灰色、灰珊瑚色、柔和的桃红、淡黄色、乳白色，并带有受巴基斯坦艺术、纺织品和景观启发的翡翠绿、青绿色、赤陶色和深海军蓝的细微点缀。

触觉质量：
图像应具有触感和手工制作感，就像精心排列的彩色纸张和水粉画海报板。添加细微的纸张纹理、哑光印刷纹理、柔软的凸起边缘、精致的压花、轻微的剪纸阴影和温和的表面粗糙感。保持表面精致简约，不杂乱。

视觉语言：
极简纸拼贴、粉彩旅游海报、扁平几何形状、细微的3D纸张浮雕、清晰的剪影、简化的建筑、柔和的哑光纹理、干脆的色域、柔和的阴影、极简的线条、精致的编辑插画、现代南亚文化海报氛围。宽画幅格式、平衡的负空间、强烈的图形层叠、清晰的焦点区域、和谐排列的简化区域、通透、沉稳且视觉舒适。

光影与氛围：
明亮的柔和日光、明净的氛围、温和的阴影、温暖轻松的色调、充满人文气息且乐观的情绪、安静而精致的旅行海报感。

排版（左上角）：
主标题“PAKISTAN”采用几何大写无衬线字体，字间距宽，纯白色。下方：较小的母语文字“پاکستان · Pakistan”和英文副标题“Faisal Mosque & Northern Landscapes”，全部采用匹配的白色，左对齐，细线条，字间距疏朗。

避免：
写实主义、写实摄影、过度细节化的建筑、厚重的轮廓线、凌乱的笔触、霓虹赛博朋克风格、阴暗沉闷的光效、过度的渐变、拥挤的场景、可读的标牌、徽标、水印。

最终效果：
一张打磨精美的极简粉彩纸拼贴巴基斯坦风景插画，以费萨尔清真寺为主要视觉锚点，具有触觉纸张纹理、柔和阴影、洁净的几何色块、充足的留白，以及一种精致现代的旅游插画氛围，颂扬该国的自然之美、文化遗产、山脉、河流和标志性建筑。

她靠近窗户站立，身体呈自然的四分之三侧面轮廓，面向相机约 60 到 75 度。她轻轻抬起双手整理散落的头发。她的长深色头发垂下，柔软且自然蓬松，略微凌乱且写实。头发必须具有连贯流动的发锁，从发根到发梢连续的流向，自然的层叠发束，真实的密度和连接的发丝。额头、脸颊和发际线附近可以出现少量细碎的婴儿毛发和微妙的散发，但头发必须保持连接且可信，具有重量感和流动感。没有断裂的漂浮发线，没有随机的黑色笔触，没有截断的发丝。

prompts.text: High-fidelity, true-to-source facial replication. Maintain 100% of the original person's facial likeness and identity from the provided user image. The user's original photo is for identity reference ONLY. You MUST replace the original pose, clothing, and background with the new style described below. Apply the following style: A four-panel photo grid collage arranged in a 2x2 layout, resembling a candid black and white photo booth sequence. The overall composition should be tailored for a 3:4 portrait aspect ratio. The photography style is high-contrast black and white studio photography. Crucially, the final image must be a clean, sharp, high-resolution rendering with minimal to no digital noise or film grain. The background in all four panels is a seamless, solid, medium-grey studio backdrop. The lighting across all panels is a harsh, direct, on-camera frontal flash. This creates bright, stark highlights on the facial features and hair, while casting sharp, distinct, opaque black shadows immediately behind the subject onto the grey backdrop. Apply a slender body build with well-defined collarbones to the subject. The hair is dark, medium-length, wavy, heavily tousled, and messy with significant volume. The skin tone appears high-key and fair due to the grayscale and flash. The makeup features structured, dark eyebrows, heavily mascaraed eyelashes, and a dark, matte lip color. In all panels, the subject is wearing a strapless garment that leaves the shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest entirely exposed to the camera frame. A delicate, thin metallic chain necklace is worn around the base of the neck. You must place the person from the user's photo into each of these four panels, changing their pose and expression as follows: Top-left panel: A close-up shot where the subject is angled slightly away, looking back over their left shoulder toward the camera with a heavily scrunched, playful smile and eyes squeezed tightly shut; hair falls heavily to the left, exposing the right neck and shoulder, and the necklace is not visible. Top-right panel: A straight-on close-up portrait; the subject stares intensely directly at the lens while bringing both hands to their face, using the index and middle fingers to pull horizontally outward from the outer corners of both eyes; hair is parted in the middle, and the necklace is visible. Bottom-left panel: A straight-on close-up portrait; the subject looks directly at the camera with an exaggerated, asymmetrical frowning pout, lower lip pushed out, and shoulders relaxed down; the necklace is visible. Bottom-right panel: A straight-on close-up portrait; the subject has both arms raised with hands behind the back of the head, index fingers pointing straight up to mimic horns; the expression is a quirky, wide-eyed grimace with the mouth pulled sharply to one side; inner arms are visible due to the raised posture, and the necklace is visible.
