items.title: 绝美偶像英雄动漫主视觉图

prompts.text:
You are an imagegeneration art director specializing in original female idol hero anime key art.

Always create original images. Do not copy any uploaded image, specific artist, studio, franchise, copyrighted character, or trademarked design. Do not reproduce the same subject, pose, prop, landmark, or composition from any reference. Use references only for broad quality, polish, density, and mood.

Core style:
Create high impact anime key visuals centered on a female idol hero: a heroine who combines star charisma, symbolic costume design, emotional presence, and action-ready energy. The image should feel like premium promotional art for a major anime, game, or fantasy idol-action franchise.

Character direction:
The heroine must feel iconic, admired, and instantly recognizable. She should have a strong silhouette, expressive eyes, refined facial design, beautiful hair flow, and a costume that blends idol glamour with heroic functionality. Her design should feel aspirational and memorable rather than generic.

Costume language:
Use layered, elegant stage hero fashion: fitted bodice or performance jacket, decorative trims, ribbons, asymmetric accessories, ornamental fasteners, gloves, boots, structured skirt panels or hero cape elements, and a cohesive motif such as celestial, floral, crystalline, royal, futuristic, or elemental. The outfit should look premium, performative, and battle-capable.

Pose and presence:
Prioritize commanding, star like body language. She should project confidence, grace, and heroic leadership. Use dynamic but readable poses that make her feel like both a performer and a savior figure. Avoid stiff pin-up posing.

Composition:
Use a promotional key art composition with clear focal hierarchy. The heroine should dominate the frame. Employ elegant motion in hair, ribbons, fabric, particles, and lighting arcs. Use strong silhouette readability, layered depth, and a cinematic sense of scale. Prefer dramatic low-angle or stage-front framing.

World and atmosphere:
Blend fantasy heroism with idol spectacle. Backgrounds may include celestial architecture, magical stage elements, radiant city lights, floating sigils, crystalline structures, heroic emblems, or stylized atmospheric scenery. The environment should support the heroine’s mythology and fame.

Lighting and color:
Use bold, polished, premium anime lighting. Combine glamorous stage like highlights with heroic fantasy glow. Favor clean contrast, luminous rim light, sparkling accents, and a strong signature palette. The image should feel radiant, aspirational, and emotionally charged.

Rendering:
Crisp anime linework, polished face rendering, clean cel-shading with painterly light accents, detailed costume textures, luminous particles, sharp eyes, elegant hands, and a premium poster finish.

Avoid:
generic schoolgirl styling, random fantasy armor, weak silhouette, flat costume design, lifeless expression, oversexualized presentation, cluttered composition, muddy colors, photorealism, 3D render look, chibi proportions, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, extra limbs, text, logos, watermarks, and obvious copying of any reference image.

prompts.text:
你是一名专注于原创女性偶像英雄动漫主视觉图的图像生成艺术总监。

始终创建原创图像。不要复制任何上传的图像、特定艺术家、工作室、系列、受版权保护的角色或商标设计。不要从任何参考中重现相同的主题、姿势、道具、地标或构图。仅将参考用于广泛的质量、打磨、密度和氛围。

核心风格：
创建以女性偶像英雄为中心的高冲击力动漫主视觉图：一位结合了明星魅力、象征性服装设计、情感存在感和战斗就绪能量的女主角。该图像应该让人感觉像是主要动漫、游戏或幻想偶像动作系列的优质宣传艺术。

角色方向：
女主角必须感觉具有标志性、受人敬仰且一眼就能认出。她应该具有强烈的轮廓、富有表现力的眼睛、精致的面部设计、美丽的头发流动，以及融合了偶像魅力与英雄实用性的服装。她的设计应该感觉令人向往且令人难忘，而不是普通的。

服装语言：
使用分层、优雅的舞台英雄时尚：紧身胸衣或表演夹克、装饰性饰边、丝带、不对称配饰、装饰性扣件、手套、靴子、结构化的裙板或英雄披风元素，以及一个连贯的主题，如天体、花卉、水晶、皇家、未来主义或元素。该服装应该看起来优质、具有表演性且具备战斗能力。

姿势与存在感：
优先考虑具有指挥力、像明星一样的肢体语言。她应该投射出自信、优雅和英雄般的领导力。使用动态但可读的姿势，使她感觉既是表演者又是救世主形象。避免僵硬的写真相片姿势。

构图：
使用具有清晰焦点层次结构的宣传主视觉构图。女主角应该主导画面。在头发、丝带、面料、粒子和光弧中采用优雅的运动。使用强烈的轮廓可读性、分层深度和电影般的比例感。偏好戏剧性的低角度或舞台前框取。

世界与氛围：
将幻想英雄主义与偶像奇观相融合。背景可能包括天体建筑、魔法舞台元素、耀眼的城市灯光、漂浮的符文、水晶结构、英雄徽章或风格化的大气风景。环境应该支持女主角的神话和名望。

光照与色彩：
使用大胆、打磨、优质的动漫光照。将迷人的舞台般高光与英雄般的幻想光芒相结合。偏好干净的对比、发光的轮廓光、闪烁的点缀和强烈的标志性调色板。图像应该感觉光芒四射、令人向往且充满情感。

渲染：
清晰的动漫线条、打磨的面部渲染、带有绘画般光点缀的干净赛璐璐阴影、详细的服装纹理、发光的粒子、锐利的眼睛、优雅的双手和优质的海报润色。

避免：
普通的女学生造型、随机的幻想盔甲、虚弱的轮廓、平淡的服装设计、无生命的表情、过度性化的呈现、杂乱的构图、浑浊的颜色、照片写实主义、3D渲染外观、Q版比例、扭曲的解剖结构、额外的手指、额外的四肢、文本、徽标、水印以及对任何参考图像的明显复制。

items.title: 人像照片的专业发型分析

prompts.text:
你是一位兼具国际审美、发型专业知识、人物形象诊断能力、版式设计能力与高情商表达能力的顶级发型顾问兼视觉总监。请基于用户上传的人像照片，生成一张高端发型分析海报、发型咨询报告、发型诊断提案。

这不是普通拼图，也不是廉价模板，而是一张可以直接用于咨询展示、打印传单、社交媒体分享、门店服务展示的海报级作品。整张图必须让人一眼觉得专业、现代、明亮、可信、科学，并且推荐逻辑必须真正成立，不能为了凑数量而乱推荐。

核心任务

请基于用户上传的人像照片，做一份“十二个推荐发型”的专业分析报告。不要设置黑榜，不要做带冒犯感的否定性内容。整套推荐必须建立在真实可行、审美先进、理论充分、因人而异的基础上。推荐的十二个发型不是简单罗列，而是结合人物的脸型、头型、五官、骨相、发量、发质、年龄感、气质、身份场景、文化背景、日常维护能力，以及现代发型理论与经典设计体系，综合推导出来的个性化结果。

最重要的优化原则

准确性优先于数量装饰。每一个推荐都必须有明确依据。
不要为了显得时髦而强行给出夸张、先锋、实验性、极难驾驭的发型，除非人物本身条件与风格真的非常适合。
不要只看脸型，要综合“轮廓结构、头型结构、发质条件、气质风格、实操可行性、维护成本”。
如果某类发型理论上成立，但对当前人物的发量、发际线、头型、年龄气质、生活场景并不友好，就不要作为优先推荐。
推荐逻辑必须像真正的资深发型师和形象顾问，而不是像网络模板文章。
十二个推荐发型之间必须有清晰差异，但都要保持“适合本人”这个大前提，不能出现明显不靠谱的尝试项。
整张报告既要有审美，也要有科学性，还要有现实可执行性。

理论与分析基础

请综合以下理论框架进行智能判断，并将这些内容转化为通俗、可信、专业、易读的结果，不要空洞堆术语，但要让人感受到专业深度。

第一类，脸型与头型分析理论。包括脸部横纵比例、头型顶部高度、后脑饱满度、头包脸关系、面部重心、横向量感、纵向延展感、轮廓松紧关系。

第二类，五官与骨相结构观察。包括额头宽度、太阳穴状态、颧骨存在感、面中部比例、下颌线、下巴走势、面部转折、软组织覆盖感、骨相清晰度。

第三类，发型设计原理。包括顶部重心控制、两侧收缩、纵向拉伸、横向平衡、轮廓修饰、体积设计、层次分布、轻重关系、刘海逻辑、发尾处理、空气感、纹理感、结构感。

第四类，发质与发量逻辑。包括细软发、粗硬发、自然卷、扁塌、毛躁、浓密、稀疏、油性倾向、蓬松能力、支撑能力、对烫染与定型的适配度。

第五类，气质风格分析。包括清爽、温柔、知性、利落、英气、成熟、年轻、优雅、可爱、酷感、职业感、艺术感、松弛感、精致感、亲和感等。

第六类，现代发型趋势与经典设计思想。可参考现代日韩潮流、国际沙龙设计趋势，以及经典剪裁理念、几何造型原则、个性化修饰原则，但不要机械点名堆砌，要把这些理论真正转化成更精准的推荐结果。

第七类，现实可行性原则。包括当前发长是否能直接实现、是否需要蓄长、是否适合烫发、是否建议染发、维护难度、复刻难度、适用场景与日常投入成本。

人物理解原则

用户上传的人可能是男性、女性、儿童、青少年、成年人、中老年人，也可能来自不同国家、民族与文化背景。请根据具体照片智能判断，不可套用单一模板，不可一概而论。不要把任何一类人群粗暴归纳为固定发型结论。必须做到“这个人就是这个人”，针对具体人物做具体分析。

高情商表达要求

整张报告不能冷冰冰，也不能像在挑毛病。请先基于照片中的人物特点，给出一段简短但真诚、专业、有分寸、有情商的优点解读。要让对方感受到被理解、被尊重、被欣赏。可以夸赞对方的五官协调度、轮廓辨识度、精神面貌、气质方向、风格可塑性、亲和感、利落感、成熟魅力、年轻感等。语言必须自然、真诚、专业，不油腻，不夸张，不虚假。后续发型建议必须建立在“放大优点、进一步优化”的逻辑上，而不是否定对方。

新增的科学分析模块

请加入一轮科学的头型与脸型分析。如果版式适合，优先采用横向报告布局。页面可分为左侧大面板与右侧多个小面板。

左侧大面板使用大型人物头部特写，清晰展示头型、脸型、发际线和整体轮廓。左侧主图上叠加优雅、克制、专业的几何分析元素，包括头型轮廓线、垂直中心线、水平引导线、宽度标记、比例辅助线、关键结构点、简洁文字注释。所有分析叠加必须像高端造型咨询图，精致、轻盈、现代，不能廉价、不能像医疗示意图、不能过重过乱。

请在左侧分析区域附近加入“头型与脸型分析总结”。这一部分要根据具体人物智能生成，概括额头宽度、颊部与太阳穴区域、下颌与下巴特征、脸部横向与纵向比例、整体轮廓印象、面部量感与视觉重心，并进一步提炼本人的造型目标。例如视觉拉长头型、提升顶部高度、减少两侧宽度、增强纵向比例、增加轻盈感和层次感、强化轮廓清晰度、让整体更精神、更协调、更时尚。这里的造型目标必须由分析自然推导出来，不能空喊口号。

版式要求

画面的宽度、高度、比例、布局方式必须根据内容数量、内容密度与空间规划灵活适应，不要机械固定比例，除非用户明确指定比例或版式方向。
如果内容更适合展示分析逻辑、人物头部特写与多个信息模块，则优先采用横向报告布局。
如果内容较多，也可以智能拉宽或拉长版面，但整体必须仍然像高级海报，而不是杂乱长图。
绝不允许出现图片拉伸、脸部畸变、头型失真、发型比例崩坏。
所有发型展示图都要裁切合理，确保头发完整可见、脸部比例自然、肩颈关系舒服。
模块之间留白明确，信息层级清晰，版式科学，不能拥挤。
整体视觉要像高端咨询海报、精品沙龙提案、时尚形象分析板，而不是低端电商长图。
整体风格必须明亮、现代、精致、时尚、可信，不压抑，不土气，不昏暗。
主色调以米白、暖白、浅灰、浅卡其、雾感中性色为主，可搭配少量精致点缀色。
字体要现代、清晰、时尚，有设计感但易读。标题可以更有气质，正文必须可读。
整体必须具备海报级呈现效果，拿出去能建立信任感。

内容结构

整张图至少包含以下内容，并根据版式灵活组织。

第一部分，主标题区。标题要高级、有吸引力，例如“专属发型诊断报告”“你的发型适配分析”“个人发型优化提案”等。副标题可简洁说明：基于脸型、头型、骨相、发质、气质与现实可行性生成的个性化建议。

第二部分，人物优势解读区。简短夸赞和概括人物优点，语气要有情商，也要有专业感。

第三部分，头型与脸型科学分析区。展示左侧主图分析和总结性文字。要明确写出轮廓特征与造型目标。这一模块必须认真做，不能敷衍。

第四部分，十二个推荐发型。必须严格是十二个，不多不少。每一个推荐发型都必须包含以下信息：发型展示图，发型名称，适配度评分，格式必须明确写成“适配度：9.2分”；推荐理由，说明它如何优化轮廓、强化气质、适应场景、提升整体观感；适配关键词，例如通勤友好、减龄自然、精致高级、温柔知性、利落清爽、层次感强、氛围感好等，但不要过多；难度或维护提示，例如“好打理”“需要吹整”“需要定期修剪”“需轻烫辅助”“更适合发量较多者”“建议蓄长后尝试”等。十二个推荐发型之间必须拉开差异，不要十二个都像同一个发型的小改款，但也不能脱离人物本身条件乱跳。

推荐发型的差异可以体现在分线方式、顶部长度、两侧处理、刘海形式、层次轻重、纹理强弱、发尾表达、直发或轻卷、正式或休闲、温柔或利落、年轻或成熟等方向上。所有差异都要建立在“适合这个人”的基础上。

第五部分，最终结论区。请给出最终最值得优先尝试的前三名发型，并总结原因。这一部分要像造型顾问的明确结论，而不是模糊态度。要说明最适合形象升级的方向、最稳妥的长期选择、最容易落地的优先方案。

第六部分，后续维护建议。内容包括修剪周期建议、吹整建议、造型产品建议、日常整理建议、不同推荐发型的维护难度差异。要简洁实用。

第七部分，头发养护建议。内容包括洗护建议、头皮护理建议、发质修护建议、减少毛躁、扁塌、出油、干枯等问题的建议，以及饮食、作息、生活方式的基础建议。语言要通俗、可信、简洁，不要像医学论文，也不要像空泛鸡汤。

推荐逻辑强化要求

十二个发型必须显得比普通模板推荐更精准。推荐不能只是“看起来差不多就放进去”，而要让人感觉这些发型是由严谨分析推导出来的。
如果某个发型只是勉强成立，宁可不要列入十二个推荐，也不要为了凑满数量而降低质量。
可以将十二个推荐在内部隐性分层，例如“最优先推荐”“稳定适配”“可进阶尝试”，但整体仍然都是正向推荐，而不是黑榜。
每个推荐都要让人感觉“这是可以认真考虑、真正可做的方案”，而不是纸上谈兵。

人物与服装规则

核心人物必须基于用户上传的真实照片进行分析与重构，保留人物辨识度与主要气质，不要变成完全不同的人。
发型变化时，人物的身份与气质要保持统一，不能十二个发型看起来像十二个不同的人。
照片中的穿着不一定要和原始照片完全一致。
如果用户明确要求服装变化，则可以根据不同发型调整服装风格。
如果用户没有明确要求服装变化，则保持服装统一，形成专业整洁的系列感。
服装只能辅助整体形象，不可喧宾夺主。
如果人物年龄、身份或文化背景不适合过度时装化，请保持克制与得体。

摄影与成像质量要求

所有发型展示图都必须有真实、高级、可信的人像摄影质感。
光线柔和但清晰，肤质真实细腻，发丝结构清楚。
背景简洁明亮，不能阴沉压抑，不能黑闷脏乱。
观感接近高端日韩摄影工作室与高端形象照的结合。
不要做成低质证件照，也不要做成浮夸大片，而是介于专业形象照与精品咨询图之间。

文字质量要求

全部文字必须真实可读、逻辑通顺、没有乱码。
文字必须专业、自然、有信息量，不机械，不空洞，不土气。
所有分析、推荐、评分都必须让人一眼看出是有依据的。
评分文字必须一眼能看懂，例如“适配度：9.3分”。
整体要建立信任感、专业感、审美品位与实用价值。

最终输出要求

输出为一张高完成度的大图海报。整张图必须同时具备科学分析价值、发型推荐价值、形象顾问报告价值、海报展示价值，以及可阅读、可分享、可印刷、可传单分发的商业品质。

请在开始生成前，先基于用户上传的照片进行智能判断，然后输出完整结果。

用户输入内容

请上传一张清晰的人像照片，生活照也可以，正面、半侧面、日常自拍、他拍都可以，但尽量保证脸部、头发、头型轮廓清楚可见。
可选补充：你的性别、年龄段、职业或风格偏好。
可选补充：是否希望服装跟随不同发型变化。
可选补充：是否有想尝试的发型方向，或明确不想要的风格。
可选补充：你更重视日常好打理、提升气质、显年轻、显成熟、正式感、时尚感，还是个性表达。

4:5 vertical poster, ultra high resolution, 8K, luxury fashion campaign, editorial + commercial hybrid, print-ready sharpness
CORE IDEA:
A bold, disruptive fashion statement where movement is exaggerated and dominant, but still feels controlled, raw, and premium.
The subject doesn’t just move —
they impose presence through scale and perspective.
SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Industrial warehouse loft (Colors shifted)
Background:
Exposed aged terracotta brick walls
Large factory windows with patinaed brass frames (blurry, cinematic background)
Environment:
Distressed concrete floor with cracks (retains gray but with a slightly warmer, dusty cast)
Warm-toned, diffused natural light filtering in (creating a soft contrast)
Mood:
Mix of realism + high-energy campaign aesthetic
SUBJECT:
Female fashion model in customized Miu Miu utility streetwear (Colors shifted)
Outfit:
Oversized cropped technical jacket in a deep, muted rust-red (Miu Miu branding subtle but present, perhaps in a gold thread)
Extremely baggy multi-pocket cargo pants in a dusty olive green (replacing dark grey)
Platform Miu Miu loafers in a warm, textured caramel-brown leather (replacing chunky black)
Opaque cream socks (replacing sheer black)
Pose:
Mid-stride dynamic jump motion
One platform loafer extremely close to camera (hero perspective)
Body twisting dynamically
Hair flying (messy but controlled)
Confident smirk, gazing away from camera
PRODUCT FOCUS:
Platform loafer dominates foreground
Ultra detailed textures (chunky leather, shiny buckles in brass, heavy wear, reflections)
Glossy + matte material contrast
Perspective distortion exaggerates size
Front shoe = tack sharp
Background shoe slightly softer
TYPOGRAPHY: (Colors shifted)
Primary Headline:
RULES
ARE
OBSOLETE.
Layout:
Right-aligned stacked text
“OBSOLETE.” large and aggressive
Slight overlap with subject
Font:
Aggressive block sans-serif
Urban stencil texture
Color:
Warm cream for main text (replacing silver)
Accent word “OBSOLETE.” in bold painted deep crimson brush style (replacing electric blue)
SECONDARY TEXT: (Colors shifted)
Placed bottom-right:
“ENGINEERING DISSIDENCE.
NOT CONFORMITY.” (Text remains same)
Small icon row (minimal, premium feel):
Built to Last
Rules Don’t Apply
Create Danger
Paris France
BRANDING: (Colors shifted)
Top-right:
MIU MIU (clean, minimal, perhaps in gold)
Bottom-left:
MIUMIU®
AW24 Collection (in warm cream)
Bottom-right:
miumiu (in warm cream)
COLOR GRADING:
Warm, earthy urban palette
Soft shadows + deep crimsons/rusts
Warm highlights from window light
Slight cinematic tone
LIGHTING:
Natural window daylight
Hard shadows for depth
Specular highlights on leather and buckles
CAMERA:
Ultra wide-angle (18–24mm)
Very low angle (ground level)
Forced perspective exaggeration
Depth:
Foreground sharp
Background slightly blurred
TEXTURE / FINISH:
Subtle grain (2–3%)
Slight sharpening on product
Micro contrast boost
Clean but not overly polished
DESIGN INTENT (IMPORTANT):
Feels like Y-3 utility + Miu Miu playfulness hybrid
Bold enough for social media
Premium enough for billboard
Immediate scroll-stopping impact

prompts.text:
4:5 竖版海报，超高清分辨率，8K，奢侈时尚广告，大片与商业混合，印刷级锐度
核心理念：
一种大胆、颠覆性的时尚宣言，其中动态被夸大且占据主导地位，但仍感觉受控、原始且高级。
主体不仅仅是移动——
他们通过尺度和透视强行施加存在感。
场景 / 环境：
工业仓库阁楼 (颜色偏移)
背景：
裸露的老化赤陶砖墙
带有铜绿黄铜边框的大型工厂窗户 (模糊，电影感背景)
环境：
有裂缝的破旧混凝土地面 (保留灰色但带有略微温暖、蒙尘的色调)
暖色调、漫反射的自然光透入 (创造柔和的对比)
氛围：
现实主义 + 高能量广告美学的混合
主体：
身穿定制 Miu Miu 实用主义街头服饰的女性时尚模特 (颜色偏移)
服装：
深色柔和铁锈红的超大号短款机能夹克 (Miu Miu 品牌标识微妙但存在，也许是金线)
极其宽松的多口袋工装裤，呈灰绿色 (替换深灰色)
Miu Miu 厚底乐福鞋，采用温暖的带有纹理的焦糖棕色皮革 (替换笨重的黑色)
不透明的奶油色袜子 (替换黑色透明袜)
姿势：
跨步中的动态跳跃动作
一只厚底乐福鞋极其贴近相机 (英雄视角)
身体动态扭曲
头发飞扬 (凌乱但受控)
自信的假笑，视线避开相机
产品焦点：
厚底乐福鞋主导前景
超精细纹理 (厚重的皮革，闪亮的黄铜搭扣，严重磨损，反光)
光泽 + 哑光材质对比
透视畸变夸大尺寸
前方的鞋子 = 极度锐利
背景的鞋子略微柔和
排版： (颜色偏移)
主标题：
规则
已经
过时。
布局：
右对齐堆叠文本
“过时。” 大且具有攻击性
与主体轻微重叠
字体：
具有攻击性的粗体无衬线字体
城市模板纹理
颜色：
主文本使用暖奶油色 (替换银色)
强调词“过时。” 采用粗犷的深红色笔刷风格绘制 (替换电光蓝)
次要文本： (颜色偏移)
放置在右下角：
“制造异见。
拒绝盲从。” (文本保持不变)
小图标行 (极简，高级感)：
经久耐用
规则不适用
制造危险
法国巴黎
品牌标识： (颜色偏移)
右上角：
MIU MIU (干净，极简，也许是金色)
左下角：
MIUMIU®
AW24 系列 (暖奶油色)
右下角：
miumiu (暖奶油色)
色彩分级：
温暖、泥土质感的城市调色板
柔和阴影 + 深红色/铁锈红
来自窗户光的温暖高光
轻微的电影感色调
灯光：
自然窗户日光
用于增加深度的硬阴影
皮革和搭扣上的镜面高光
相机：
超广角 (18–24mm)
极低角度 (地面水平)
强制透视夸大
景深：
前景锐利
背景略微模糊
纹理 / 后期：
微弱的颗粒感 (2–3%)
产品上轻微锐化
微对比度增强
干净但不过度精修
设计意图 (重要)：
感觉像 Y-3 实用主义 + Miu Miu 玩趣性的混合体
足够大胆以适用于社交媒体
足够高级以适用于广告牌
产生即时的划屏停止冲击力

items.title: 雨夜公交站等车的少女

prompts.text: At a city bus stop on a rainy night, a young adult woman stands alone under the dim yellow streetlight and the bus stop light box, looking down slightly at her phone, not looking at the camera, showing a natural waiting state. She is wearing a light-colored thin jacket, a dark midi skirt, and white sneakers, with long hair falling naturally, holding a phone in one hand, and lightly holding a clear umbrella in the other hand. The character is located in the right third of the frame, with a blurred foreground obstruction on the left, like a momentary glimpse from the edge of a street crowd or a car window. The bus stop sign, advertising light box, streetlight pole, and the edge of the umbrella form clear vertical and diagonal lines, guiding the line of sight. The ground has rainwater reflections, and distant headlights and neon lights are blurred into soft light spots. The overall look is a mix of a cold blue rainy night environment and warm yellow streetlights, creating realistic city lighting, with soft top light and side light, without a strong posed feeling. Shallow depth of field makes the subject clear and the background slightly blurred, the image has a real camera grain feel, slight motion blur, and imperfect composition, presenting a candid snapshot of a real moment. The photo style is realistic and natural, not a portrait, not an advertising blockbuster, with no text watermark.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text: 在雨夜的城市公交站台，一位年轻成年女性独自站在昏黄路灯和公交站灯箱下，微微低头看手机，没有看向镜头，展现自然等待的状态。她穿着浅色薄外套、深色半裙和白色运动鞋，长发自然垂落，一只手拿着手机，另一只手轻握透明雨伞。人物位于画面右侧三分之一的位置，左侧有模糊的前景遮挡，像从街边人群或车窗边缘偶然看到的一瞬间。公交站牌、广告灯箱、路灯杆和雨伞边缘形成清晰的竖向与斜向线条，引导视线。地面有雨水反光，远处车灯和霓虹被虚化成柔和光斑。整体为冷蓝色雨夜环境与暖黄色路灯混合的真实城市光线，柔和顶光和侧光，没有强烈摆拍感。浅景深使主体清晰，背景略微虚化，画面带真实相机颗粒感、轻微运动模糊和不完美构图，呈现随手抓拍的真实瞬间。照片风格真实自然，非写真、非广告大片，无文字水印。

items.title: 水墨光影国潮城市海报

prompts.text:
Please generate a vertical city promotional poster for [City Name]. Do not apply fixed templates. You must first extract the city's most unique cultural background, geographical environment, industrial development, and urban philosophy, and then design the visual structure based on this.

The image must make people recognize at a glance that this is [City Name]: select the most recognizable historical and cultural symbols, natural geographical symbols, modern landmarks, industrial characteristics, lifestyle temperament, and future vision of the city. The composition is not fixed; you can freely arrange foreground, midground, background, and dynamic elements according to the city's characteristics.

Requirements to reflect:
Historical culture: the city's traditional architecture, regional culture, folk customs, historical memory, or spiritual symbols.
Current development: modern skyline, industrial characteristics, transportation, commerce, technology, finance, ports, ecology.
Urban philosophy: use visual metaphors to express the spirit of the city, such as openness, innovation, local lifestyle atmosphere, internationalization, landscape and humanities, future technology.
Poster texture: vertical 9:16, high-end Guochao city promotional poster, integration of realistic digital matte painting and ink wash/light and shadow, cinematic lighting and shadow, high details, commercial poster layout.

Text: the city name "[City Name]" can be used as the calligraphy main title, plus a promotional slogan that matches the city's temperament; avoid a large amount of small garbled text.

No generic city collages, no incorrect landmarks, no cheap tourism advertisement feel, no cartoon style, no watermarks.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请为【城市名】生成竖版城市宣传海报。不要套用固定模板，要先提炼这座城市最独特的文化背景、地理环境、产业发展和城市理念，再据此设计画面结构。

画面必须让人一眼看出这是【城市名】：选取该城市最具辨识度的历史文化符号、自然地理符号、现代地标、产业特征、生活气质和未来愿景。构图不固定，可根据城市特色自由安排前景、中景、远景和动势元素。

要求体现：
历史文化：该城市的传统建筑、地域文化、民俗、历史记忆或精神象征。
当下发展：现代天际线、产业特色、交通、商业、科技、金融、港口、生态等。
城市理念：用视觉隐喻表现这座城市的精神，比如开放、创新、烟火气、国际化、山水人文、未来科技等。
海报质感：竖版 9:16，高端国潮城市宣传海报，写实数字绘景与水墨/光影融合，电影级光影，高细节，商业海报排版。

文字：城市名“【城市名】”可作为书法主标题，另加一句符合城市气质的宣传语；避免大量小字乱码。

不要通用城市拼贴，不要错误地标，不要廉价旅游广告感，不要卡通风，不要水印。

items.title: 动感高定时尚女郎凌空飞跃

prompts.text: A dynamic, high-fashion action photograph features a woman with flowing, wavy grey-blue hair, caught mid-air in a powerful, dynamic leap against a clean, gradient blue studio background. She wears light blue-framed sunglasses, small hoop earrings, and a white cropped puffer jacket with light blue striped panels and cuff details, layered over a white bandeau top and a light blue utility harness. Her bulky, oversized grey-olive cargo pants feature multiple large pockets, light blue strapping details, and integrated light blue drawstrings, tucked into chunky white athletic socks with a small blue Nike swoosh. Her feet are encased in large, intricate light blue Nike Air-Max-style sneakers with complex sole structures, and a clear reflection is visible on the blue polished floor beneath her. A large, stylized vertical white text graphic to the right reads "+tsun" and to the left, the white text reads "Nike" with smaller text below. The lighting is crisp and even, highlighting textures and form.

items.title: 超饱和卡通剪纸立体模型

prompts.text:
{
  "VARIABLE": "[CARTOON_SHOW_NAME]",
  "concept": "Hyper-saturated physical paper cut-out diorama of the world of [CARTOON_SHOW_NAME] — maximalist, eye-level dead-center straight-on view, bleed-to-edge, no outer frame, no border, no tray",
  "style": {

  "depth_planes": {

    "foreground_base": "Small iconic props, collectibles, and world-items from [CARTOON_SHOW_NAME] scattered and crowding the base plane edge",
    "layer_2": "The single most iconic protagonist character from [CARTOON_SHOW_NAME] as the central figure — frozen mid-signature-action, built entirely from stacked paper geometry",

prompts.text:
You are a top medical aesthetics plastic surgery visual designer, facial aesthetics analyst, and high-end portrait retouching blueprint designer. Please generate a realistic high-definition "medical aesthetics plastic surgery before and after comparison blueprint," adopting a left-right dual-column side-by-side layout, presenting an overall high-end professional medical aesthetics advertising-grade texture, like a real plastic surgery institution's before and after case display image.

【Core Objective】
The focus of this image is not ordinary retouching, but a "medical aesthetics plastic surgery before and after strong contrast case image."
The before and after must be the same person, same angle, same expression, same lighting direction, but the post-surgery effect must be significantly improved compared to the pre-surgery, forming a strikingly visible strong difference.
The before and after difference must be significantly greater than ordinary skin smoothing retouching, focusing on highlighting changes in the nose, facial contours, periorbital area, midface, skin, and rejuvenation.
The overall style must be realistic, high-definition, professional, high-end, and natural, neither exaggeratedly deformed nor plastic fake face.

【Overall Image Requirements】
- Horizontal dual-column composition, left and right side by side.
- Left side is "Pre-surgery Analysis," right side is "Post-surgery Effect."
- There is a clear dividing line between left and right.
- Same person, same shooting angle, same face orientation, same expression, same composition ratio.
- The person's face occupies the main body of the image, preferably a bust or half-body close-up, ensuring facial features and contour details are clearly visible.
- The image focuses on the face, do not let clothing or background overshadow the main subject.
- The background adopts a clean and simple white, light gray, or high-end medical aesthetics space background.
- The overall image quality must be high-definition, with clear details and naturally visible skin texture.

【Left Panel: Pre-surgery Analysis】
- Display an unretouched pre-surgery original portrait.
- The left side must retain obvious pre-surgery issues, but do not uglify it to the point of distortion, it should look like a real ordinary person's pre-surgery state.
- The pre-surgery issues should be relatively more obvious to widen the before and after gap, including but not limited to:
  - Facial contours are relatively blunt, not smooth enough
  - Jawline is blurred, lower face slightly wide
  - Chin is receding or proportionally inadequate
  - Nasal bridge is low, insufficient three-dimensionality
  - Nasal tip is round and blunt, slightly large
  - Alar is slightly wide, nasal refinement is insufficient
  - Eyes lack spirit, eye shape is average
  - Dark circles are obvious
  - Eye bags are obvious, periorbital puffiness
  - Midface is slightly sunken, apple cheeks lack support
  - Nasolabial folds are quite obvious
  - Slight facial asymmetry
  - Eyebrow shape is messy, insufficient refinement
  - Skin is dull
  - Uneven skin tone
  - Slight redness on cheeks
  - T-zone or face has oily shine
  - Skin texture roughness is more obvious
  - Teeth are slightly yellow
  - Hair strands are frizzy, many flyaway hairs, insufficient hair volume
- Use precise red medical aesthetics analysis annotations to indicate positions that need improvement.
- Annotation methods include: red arrows, red circles, red dashed lines, red auxiliary lines, red hand-drawn grids, facial proportion analysis lines.
- Next to each problem point, there must be a short and clear Chinese retouching instruction.
- The left side must have a "Pre-surgery Analysis" title.
- The overall effect of the left side should look like a professional doctor's or medical aesthetics institution's pre-surgery analysis image.

【Chinese Annotation Instructions That Must Appear on the Left Side】
- Refine skin texture
- Reduce facial oiliness
- Even out skin tone
- Improve facial redness
- Adjust eyebrow shape lines
- Optimize eye contour
- Lighten dark circles
- Improve eye bag puffiness
- Raise nasal bridge
- Reduce nasal tip size
- Narrow alar
- Lift midface fullness
- Lighten nasolabial folds
- Define jawline
- Narrow lower facial contour
- Optimize chin proportion
- Improve facial symmetry
- Slightly brighten teeth
- Tidy flyaway hairs
- Add natural hair volume
- Balance overall lighting
- Soften background

【Right Panel: Post-surgery Effect】
- Based on all red annotations and Chinese instructions on the left side, generate a post-surgery portrait with obvious improvements.
- The post-surgery effect must be significantly better than the pre-surgery, achieving a change that can be recognized at a glance as "after medical aesthetics plastic surgery."
- The post-surgery changes must be much more obvious than ordinary retouching, but still realistic and natural.
- The right side only displays the final post-surgery effect, without adding red annotations.
- The right side must have a "Post-surgery Effect" title.

【Post-surgery Changes That Must Be Strengthened】
1. Nasal changes must be obvious
- Nasal bridge is obviously raised, nasal dorsum line is straighter and more upright
- Nasal tip is obviously reduced, more refined and delicate
- Alar is obviously narrowed, more coordinated
- Overall nasal three-dimensionality is significantly enhanced
- Must make people recognize the refinement after rhinoplasty at a glance

2. Facial contour changes must be obvious
- Jawline is clearer and cleaner
- Lower face is obviously narrower
- Face shape is smoother, more petite, more refined
- Chin proportion is more coordinated, slightly advanced or more three-dimensional
- Facial contour changes from relatively blunt to clearer and more three-dimensional
- Visually has an obvious effect of "face slimming, refinement, contour optimization"

3. Periorbital changes must be obvious
- Dark circles are obviously lightened
- Eye bags and puffiness are obviously reduced
- Eye fissure shape is smoother, eyes are more spirited
- Both eyes look more energetic and younger
- But do not exaggerate into European-style large double eyelids, maintain natural Asian aesthetics

4. Midface rejuvenation changes must be obvious
- Midface fullness is improved
- Apple cheek support is better
- Nasolabial folds are obviously shallower
- The overall face looks younger, fuller, and more energetic

5. Skin changes must be obvious
- Skin is more refined
- Skin is more translucent and bright
- Skin tone is more even
- Dullness is obviously improved
- Redness is obviously reduced
- Oiliness is obviously reduced
- Skin texture must be good, but do not over-smooth, still retain natural and realistic skin texture

6. Detail refinement changes
- Eyebrow shape is neater, more designed
- Teeth are slightly brightened but natural
- Hair strands are neater, flyaway hairs are reduced
- Hair is more voluminous and natural
- Fill light is more balanced, facial lighting is more high-end
- Background is softer, with more high-end medical aesthetics advertising texture

【Difference Enhancement Requirements】
- The difference between pre-surgery and post-surgery must be "obviously widened."
- Do not just slightly retouch, do not just simply smooth skin.
- Must highlight the comprehensive medical aesthetics changes of "comprehensive nasal enhancement + contour optimization + periorbital rejuvenation + skin quality improvement."
- The before and after difference should reach the level of real medical aesthetics case images.
- Focus on making the viewer notice at a glance:
  - Nose is higher and more refined
  - Face is smaller and more three-dimensional
  - Jawline is clearer
  - Periorbital area is younger
  - Skin is more high-end and cleaner
- Pre-surgery is more ordinary, post-surgery is more refined, more photogenic, younger, but still the same person.
- Retain the person's original identity features, do not swap faces, do not turn into another person.
- The post-surgery improvement magnitude can be larger than conventional retouching, but must be realistically credible.

【Text and Annotation Requirements】
- All annotation text on the left side must be in Chinese.
- Chinese annotations must be short, clear, professional, and easy to read.
- Annotations must be neatly arranged, avoiding obscuring key facial features.
- Do not have garbled text, do not have incorrect text.
- The left side has red analysis annotations, the right side has no annotations.

【Style Requirements】
- Realistic photography style
- High-definition portrait
- Professional medical aesthetics case display style
- High-end, clean, simple
- Like a formal plastic surgery institution's promotional case image
- Not illustration, not comic, not concept art

【Negative Requirements】
- No comic style
- No illustration style
- No exaggeratedly deformed plastic surgery
- No turning into internet celebrity fake face
- No plastic skin
- No over-smoothing
- No overly strong AI feel
- Do not make the post-surgery into a completely different person
- No low clarity
- No ordinary collage feel
- No additional explanatory text
- No complex cluttered background
- Do not have English text annotations
- No garbled text

【Final Output Requirements】
Only output one left-right dual-column medical aesthetics plastic surgery before and after comparison blueprint final image:
- Left side: "Pre-surgery Analysis" — unretouched pre-surgery original portrait + red medical aesthetics analysis annotations + Chinese retouching instructions
- Right side: "Post-surgery Effect" — naturally realistic post-surgery portrait with obvious improvements
The final effect must be realistic, high-definition, professional, high-end, and with significant before and after differences, with medical aesthetics plastic surgery before and after changes visible at a glance.

prompts.text:
你是一位顶尖医美整形视觉设计师、面部美学分析师与高端人像修图蓝图设计师。请生成一张真实高清的“医美整容术前术后对比蓝图”，采用左右双栏并排布局，整体呈现高端专业医疗美容广告级质感，像真实整形机构的术前术后案例展示图。

【核心目标】
这张图的重点不是普通修图，而是“医美整形前后强对比案例图”。
前后必须为同一人物、同一角度、同一表情、同一光线方向，但术后效果要比术前明显提升，形成一眼可见的强烈差异。
要求前后差异明显大于普通磨皮修图，重点突出鼻部、轮廓、眼周、中面部、皮肤、年轻化等部位的变化。
整体风格必须真实、高清、专业、高级、自然，不能夸张畸形，也不能塑料假脸。

【整体画面要求】
- 横向双栏构图，左右并排。
- 左侧为“术前分析”，右侧为“术后效果”。
- 左右之间有清晰分隔线。
- 同一人物，同一拍摄视角，同一脸部朝向，同一表情，同一构图比例。
- 人物脸部占画面主体，最好是胸像或半身近景，确保五官与轮廓细节清晰可见。
- 画面重点聚焦脸部，不要让服装或背景喧宾夺主。
- 背景采用干净简洁的白色、浅灰色或高级医美空间背景。
- 整体画质要高清、细节清楚、皮肤纹理自然可见。

【左侧面板：术前分析】
- 展示未经修饰的术前原始人像。
- 左侧必须保留明显的术前问题，但不要丑化到失真，要像真实普通人术前状态。
- 术前问题要相对更明显一些，以拉开前后差距，包括但不限于：
  - 面部轮廓偏钝，不够流畅
  - 下颌线模糊，下面部略宽
  - 下巴后缩或比例欠佳
  - 鼻梁偏低，立体度不足

  - 双眼不够有神，眼型一般
  - 黑眼圈明显
  - 眼袋明显，眼周浮肿
  - 中面部略凹，苹果肌支撑感不足
  - 法令纹较明显
  - 面部轻微不对称
  - 眉形凌乱，精致度不足
  - 皮肤暗沉
  - 肤色不均
  - 面颊轻微泛红

  - 牙齿轻微发黄
  - 发丝毛躁，碎发较多，头发蓬松度不足

- 标注方式包含：红色箭头、红色圆圈、红色虚线、红色辅助线、红色手绘网格、面部比例分析线。
- 每个问题点旁边都要有简短清晰的中文修整指令。
- 左侧必须有“术前分析”标题。
- 左侧整体效果像专业医生或医美机构做的术前分析图。

【左侧必须出现的中文标注指令】

- 均匀肤色
- 改善面部泛红
- 调整眉形线条

【右侧面板：术后效果】

- 鼻部整体立体度显著增强
- 要让人一眼看出鼻整形后的精致感

2. 面部轮廓变化必须明显
- 下颌线更清晰利落
- 下面部明显更收窄
- 脸型更流畅、更小巧、更精致
- 下巴比例更协调，轻微前移或更立体
- 面部轮廓从偏钝变为更清晰立体
- 视觉上有明显“小脸化、精致化、轮廓优化”的效果

3. 眼周变化必须明显
- 黑眼圈明显淡化
- 眼袋和浮肿明显减少
- 眼裂形态更流畅，眼睛更有神采
- 双眼看起来更精神、更年轻
- 但不要夸张成欧式大双眼皮，保持自然亚洲审美

4. 中面部年轻化变化必须明显
- 中面部饱满度提升
- 苹果肌支撑感更好
- 法令纹明显变浅
- 面部整体显得更年轻、更饱满、更有精神

5. 皮肤变化必须明显
- 皮肤更细腻
- 皮肤更透亮
- 肤色更均匀
- 暗沉明显改善
- 泛红明显减少
- 油光明显减少
- 皮肤质感要好，但不能过度磨皮，仍要保留自然真实的皮肤纹理

6. 细节精致化变化
- 眉形更整齐、更有设计感
- 牙齿轻微提亮但自然
- 发丝更整洁，碎发减少
- 头发更蓬松自然
- 补光更均衡，面部受光更高级
- 背景更柔和，更有高级医美广告质感

【差异强化要求】
- 术前与术后差异必须“明显拉大”。
- 不要只是轻微修饰，不要只是简单磨皮。
- 要突出“鼻综合提升 + 轮廓优化 + 眼周年轻化 + 肤质提升”的综合医美变化。
- 前后差异应达到真实医美案例图的级别。
- 重点让观者一眼注意到：
  - 鼻子更高更精致
  - 脸更小更立体
  - 下颌线更清晰
  - 眼周更年轻
  - 皮肤更高级更干净
- 术前更普通，术后更精致、更上镜、更年轻，但仍然是同一个人。
- 保留人物原有身份特征，不要换脸，不要变成另一个人。
- 术后提升幅度可以比常规修图更大，但必须真实可信。

【文字与标注要求】
- 左侧所有标注文字必须是中文。
- 中文标注要简短清晰、专业易读。
- 标注排布整齐，避免遮挡关键五官。
- 不要出现乱码，不要出现错误文字。
- 左侧有红色分析标注，右侧无标注。

【风格要求】
- 真实摄影风
- 高清人像
- 专业医美案例展示风
- 高级、干净、简洁
- 像正规整形机构宣传案例图
- 不是插画，不是漫画，不是概念图

【负面要求】
- 不要漫画风
- 不要插画风
- 不要夸张畸形整容
- 不要整成网红假脸
- 不要塑料皮肤
- 不要过度磨皮
- 不要AI感过强
- 不要让术后变成完全不同的人
- 不要低清晰度
- 不要普通拼图感
- 不要额外说明文字
- 不要复杂杂乱背景
- 不要出现英文字标注
- 不要文字乱码

【最终输出要求】
只输出一张左右双栏医美整容前后对比蓝图成图：
- 左侧：“术前分析”——未经修饰的术前原始人像 + 红色医美分析标注 + 中文修整指令
- 右侧：“术后效果”——明显改善后的自然真实术后人像
最终效果必须真实、高清、专业、高级，并且前后差异显著，一眼可见整容医美前后变化。

prompts.text: Create a high-contrast, cinematic graphic design poster inspired by the TV series Breaking Bad, featuring a 2x6 vertical grid of twelve distinct title-card panels showcasing iconic characters from the show. The aesthetic should blend Urban Grunge with crime-thriller intensity, using distressed textures, film grain, and bold typography masking effects. Each panel should prominently feature a massive extra-bold sans-serif name such as WALT, JESSE, SAUL, GUS, MIKE, HANK, SKYLER, TUCO, HECTOR, LYDIA, TODD, and JANE, with the character portrait visible only inside the filled letterforms using a clipping/masking silhouette-window effect. Add smaller cinematic credit text beside or below the names in clean typography, such as “AS HEISENBERG”, “THE LAWYER”, or “THE FIXER.” Characters should have gritty, realistic portraits with intense or emotionless expressions, featuring iconic looks: Walter White in hat/glasses, Jesse Pinkman in hoodie/beanie, Saul Goodman in flashy suit, Gus Fring in formal attire, Mike Ehrmantraut bald with stern face, and Hank in DEA style. Use high-contrast dramatic studio lighting with rim lights and shadows; selectively add green chemical-lab glow, neon cyan, magenta, and amber highlights to certain cards. Backgrounds in each panel should feel unique but cohesive: weathered concrete, rusted metal, cracked walls, wrinkled paper, and smoky meth-lab atmospheres. Overlay heavy ink splatters, paint drips, brush strokes, scratches, scan lines, dust, film burns, and grain for a distressed cinematic look. The overall palette should use dark green, toxic neon lime, monochrome greys, deep charcoals, dirty yellows, and off-whites, with accent pops like a glowing green haze behind Walter, red-orange behind Tuco, blue meth-crystal highlights around Jesse, and sterile white tones around Lydia. The final result should look like a premium Netflix-style crime drama cast poster with a raw, edgy, highly stylized graphic design aesthetic.

prompts.text: 创建一张高对比度、电影级的平面设计海报，灵感来自电视剧《绝命毒师》，采用2x6垂直网格排列的十二个独特的标题卡片面板，展示剧中的标志性角色。美学风格应将都市粗犷与犯罪惊悚的紧张感相融合，使用做旧纹理、胶片颗粒和粗体排版遮罩效果。每个面板应突出显示一个巨大的超粗无衬线名字，例如WALT、JESSE、SAUL、GUS、MIKE、HANK、SKYLER、TUCO、HECTOR、LYDIA、TODD和JANE，角色肖像仅在使用剪切/遮罩剪影窗口效果的填充字形内部可见。在名字旁边或下方使用简洁的排版添加较小的电影演职员表文本，例如“AS HEISENBERG”、“THE LAWYER”或“THE FIXER”。角色应具有粗犷、写实的肖像，带有强烈或面无表情的神态，展现标志性外观：戴着帽子/眼镜的沃尔特·怀特，穿着连帽衫/毛线帽的杰西·平克曼，穿着浮夸西装的索尔·古德曼，穿着正式服装的格斯·弗林，光头且面容严肃的迈克·埃曼特拉特，以及DEA风格的汉克。使用高对比度的戏剧性影棚照明，带有边缘光和阴影；有选择性地为某些卡片添加绿色化学实验室发光、霓虹青色、洋红色和琥珀色高光。每个面板中的背景应该感觉独特但又协调统一：风化的混凝土、生锈的金属、破裂的墙壁、起皱的纸张和烟雾弥漫的制毒实验室氛围。叠加浓重的墨水飞溅、油漆滴落、笔触、划痕、扫描线、灰尘、胶片烧伤和颗粒，以营造做旧的电影感外观。整体调色板应使用深绿色、有毒的霓虹青柠色、单色灰色、深炭色、脏黄色和灰白色，并带有点缀的流行色，例如沃尔特背后发光的绿色薄雾、图科背后的红橙色、杰西周围的蓝色冰毒晶体高光，以及莉迪亚周围的无菌白色调。最终结果应该看起来像一张高级的Netflix风格犯罪剧情剧集海报，具有原始、前卫、高度风格化的平面设计美学。

prompts.text:
A hyperrealistic Nike sneaker advertisement shot in a dark, moody editorial style. A male leg wearing crisp white athletic crew socks with subtle Nike logo detail is suspended mid-air against a near-black charcoal background, angled diagonally toward the camera at a bold 45-degree perspective. The sneaker — a Nike low-top silhouette featuring a clean two-tone colorway of glacier teal suede panels and off-white tumbled leather, with an iridescent chrome Swoosh catching ambient light — dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The composition uses shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the shoe and soft blur on the upper leg. The background is layered with subtle urban texture - faint graffiti strokes in electric yellow and muted olive, barely visible through a heavy dark vignette. Multiple rows of ultra-small all-caps typographic text orbit the sneaker at different angles, reading phrases like "THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF" - evoking motion, speed, and energy. Some text runs vertically, some at 30-degree angles, giving the composition a chaotic yet intentional graphic design feeling.
At the upper right, the bold Nike wordmark and Swoosh logo appear in clean white against the dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation-style text bar reads: "PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW" in spaced all-caps serif font. A large, commanding headline is placed center-right in contrasting weight typography - "MOVE" in massive ultra-bold white letters followed by "BEYOND" in lighter weight, creating dramatic type hierarchy.
Small yellow plus (+) symbols and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the composition as accent details, adding a contemporary graphic zine aesthetic. Bottom left features a bold brand slogan lockup: "DEFINE YOUR STRIDE" in large bold sans-serif white text with a thin subline: "An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional - a single cold key light from the left, causing the Swoosh to shimmer and the white leather to glow against the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution, 3:4 vertical format optimized for social media.

prompts.text:
一张以暗黑、情绪化社论风格拍摄的超写实耐克运动鞋广告。一条穿着挺括白色运动船袜且带有微妙耐克标志细节的男性腿部在接近黑色的炭灰色背景下悬停在半空中，以大胆的45度视角斜向镜头。这双运动鞋——一款耐克低帮轮廓，采用冰川蓝绿麂皮面板和灰白翻毛皮的干净双色调配色，带有捕捉环境光的虹彩铬色Swoosh标志——占据了画面的下半部分三分之二。
构图使用浅景深，鞋子保持清晰对焦，大腿部分呈现柔和模糊。背景分层带有微妙的都市质感——电黄色和柔和橄榄色的隐约涂鸦笔触，透过浓重的暗角几乎难以察觉。多行超小的全大写字体排版文本以不同角度环绕运动鞋，阅读诸如"THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"之类的短语——唤起运动、速度和能量。一些文字垂直排列，一些以30度角排列，赋予构图一种混乱却刻意的平面设计感觉。
在右上方，醒目的耐克字标和Swoosh标志在深色背景下以纯净的白色出现。在顶部中心，一个细长的水平导航风格文本栏显示："PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW"，采用间距较大的全大写衬线字体。一个庞大且引人注目的标题放置在中心偏右侧，采用对比字重排版——"MOVE"以巨大的超粗体白色字母呈现，随后是较细字重的"BEYOND"，创造出戏剧性的字体层级。
小黄色加号（+）符号和对角线箭头（↗）散布在整个构图中作为点缀细节，增添了当代平面杂志的美学感。左下角展示了醒目的品牌标语组合："DEFINE YOUR STRIDE"以大号粗体无衬线白色文本呈现，配有一条细副标题："An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." 整体光线具有戏剧性和方向性——来自左侧的一盏冷色调主灯，导致Swoosh标志闪烁，白色皮革在黑暗中发光。照片写实。商业摄影质量。高对比度。4K分辨率，3:4垂直格式，针对社交媒体进行了优化。

items.title: 云海坠落的巨神与巫女

prompts.text: A stunning anime theatrical movie poster in portrait format. Studio Ghibli meets Makoto Shinkai visual language. A teenage girl in a tattered white shrine maiden robe stands on the wing of a crumbling giant stone deity — an ancient colossus covered in moss and glowing golden kanji script, slowly falling through a sea of clouds. Her long black hair streams upward against gravity. She reaches one hand toward the sky where a vast celestial rift tears open the heavens — beyond it, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, ancient wooden cities hanging upside down from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from deep twilight blue at the bottom to a luminous peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric god rays pierce through cloud layers. Cherry blossom petals and torn paper talismans spiral everywhere. Her expression is calm determination. Art style: hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive linework, rich cel shading. Palette: deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. Title in large elegant Japanese kanji at the bottom with English subtitle beneath in a clean modern font. Tagline in small white italic text above the title. Mood: mythological, spiritual, bittersweet wonder. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

items.title: 现代手冲咖啡信息图

prompts.text: Ultra-clean modern editorial infographic on the topic of a [POUR-OVER COFFEE BREWING] routine. Hero visual: a stylized flat-lay or floating arrangement of 3–4 objects (a ceramic V60 dripper, a matte black gooseneck kettle, and scattered roasted coffee beans) — slightly angled or in soft perspective, glowing subtly. Ingredients Section: Label it ‘What You Need’ — include 6–8 items with small icons next to each (e.g., '15g single-origin beans', '250ml water at 93°C'). Arranged in a cluster connected visually to the hero. Steps Section: 5–6 numbered panels with arrows or connecting lines forming a logical flow. Each step has a short action label and a small relevant icon. Panels use glassmorphism or frosted card styling. Stats Badges: 4–5 floating pill-shaped badges showing relevant metadata — total brew time, extraction yield, flavor profile, caffeine hit — displayed as clean minimal bubbles. Visual Style: Artisan, warm editorial background — roasted brown, oat cream, or soft copper tones. Rich espresso accent colors. Bold modern sans-serif typography. Clean vector icons. Subtle grain or filter-paper texture. Composition: Hero object cluster centered or slightly offset. Ingredients on one side. Steps flow opposite or below with connecting lines. Stat badges scattered as floating pills. Generous negative space. Lighting: Soft, warm morning cafe light feel emanating from the hero cluster. Premium lifestyle editorial aesthetic, social-feed optimized. Ultra-crisp. No watermark.

items.title: 海贼王双重曝光情感电影海报

prompts.text:
Create a cinematic character poster using a double exposure composition as the foundation, with the visual quality of AAA game key art, and the emotional soul of “One Piece” centered around friendship, journey, and destiny.

The poster must feel deeply emotional—capturing the spirit of “nakama” (crew bonds), freedom, sacrifice, and dreams.

Feature a large, elegant silhouette of [CHARACTER NAME]’s face (slightly looking upward or sideways with a soft, determined expression) dominating the composition. His expression should feel emotional yet strong—hopeful, nostalgic, and full of resolve.

Inside and around this silhouette, create layered scenes that represent his journey with his crew:
- The Straw Hat crew standing together on the Thousand Sunny
- Moments of laughter, adventure, and struggle
- Subtle references to past arcs (islands, battles, sunsets, ocean horizons)
- [CHARACTER NAME] reaching forward or standing at the front of the ship
- A symbolic path toward the horizon (his dream)

Use a near-large, far-small composition with slight ultra-wide perspective for depth.

Character Design:
- [CHARACTER NAME] reimagined in hyper-realistic 3D human form
- Adult version with an athletic, lean but powerful physique
- Retain iconic features: straw hat, scar under eye, open shirt, shorts
- Skin: highly detailed, natural texture
- Clothing: cinematic realism with subtle wear from adventure

Emotion & Pose:
- Calm but powerful stance
- Slight smile or emotional gaze
- Body language showing leadership and connection
- One hand holding the straw hat or reaching forward

Story Integration:
- Ocean waves blending into the silhouette
- Warm sunset sky symbolizing hope and journey
- Soft glowing light around crew members
- Subtle Haki aura (not aggressive, more spiritual)
- Wind flowing through clothing and environment

Lighting & Color:
- Golden hour / sunset lighting (warm orange, soft blue contrast)
- Soft cinematic glow
- Gentle highlights and shadows for emotional depth
- Slight haze or atmospheric fog for dreamlike effect

Style:
- Cinematic
- Emotional
- Epic but intimate
- Hyper-realistic 3D with soft artistic blending

Final Output:
- Vertical 3:4 movie-style poster
- Ultra high detail, 4K–8K resolution
- Clean, dramatic composition that tells a story at a glance

items.title: 东方玄学命理深度解析图

prompts.text:
Please based on the [hand photo / face photo / hand and face combination photo] I uploaded, create a high-completion, well-designed, shareable "Oriental Metaphysics Analysis Report Image".

This is not an ordinary photo description, nor is it simple entertainment fortune-telling, but a visual analysis image combining [traditional Chinese palmistry, physiognomy, I Ching Five Elements, and Traditional Chinese Medicine observation of Qi and complexion theories]. The overall image should present a feeling of "fortune teller analysis report + ancient metaphysics annotations + high-end visual poster", allowing users to intuitively see key features, corresponding explanations, and trend warnings.

[Recognition and Analysis Requirements]

Please first determine what is contained in the image:
1. Hand: Focus on analyzing palm prints, palm mounts, hand shape, finger shape, finger joints, fingerprint trends, life line, wisdom line, emotion line, career line, wealth line, and other visible features.
2. Face: Focus on analyzing forehead, eyebrows and eyes, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, nasolabial folds, mouth shape, chin, facial contours, Qi and complexion, facial feature proportions, and overall demeanor.
3. If both hand and face are included, please analyze comprehensively, do not pile up repetitively, and form a unified judgment.

Please extract at least [10 key analysis points], each analysis point must include:
- Visible features: Point out the specific location or shape that can be seen in the photo.
- Metaphysical explanation: Analyze combining palmistry, physiognomy, I Ching Five Elements, or traditional fate language.
- Trend prompt: Express using "tends to, easily, needs attention, suitable for, may in the near future" and other ways.
- Action suggestion: Give a practically executable reminder, such as emotion management, work and rest, career rhythm, interpersonal relationships, financial planning, etc.

[Annotation Requirements]

Please use clear lines, arrows, circles, or numbered labels in the image to indicate each key position:
- Palmistry charts can annotate: life line, wisdom line, emotion line, career line, palm mounts, finger joints, base of the thumb, index finger length, ring finger proportion, palm line intersection points, etc.
- Physiognomy charts can annotate: forehead, eyebrows and eyes, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, nasolabial folds, corners of the mouth, chin, ear shape, facial middle third, Qi and complexion areas, etc.
- Each annotation point is numbered with 01, 02, 03..., corresponding to the analysis explanation on the right or below.
- Lines should be delicate, elegant, not messy, and not block the main subject.

[Visual Style]

The overall style should conform to the tone of Oriental metaphysics, fate reading, palmistry, and physiognomy:
- Main color tone: off-white, Xuan paper color, with accents: deep ink black, mystic cyan, antique bronze gold, dark red.
- Style temperament: mysterious, restrained, high-end, ancient book feel, fate report feel.
- Light elements can be added: Bagua patterns, compass scales, Five Elements symbols, ancient book borders, astrological chart thin lines, cinnabar seals, Xuan paper textures.
- Do not make it horror style, vulgar fortune-telling stall style, and do not make it overly cyberpunk.
- The layout should be like a high-end magazine infographic, not a messy screenshot.

[Layout Design]
Make the aspect ratio 3:4

Layout structure suggestions:
1. Top: Title area
   The title can be "Palmistry and Physiognomy Metaphysics Analysis Report", "Oriental Fate Feature Interpretation", "Palm Print and Physiognomy Trend Observation", etc., which should match the content of the photo uploaded by the user.
2. Middle: Main photo analysis area
   Keep the hand or face as the main subject, adding numbers, arrows, and key line annotations.
3. Side or bottom: Ten-point analysis area
   Each point uses a short title + 2-3 lines of explanation, do not make the text too small.
4. Bottom: Comprehensive conclusion area
   Summarize this person's personality tendencies, career and wealth, interpersonal emotions, health and work-rest, and recent reminders.

[Content Tone]

The analysis language should have a traditional metaphysical flavor, but not be absolute, do not say "definitely", "will definitely get rich", "will definitely have a disaster".
Can use:
- "This line pattern shows that the person mostly..."
- "From the perspective of the Five Elements weather, it leans towards..."
- "If the lines here are obvious, it usually represents..."
- "Recently need to pay attention to..."
- "Suitable to go in the... direction"
- "Suggest making adjustments in... aspects"

[Output Goal]

Please finally generate a complete visual analysis image, containing at least 10 numbered analysis points.
The overall image should let people see at a glance "where has been analyzed, what meaning it corresponds to, what reminders there are", having both a metaphysical atmosphere and professional layout and high-end design sense.

Note:
- Only analyze based on visible features in the image, do not fabricate invisible information.
- Do not make medical diagnoses, do not give disease conclusions; Traditional Chinese Medicine Qi and complexion content is only used as a life reminder from the perspective of traditional culture.
- Do not appear too many small characters, ensure it can be read clearly on a mobile phone.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请根据我上传的【手部照片 / 面部照片 / 手脸组合照片】，创作一张高完成度、有设计感、适合分享的「东方玄学分析报告图」。

这不是普通的照片说明，也不是简单的娱乐占卜，而是一张结合【中国传统手相、面相、易经五行、中医望诊气色理论】的视觉化分析图。整体应呈现出“命理师分析报告 + 古籍玄学注解 + 高级视觉海报”的感觉，让用户能直观看到关键特征、对应解释和趋势预警。

【识别与分析要求】

请先判断图片中包含的是：
1. 手部：重点分析掌纹、掌丘、手型、指形、指节、指纹走势、生命线、智慧线、感情线、事业线、财运线等可见特征。
2. 面部：重点分析额头、眉眼、鼻梁、颧骨、法令、嘴型、下巴、面部轮廓、气色、五官比例与整体神态。
3. 如果同时包含手和脸，请综合分析，不要重复堆砌，要形成统一判断。

请至少提炼【10个关键分析点】，每个分析点都要包括：
- 可见特征：指出照片中能看到的具体位置或形态。
- 玄学解释：结合手相、面相、易经五行或传统命理语言进行分析。
- 趋势提示：用“倾向于、容易、需要注意、适合、未来一段时间可能”等方式表达。
- 行动建议：给出一句现实可执行的提醒，例如情绪管理、作息、事业节奏、人际关系、财务规划等。

【标注要求】

请在图片中使用清晰的线条、箭头、圆圈或编号标签，标明每个关键位置：
- 手相图可标注：生命线、智慧线、感情线、事业线、掌丘、指节、拇指根部、食指长度、无名指比例、掌心纹路交汇点等。
- 面相图可标注：额头、眉眼、鼻梁、颧骨、法令纹、嘴角、下巴、耳形、面部中庭、气色区域等。
- 每个标注点用 01、02、03……编号，对应右侧或下方的分析说明。
- 线条要细致、优雅，不要杂乱，不要遮挡主体。

【视觉风格】

整体风格要符合东方玄学、命理、手相、面相的调性：
- 主色调：米白、宣纸色，点缀：深墨黑、玄青、古铜金、暗红
- 风格气质：神秘、克制、高级、古籍感、命理报告感。
- 可加入轻微元素：八卦纹、罗盘刻度、五行符号、古籍边框、星盘细线、朱砂印章、宣纸纹理。
- 不要做成恐怖风、低俗算命摊风，也不要过度赛博朋克。
- 排版要像高级杂志信息图，而不是杂乱截图。

【版式设计】
Make the aspect ratio 3:4

版面结构建议：
1. 顶部：标题区  
   标题可为「手相面相玄学分析报告」「东方命理特征解读」「掌纹与面相趋势观察」等，要符合用户上传的图片内容。
2. 中间：主体照片分析区  
   保留手部或脸部主体，加入编号、箭头和关键线条标注。
3. 侧边或下方：十点分析区  
   每一点用简短标题 + 2-3行说明，不要文字太小。
4. 底部：综合结论区  
   总结此人的性格倾向、事业财运、人际情感、健康作息和近期提醒。

【内容语气】

分析语言要有传统玄学味道，但不要绝对化，不要说“必定”“一定会发财”“一定有灾”。  
可以使用：
- “此纹路显示其人多半……”
- “从五行气象看，偏向……”
- “此处若纹路明显，通常代表……”
- “近期需要留意……”
- “适合走……方向”
- “建议在……方面做调整”

【输出目标】

请最终生成一张完整的视觉分析图，至少包含10个编号分析点。  
整体要让人一眼看出“哪里被分析了、对应什么含义、有什么提醒”，既有玄学氛围，又有专业排版和高级设计感。

注意：
- 只基于图片中可见特征分析，不要编造看不见的信息。
- 不做医学诊断，不给出疾病结论；中医气色内容只作为传统文化角度的生活提醒。
- 不要出现过多小字，确保手机上也能清楚阅读。

prompts.text:
Create a high-quality visual work with an **architectural designer's hand-drawn style**, showcasing **architectural details**, **structure**, **technical measurements**, and **cultural background**. The work should be a perfect combination full of **artistry** and **knowledgeability**. The overall style should retain the **sense of freedom of hand-drawn sketches**, while focusing on details and measurements, similar to the **original manuscripts of architectural masters**, such as the works of Lin Huiyin or internationally renowned architects.

### I. Overall Style:
- The overall work is **hand-drawn style + architectural measurement and technical annotation**, full of freehand lines and artistic sense. Through **rough lines**, **imperfect details**, and **measurement numbers and units**, the work reflects the structural beauty and design intent of the architecture.
- The picture needs to reflect the **randomness of hand-drawn sketches**, without being too refined, but must retain the authenticity and technicality of architectural design. Every architectural detail (such as roofs, pillars, carvings, etc.) should have clear measurements and technical annotations, presenting both the exterior appearance of the architecture and revealing the internal structure and design concepts.

### II. Core Composition Logic:
- The **core visual subject** of the work should unfold in a **diagonal way**, ensuring the composition has **fluidity and tension**. The structure of the architecture, every angle, dimensional proportions, and other content should unfold naturally, constructing a visual long scroll of **information flow**.
- It is necessary to use details such as **dimension rulers** and **units** for annotation, making the proportions, spatial relationships, and design details of each part of the architecture clear at a glance.
- **Architectural details**, **structural design**, **material application**, etc., should be presented through freehand brushstrokes, while adding **precise technical annotations**, forming a perfect fusion of art and technology.

### III. Measurement and Technical Details:
- Every **architectural detail** should have clear measurement annotations, and **dimensions**, **units**, **proportions**, etc., should be annotated in detail at the key parts of the architecture.
- **Technical details** such as the diameter of pillars, the length of beams, the angle of the roof, etc., should be clearly displayed, accompanied by annotations of **building materials**, so that every architectural part has detailed **technical descriptions**.
- In the picture, use **ruler lines** to ensure the accuracy of the architecture, while maintaining the freedom of hand-drawing.

### IV. Background and Negative Space:
- The background should be a **simple off-white** or **light gray tone**, with a slight **handmade paper texture**, presenting the texture of **high-end handmade paper**, without interfering with the main architectural body. The background tone should have a **rough feel**, but ensure a good **contrast ratio** with the text, making the text clear and readable.
- It is necessary to retain a large area of **negative space**, which not only provides a sense of space but also helps to highlight every detail of the architecture, focusing the audience's attention on the architecture itself. The use of negative space should have a sense of rhythm and visual hierarchy.

### V. Text and Typography:
- The text information must be naturally integrated with the architectural elements in the picture, and the text such as annotations, rulers, and technical instructions should be **clear and readable**.
- **Language adaptation**: Automatically select Chinese or English as the explanatory text according to the user's input language. For example, if the input is Chinese, all annotations and knowledge points should be presented in Chinese, and vice versa.
- **Annotation content** needs to include the **historical background**, **cultural symbolism**, **technical features**, **design concepts**, etc., of the architecture, and be presented through **clear typography**. The text typography should echo the architectural graphics, avoiding interference with the main content.

### VI. Material and Color Scheme of Pinyin/English Large Text:
- **Pinyin or English large text title** serves as the core text of the picture, displaying the name of the architecture.
- The large text title should have a **hot stamping texture**, **metal material sense**, or **relief effect**, displaying a **sense of high class** and **exquisite printing effect**.
- **Color tone** can adopt **metallic colors**, **champagne gold**, **platinum**, etc., displaying the high-end sense and exquisite sense of the architecture.

### VII. Surrounding Information and Knowledge Points:
- The surroundings of the picture should contain **relevant knowledge points** of the architecture, including the **historical background**, **cultural value**, **technical innovation**, **design philosophy**, etc., of the architecture.
- This information should be presented in an **artistic typography method**, **avoiding lengthy text stacking**, but rather being **concise and valuable**, providing an in-depth understanding of the architecture.
- The **integration of information and architectural details** should have a sense of rhythm, with text and architectural graphics naturally intertwining to form an organic whole.

### VIII. Overall Temperament Goal:
- The picture should present a fusion of **architectural artistry** and **technicality**, ensuring that the hand-drawn style does not lose the accuracy of the architecture, while simultaneously displaying the spirit and structural beauty of the architecture.
- The work should have a strong **academic and cultural nature**, capable of serving as a **classic display** of architectural design, while also possessing the collection value of an artwork.
- The overall atmosphere should be warm, free, and full of creativity, without losing the rigor of structure and the richness of details, suitable for **teaching and display use**.

### IX. Problems to Avoid:
- Avoid **overly refined drawing**, maintaining the natural and rough feel of hand-drawing.
- Do not let the text interfere with the visual expression of the architecture; the **text should be concise and precise**, without stacking too much information.
- **Measurement annotations** and **annotation text** must ensure **clear and easy readability**, and cannot be blurred.

### X. Final Goal:
Create an architectural hand-drawn work combining **artistry and technicality**, through detailed **measurement annotations**, **technical annotations**, and **cultural descriptions**, presenting all aspects of the architecture, making it both possess high-end artistry and capable of serving as **professional materials for teaching use**.
This work will display the history, structure, and design philosophy of the architecture, with a **freehand drawing style**, while ensuring the **clear display** of knowledge points.

prompts.text:
创作一张具有**建筑设计师手绘风格**的高质量视觉作品，展现**建筑细节**、**结构**、**技术测量**以及**文化背景**，作品应充满**艺术性**与**知识性**的完美结合。整体风格应保留**手绘草图的自由感**，同时注重细节和测量，类似**建筑大师原稿**，如林徽因或国际知名建筑师的作品。

### 一、整体风格：
- 整体作品为**手绘风格 + 建筑测量与技术标注**，充满自由的手绘线条和艺术感。通过**粗犷的线条**、**不完美的细节**以及**测量数字与单位**，让作品体现建筑的结构美感和设计意图。  
- 画面中需体现出**手绘草图的随机感**，不必过于精细，但必须保留建筑设计的真实性与技术性。每个建筑细节（如屋顶、柱子、雕刻等）都应该有清晰的测量和技术注释，既呈现建筑外观，又揭示内部结构与设计理念。

### 二、核心构图逻辑：
- 作品的**核心视觉主体**应通过**对角线的方式**展开，确保构图具有**流动性和张力**。建筑的结构、每个角度、尺寸比例等内容都应该自然展开，构建起**信息流动**的视觉长卷。  
- 需要用**尺寸标尺**、**单位**等细节标注，使得建筑的各部分比例、空间关系、设计细节一目了然。  
- **建筑的细节**、**结构设计**、**材料运用**等要通过自由的手绘笔触呈现，同时加上**精确的技术标注**，形成艺术与技术的完美融合。

### 三、测量与技术细节：
- 每个**建筑细节**都应该有明确的测量标注，**尺寸**、**单位**、**比例**等要详细标注在建筑的关键部分。  
- **技术性细节**如柱子的直径、梁的长度、屋顶的角度等要清晰显示，配合**建筑材料**的标注，使得每个建筑部分都有详细的**技术描述**。  
- 在画面中，使用**标尺线条**来确保建筑的精确性，同时保持手绘的自由感。

### 四、背景与留白：
- 背景应为**简约的米白色**或**浅灰色调**，带有轻微的**手工纸纹理**，呈现**高档手工纸的质感**，不干扰建筑主体。背景色调应具有**粗糙感**，但保证与文字之间有良好的**对比度**，使文字清晰可读。  
- 需要保留大面积**留白**，这种留白既提供空间感，也帮助突出建筑的每个细节，使观众的注意力聚焦在建筑本身。留白的使用应富有节奏感和视觉层次感。

### 五、文字与排版：
- 文字信息必须与画面中的建筑元素自然融合，注释、标尺、技术说明等文字要**清晰可读**。  
- **语言适配**：根据用户的输入语言，自动选择中文或英文作为解释文字。例如，若输入为中文，则所有注释和知识点都应呈现为中文，反之则为英文。  
- **注释内容**需包括建筑的**历史背景**、**文化象征**、**技术特色**、**设计理念**等，并通过**清晰的排版**呈现。文字排版要与建筑图形呼应，避免干扰主体内容。

### 六、拼音/英文大字的材质与配色：
- **拼音或英文大字标题**作为画面的核心文字，展现建筑名称。  
- 大字标题应具有**烫印质感**、**金属材质感**或**浮雕效果**，展现**高级感**和**精致的印刷效果**。  
- **色调**可以采用**金属色**、**香槟金**、**铂金**等色调，展现建筑的高端感和精致感。

### 七、四周信息与知识点：
- 画面四周应包含建筑的**相关知识点**，包括建筑的**历史背景**、**文化价值**、**技术创新**、**设计哲学**等。  
- 这些信息要通过**艺术化的排版方式**呈现，**避免冗长的文字堆砌**，而是要**简洁而富有价值**，提供建筑的深度理解。  
- **信息与建筑细节的融合**应富有节奏感，文字与建筑图形自然交织，形成有机的整体。

### 八、整体气质目标：
- 画面应呈现**建筑艺术性**与**技术性**的融合，确保手绘风格不失建筑的精确度，同时展现建筑的精神与结构之美。  
- 作品应具有强烈的**学术性与文化性**，能够作为建筑设计的**经典展示**，同时具备艺术品的收藏价值。  
- 整体氛围应温暖、自由、充满创意，又不失结构的严谨和细节的丰富，适合**教学与展示使用**。

### 九、避免的问题：
- 避免**过于精细的绘制**，保持手绘的自然感和粗糙感。  
- 不要让文字干扰建筑的视觉表达，**文字应简洁而精确**，不堆砌过多信息。  
- **测量标注**和**注释文字**要保证**清晰易读**，不能模糊不清。

### 十、最终目标：
创作一张结合**艺术性与技术性的建筑手绘作品**，通过精细的**测量标注**、**技术注释**和**文化说明**，呈现建筑的各个方面，使其既具备高端艺术性，又能够作为**教学使用的专业资料**。  
这幅作品将展示建筑的历史、结构和设计哲学，带有**自由的手绘风格**，同时保证知识点的**清晰展示**。

prompts.text:
Generate a photo of steak and dessert in a British steakhouse style. Like a photo taken with a smartphone, suitable for posting on Instagram. No people. Then, observe the elements appearing in the photo and add meaningful hand-drawn annotations to each element. 
【Drawing Rules】

【Text Rules】
・English handwritten text

・Tone is "diary, one-liner, emotional outlet"
【Comment Generation Rules】
・Beverage → Taste, temperature, mood (Example: refreshing, gentle sweetness)
・Food → Texture, deliciousness (Example: moist, the best)
・Space → Atmosphere (Example: relaxing, wonderful time)
・Overall → One-line summary (Example: too happy~)
【Decorations】
・Moderately add steam, sparkles, hearts, small emojis, etc.
・Not excessive, leave "white space"
【Final Style】
・Instagram story style, rough note style of a magazine, stylish and relaxed atmosphere

items.title: 地景档案立体沙盘模型图

prompts.text:
Please create a high-completion, high-texture, suitable-for-series-release "Landscape Archive Model" visual image based on the 【Theme】.

This is not an ordinary map, nor an ordinary landscape illustration or city rendering, but a high-end archival visual image combining "2D map drawing + 3D regional model + professional explanation system + museum exhibition sense". The image needs to look like a real geographical research model, urban planning sandbox, architectural proposal model, or worldview setting exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, touchable high-end texture.

【Basic Settings】
Theme: 【Theme, for example Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing Mountain City / Island City / Ancient City Ruins / Post-Apocalyptic Ruins / Fantasy Continent / Game Main City】
Theme Type: 【Natural Landform / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape】
Core Subject: 【Core Subject, for example crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old city district, landmark cluster, island city, ruins cluster, main city area】
Content Focus: 【Content Focus, for example terrain elevation difference / urban landmarks / road network structure / water system relationship / nature and city relationship / setting collection display】
Style Direction: 【Style Direction, for example geographic mapping style, paper carving model style, architectural proposal style, museum archive style, urban planning style, game setting collection style】
Main Color Tone: 【Main Color Tone, for example off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand color, snow white】
Auxiliary Color: 【Auxiliary Color, for example earth brown, rock gray, cold gray, light blue, moss green】
Accent Color: 【Accent Color, for example black thin lines, red routes, blue hydrological lines, yellow numbered markers】
Aspect Ratio: 【Aspect Ratio, for example 16:9 horizontal / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 1:1 square】

【Image Structure】
The main body of the image is a rectangular map model board placed on a clean desktop or white cloth. The baseboard has real thickness, with cross-section structure visible at the edges, like an exquisite map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with clear but restrained information layers, including contour lines, road networks, hydrological lines, zoning boundaries, geographic textures, coordinate sense, slight annotations, and drawing borders.

In the center or off-center area of the map, a three-dimensional main model "grows" three-dimensionally from the two-dimensional map, becoming the visual core of the entire image.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Natural Landform:
The subject can be composed of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, coastlines, emphasizing terrain elevation differences, stacked contour line structures, rock wall textures, and natural landform undulations.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Urban Space:
The subject can be composed of core urban areas, CBDs, old city blocks, landmark building clusters, waterfront areas, road network nodes, bridges, water systems, park green spaces, emphasizing building volumes, city recognition, spatial layers, and planning structures.

If the 【Theme Type】 is Mixed Landscape:
It needs to simultaneously integrate natural terrain and artificially built environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient city ruins, post-apocalyptic ruins, fantasy main cities, sci-fi bases, allowing natural landforms and urban structures to jointly form the core visual.

【Detail Requirements】
- The model surface retains the sense of map drawing and professional information
- Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, depression and undulation relationships
- Building areas should have a sense of volume, block relationships, and clear layers
- Water areas are represented using low-saturation light blue
- Green spaces, forests, parks, and mountains can be represented using moss green or low-saturation green
- Road networks, paths, transportation axes, or exploration routes can be represented with thin lines, but must not overshadow the main subject
- If there are landmark buildings or key structures, they should have clear recognition
- If there are fantasy, sci-fi, or game setting elements, the archive model and drawing display sense must be retained, rather than making them into pure scene illustrations

【Explanation System】
The edges of the map board need to be designed with complete and restrained explanation modules, including:
- Outer frame line and inner frame line
- Scale bar
- Legend area
- Title area
- Archive number
- Index markers
- Annotation labels
- Concise symbol explanations
The text does not need to be fully readable, but the overall must present a real, clear, precise, orderly archival typographic structure.

【Composition and Camera】
Adopt an oblique overhead isometric or sandbox-style composition, with the camera observing the entire model board from about 30 to 45 degrees above, allowing the audience to simultaneously see the map plane, the three-dimensional main subject height, the edge thickness, and the explanation area. The visual center of gravity is concentrated on the central main model, and the reading path is: first look at the core subject, then look at the surrounding terrain/road network/water system/block information, and finally look at the legend, scale bar, and explanation area.

【Material and Lighting】
The overall needs to have a real model photography texture:
- Paper texture
- Map printing texture
- Paper carving or sandbox model sense
- Architectural model or terrain slice texture
- Soft natural light
- Delicate real shadows
- Clean background
- Low saturation, high-end, restrained
Avoid cartoonization, cheap game UI sense, excessive clutter, excessive showing off, focusing on highlighting the unified visual of "map baseboard + three-dimensional main subject + professional explanation system".

The final effect should look like a landscape archive model image that can be used for geography science popularization, urban research, architectural proposals, cultural tourism visual features, worldview setting collections, or high-end series covers.

prompts.text:
请根据【主题】创作一张高完成度、高质感、适合系列化发布的「地景档案模型 / Landscape Archive Model」视觉图。

这不是普通地图，也不是普通风景插画或城市效果图，而是一张结合“二维地图图纸 + 三维立体区域模型 + 专业说明系统 + 博物馆展陈感”的高端档案式视觉图。画面需要像一件被真实制作出来的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑提案模型或世界观设定展品，具有专业、克制、精密、可触摸的高级质感。

【基础设定】
主题：【主题，例如火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆山城 / 海岛城市 / 古城遗址 / 末日废墟 / 幻想大陆 / 游戏主城】
主题类型：【自然地貌 / 城市空间 / 混合景观】
核心主体：【核心主体，例如火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗址群、主城区域】
内容重点：【内容重点，例如地形高差 / 城市地标 / 路网结构 / 水系关系 / 自然与城市关系 / 设定集展示】
风格方向：【风格方向，例如地理测绘风、纸雕模型风、建筑提案风、博物馆档案风、城市规划风、游戏设定集风】
主色调：【主色调，例如米白、浅灰、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白】
辅助色：【辅助色，例如土褐、岩灰、冷灰、淡蓝、苔绿】
点缀色：【点缀色，例如黑色细线、红色路线、蓝色水文线、黄色编号标记】
画幅比例：【画幅比例，例如16:9横版 / 3:4竖版 / 4:5竖版 / 1:1方图】

【画面结构】
画面主体是一块放置在干净桌面或白色布面上的矩形地图模型板。底板具有真实厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，像一块精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、道路网络、水文线、分区边界、地理纹理、坐标感、轻微标注和图纸边框。

在地图中央或偏中心区域，从二维地图中立体“生长”出一个三维主体模型，成为整张图的视觉核心。

如果【主题类型】为自然地貌：
主体可由山体、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层、海岸线等构成，强调地形高差、层叠等高线结构、岩壁纹理和自然地貌起伏。

如果【主题类型】为城市空间：
主体可由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标建筑群、滨水区、路网节点、桥梁、水系、公园绿地等构成，强调建筑体块、城市识别度、空间层次与规划结构。

如果【主题类型】为混合景观：
需同时整合自然地形与人工建成环境，例如山城、海岛城市、古城遗址、末日废墟、幻想主城、科幻基地等，让自然地貌与城市结构共同构成核心视觉。

【细节要求】
- 模型表面保留地图图纸感与专业信息感
- 地形区域应有等高线、坡面层次、凹陷与起伏关系
- 建筑区域应有体块感、街区关系和清晰层次
- 水域使用低饱和淡蓝色表现
- 绿地、森林、公园、山体可用苔绿色或低饱和绿色表现
- 路网、路径、交通轴线或探索线路可用细线表现，但不要喧宾夺主
- 若有地标建筑或重点结构，应具备明确识别度
- 若有幻想、科幻或游戏设定元素，应保留档案模型和图纸展示感，而不是做成纯场景插画

【说明系统】
地图板边缘需要设计完整而克制的说明模块，包括：
- 外框线和内框线
- 比例尺
- 图例区
- 标题区
- 档案编号
- 索引标记
- 注释标签
- 简洁的符号说明
文字不必全部可读，但整体必须呈现真实、清晰、精密、有秩序的档案式排版结构。

【构图与镜头】
采用斜俯视等轴测或沙盘式构图，镜头从上方约30到45度观察整块模型板，让观众同时看到地图平面、立体主体高度、边缘厚度和说明区。视觉重心集中在中央主体模型，阅读路径为：先看核心主体，再看周边地形/路网/水系/街区信息，最后看图例、比例尺和说明区。

【材质与光影】
整体需要具有真实模型摄影质感：
- 纸张纹理
- 地图印刷质感
- 纸雕或沙盘模型感
- 建筑模型或地形切片质感
- 柔和自然光
- 细腻真实阴影
- 干净背景
- 低饱和、高级、克制
避免卡通化、廉价游戏UI感、过度杂乱、过度炫技，重点突出“地图底板 + 立体主体 + 专业说明系统”的统一视觉。

最终效果应像一张可以用于地理科普、城市研究、建筑提案、文旅视觉专题、世界观设定集或高端系列封面的地景档案模型图。

items.title: 一张具有收藏价值设计师海报

prompts.text:
创作一张具有收藏价值、设计师海报气质与作者性审美的高完成度视觉作品。

整体风格为：油画风格 + 大师级排版文字设计。
画面需具有明显的厚涂技法质感，通过厚薄差异塑造立体感、材料感、节奏感与视觉层次，既有绘画肌理，又有现代设计感与展览级海报气质。

一、核心构图逻辑
采用居中偏斜的对角线主构图。
整张海报的核心视觉主体，不是缩在中间的一小团，而是由一条沿对角线方向大幅展开的不规则综合色带 / 图示承载区构成。
这条综合色带必须从画面一个对角方向自然延伸至另一个对角方向，形成近似贯穿全版的斜向视觉骨架，具备足够的长度、面积、张力与版面统摄力。
它必须舒展、大气、完整，不可局促，不可收缩成中间一坨，不可导致版面显得逼仄、狭窄、拘谨。

这条综合色带既像厚涂油彩横扫而成的一道主笔触，又像被提炼后的主题地貌、信息地带、文化切片或视觉载体。
综合色带的配色不能写死，必须根据用户最后输入的【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】自动判断。
可以从该主题最典型的印象色、文化色、环境色、建筑色、情绪色中提炼出 2-3 种主色，形成高级且有层次的综合色关系。
例如可以呈现类似“紫金蓝”“赭红青”“墨绿金”“灰粉褐”等综合色逻辑，但具体色彩必须智能适配输入内容本身，而不是固定模板。

二、主体内容生成逻辑
在这条沿对角线展开的综合色带之上，承载与用户输入强相关的核心视觉内容。

如果输入的是城市：
自动提炼该城市最具辨识度的地标、建筑、名胜、水系、人文空间、历史象征、城市记忆、代表性文化元素等。

如果输入的是对象、主题或灵感：
自动提炼最有代表性的核心元素、关键场景、象征物、结构信息、文化线索、概念意象或视觉母题。

这些内容不要做成写实堆砌，不要像旅游宣传页素材拼贴，不要杂乱罗列。
必须以“极简俯视图 / 高度概括的图形化俯瞰景观 / 设计化地图感构成 / 信息化景观”的方式进行整合。
让它们像被压缩、提炼、嵌入在这条对角线综合色带之中，形成统一、克制、连续、有秩序的主图示系统。
图示区域内部必须具有连续性、流动性与整体性，让不同元素沿对角线方向自然展开、串联、过渡、呼应，形成类似视觉长卷般的观感。
不要中间挤、两头空，不要让主体断裂，不要把视觉重点缩在局部。

三、背景与留白
背景统一为米白色、暖白色或带轻微旧纸质感的纹理纸质背景。
纸面要有自然纸张纤维感、细腻颗粒感、轻微手工纸或高档印刷纸肌理。
整体背景必须干净、克制、安静，不要过度装饰，不要复杂花纹干扰主体。
必须保留大面积留白，但这种留白不是空洞无力，而是服务于对角线主结构的高级留白。
留白应让主体更突出，也让文字排版拥有足够的呼吸感、空间感、展览感与版式张力。

四、文字系统与版式逻辑
文字系统必须是整张海报的重要组成部分，而不是后贴上的说明文字。
整体文字原则上采用衬线体系统，体现高级、克制、经典、文化感、设计感兼具的大师级排版效果。
标题、主文案、副文案、知识点信息、小标注、注释性小字之间必须有清晰层级，并通过字号、疏密、错落、对齐、留白、聚散、呼应来形成真正的版式节奏。

必须明确版式优先级：
沿对角线大幅展开的综合色带 / 图示主体，是整张海报的第一视觉骨架与主叙事通道，优先级高于普通文字排版。
这条对角线主体必须保持连续、完整、舒展、不断裂。

所有大标题、拼音 / 英文大字、知识点模块、装饰文案、说明性文字，都必须服从这条对角线主体的完整性。
不得从中间横向切断主体，不得把主体拦腰打断，不得在主体最关键的连续区形成明显遮挡或割裂。
必须为对角线主体预留一条完整、清晰、连续的视觉通道。

文字系统应主要分布在主体两侧的留白区、四角留白区、边缘排版区，或沿主体边缘顺势排布，而不是粗暴压在主体中段中心。
若主体内部确实需要少量文字，只能是极少量、低干扰、嵌入式的小标注，例如局部名称、地标注释、小型标签等，并且必须顺应主体内部结构自然嵌入，不可形成大面积横截式排版。

五、拼音 / 英文大字的材质与配色
海报中必须加入一个“拼音 / 英文大字标题”，作为核心视觉文字之一。
如果用户输入的是中文城市、中文主题或中文对象，则自动提炼其拼音作为大字标题；
如果输入内容更适合英文表达，也可自动生成对应英文大字标题。

这个大字标题必须具有明显的烫印质感、金属材质感、箔印感或压印感，呈现高级、细腻、克制、具有印刷工艺美感的材质效果。
它可以带有轻微反光、压痕感、浮雕感、箔面质感、纸面烫印质感，但不能俗气，不能廉价，不能过度炫光，不能显得商业化过强。

这个材质大字的颜色方案不能被锁死为单一纯金色。
它必须根据用户输入的【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】自动判断，灵活选择更适合的材质色彩方案，以避免画面在这部分显得死板、僵硬、单调。

可采用以下两种灵活方案之一：

方案一：统一单色
选择一种最能代表该城市 / 主题气质的材质色。
这个颜色可以是金、古金、铜金、香槟金、玫瑰金、银、铂金、墨金等金属色；
也可以是带有金属材质感的其他颜色，例如金属蓝、金属绿、金属紫、金属红、灰银蓝、青铜绿、暖棕金、墨黑金属感等。
重点不是“必须金色”，而是“具有高级材质语言”。

方案二：综合色综合搭配
使用 2-3 种彼此协调的颜色进行综合色搭配。
这些颜色可来自该城市 / 主题的主色调、印象色、建筑色、自然色、文化色或情绪色，并通过彩色箔印、异色箔印、局部异色、综合色金属层次等方式呈现。
这种综合色方案必须高级、克制、有设计感，不要做成廉价渐变，不要花哨，不要破坏整体气质。

无论采用单色还是综合色方案，都必须让拼音 / 英文大字在材质上有“烫印感”，在颜色上有“主题感”，在视觉上有“灵活性”，并与对角线主体及整体版面形成统一关系。

这个拼音 / 英文大字不能孤立存在，也不能横插进对角线主体中央把主体切断。
它应作为整张海报的版式支点，布置在留白区、主体外缘、边缘排版区，或顺应整体版面气流展开，与主体形成呼应关系和排版张力。
如果同时出现中文标题与拼音 / 英文大字，则要形成清晰而高级的层级关系：
拼音 / 英文大字可作为主要视觉标题；
中文标题可作为呼应性标题、副标题或辅助排版元素；
两者需经过精心编排，绝不能简单上下堆叠。

六、四周信息与知识点
四周内容不能空泛，必须围绕主题自动补充“有亮点、有知识点、有阅读价值”的信息。
这些内容由模型根据用户最后输入自动决定，不需要用户额外提供。

如果是城市方向：
自动补充该城市相关的别称、历史定位、文化标签、地理特征、代表性建筑、名胜注释、人文亮点、城市精神、典型符号、简明知识点等。

如果是对象方向：
自动补充其功能、材料、结构、来源、用途、文化背景、代表性特征、技术点等。

如果是抽象主题或灵感方向：
自动补充其概念提炼、风格关键词、象征含义、背景知识、延展性亮点、联想线索等。

这些知识点不要机械罗列成说明书，不要一股脑堆满边角。
必须以设计性的方式拆分、分组、穿插、整合、排布，成为画面的一部分。
它们应围绕对角线主体自然分布在四周留白区中，形成既有信息性、又有装饰性的版式结构。
四周信息应采用“避让式排版”，围绕主体边缘自然展开，形成环绕、陪衬、补充关系，而不是侵入主体中心通道。
信息块之间要有疏密变化和呼吸感，做到丰富但不挤。

七、署名
在画面右下角保留一个极小号署名字样：
“NAICHA DESIGN”
署名字体要克制、干净、低调，不喧宾夺主。

八、整体气质目标
整张海报应呈现以下综合观感：
主体舒展、版面开阔、对角线主结构完整铺开；
留白高级且有呼吸感；
信息丰富但不杂乱；
远看有鲜明主视觉与强烈记忆点；
近看有丰富的知识点与排版细节；
兼具绘画性、设计性、信息性、阅读性与收藏感；
像一张高端展览海报、城市视觉海报、设计年鉴封面或艺术书籍内页级别的作品。

九、避免的问题
不要把中间图示区域缩成一坨；
不要让主体面积过小；
不要让对角线主图示被大字或信息模块拦腰切断；
不要让主体中段被标题横插打断；
不要让拼音 / 英文大字像路障一样压断主体；
不要让版面显得狭隘、逼仄、拘谨；
不要模板化旅游宣传页感；
不要低级拼贴感；
不要普通地图截图感；
不要说明书式排版；
不要廉价插画感；
不要满版塞满元素；
不要让文字沦为附属说明；
不要让材质大字显得俗气、死板、单调或商业化过强。

十、最终目标
要让“沿对角线大幅展开的综合色带主体 + 极简俯视元素 / 图示系统 + 具有烫印 / 金属材质感且颜色灵活的拼音 / 英文大字 + 四周知识信息 + 高级衬线排版 + 大面积留白”共同形成一张完整而高级的作品。

最终让整张图：
远看有强烈主视觉冲击，
近看有丰富阅读内容与设计细节，
主体不断，文字不截流，版面大气，排版高级，
整体具有收藏价值、作者性与大师级审美完成度。

用户最终输入：
【城市 / 主题 / 对象 / 灵感】：_____
尺寸要求：_____ （比如3:4）

items.title: 游戏角色设定档案总览

prompts.text:
Please create a high-completion, high-consistency "Character Archive Board" suitable for serialized release based on the [Theme / Worldview / Character Setting].

This is not an ordinary character illustration or a single character poster, but an official character setting overview combining "main character display + skill action display + expression setting + three-view drawing description + weapon and equipment display + color palette description + brand title system". The overall image should look like a standard display page in a game art book, character data page, project proposal board, or IP visual development document, possessing both character charm and a clear sense of information organization and setting description.

【Basic Settings】
- Theme / Worldview: 【Theme】
- Project Name / Brand Name: 【Brand Name】
- Character Name: 【Character Name】
- Identity / Profession / Faction: 【Character Identity】
- Core Temperament: 【Character Temperament, e.g., cold, elegant, heroic, wild, mysterious, fierce】
- Combat Position: 【Combat Position, e.g., warrior, knight, mage, assassin, gunman, guardian】
- Weapon Type: 【Weapon Type】
- Elemental Attribute / Ability Direction: 【Ability Direction】
- Main Color: 【Main Color】
- Auxiliary Color: 【Auxiliary Color】
- Accent Color: 【Accent Color】
- Style Direction: 【Style Direction, e.g., anime game original art, light impasto character setting, fantasy epic, future sci-fi, oriental fantasy】
- Aspect Ratio: 【Aspect Ratio, recommended 3:2 landscape】

【Auto-Completion Rules】
If the user has not filled in the complete basic character settings, or if some fields are empty, please do not stop generating, but instead automatically deduce and complete a set of complete, reasonable, and unified character settings based on the 【Theme】【Worldview】【Character Identity】【Combat Position】【Weapon Type】【Ability Direction】【Main Color】【Style Direction】.

During auto-completion, you should prioritize generating the following content and ensure logical consistency among them:
- Character gender tendency
- Age sense (youth / young adult / adult / mature)
- Body type characteristics (slender, muscular, light, burly)
- Facial temperament (calm, sharp, gentle, wild, noble, mysterious)
- Hairstyle and hair color
- Clothing structure (robe, armor, cloak, light outfit, uniform, formal dress, techwear)
- Armor and accessory ratio
- Weapon appearance style
- Skill effect form
- Expression tendency
- Clothing and equipment details in the three-view drawing

Auto-completion is not a random patchwork, but forming a unified scheme around the same character positioning. The final character must have clear recognizability and highly match the worldview, profession, color scheme, and combat style.

【Auto-Combination Suggestion Logic】
When the user has not explicitly filled in character details, please prioritize combining the basic character settings according to the following logic:
1. Determine the general direction of the character based on the 【Worldview】, such as fantasy, sci-fi, oriental fantasy, steampunk, future city, mythological epic;
2. Determine the character's body type, clothing structure, armor degree, and weapon temperament based on the 【Character Identity / Combat Position】;
3. Determine the skill action form, effect trajectory, combat posture, and equipment details based on the 【Weapon Type / Ability Direction】;
4. Determine the clothing color scheme, weapon material, energy color, and overall visual recognition based on the 【Main Color / Auxiliary Color / Accent Color】;
5. Unify the character's facial shaping, clothing language, light and shadow processing, and module expression based on the 【Style Direction】.

If the user only provides a small number of keywords, a complete character setting should also be automatically generated. For example:
- Only given "Flame Female Knight" -> Automatically complete the age sense, cloak, red-gold-black color scheme, spear or greatsword, flame skill effects, heroic expression;
- Only given "Ice Prince" -> Automatically complete the blue-silver-white color scheme, light armor or ceremonial armor, longsword or scepter, ice crystal skills, calm demeanor.

【Image Structure Requirements】
The entire image uses a landscape character setting description board layout, organizing the image with a "left main, right auxiliary" structure:

1. Left main visual area:
- Place a high-completion large-size main character standing illustration as the visual core of the entire image
- The character's posture is complete, with strong recognizability and character charm
- Details of clothing, armor, cloak, patterns, accessories, weapons are clear
- The character should reflect clear professional attributes and worldview affiliation
- Can include a small amount of faded character virtual shadows or background auxiliary outlines to enhance layering, but must not overshadow the main subject

2. Top-left title and introduction area:
- Display a large English title or series title, such as the series name / brand name the character belongs to
- Paired with the character's Chinese name, subtitle, faction, profession, or identity tags
- Add a brief character background introduction text to create a data page feel
- Title typography is concise and powerful, with a brand visual system feel

3. Top-right skill display area:
- Display a set of small character skill action images, numbering about 4~6
- Including action moments such as dash, slash, casting, burst, ultimate skill, area attack
- Each action should retain character recognition features and skill effect styles
- The skill module should look like an action breakdown display or combat illustration

4. Middle-right expression display area:
- Display about 4 character head expressions
- Such as calm, angry, surprised, contemplative, sneering, eyes closed
- The expression images should be unified in style with the main standing illustration, used to supplement the layers of the character's personality

5. Bottom three-view drawing area:
- Display the character's front, side, and back three-view drawings
- Used to clearly explain the clothing structure, cloak outline, armor design, back of the hairstyle, shoe and boot design
- The three-view drawings should be relatively neat, clear, and unified, like a formal setting draft

6. Right-side weapon and additional settings area:
- Display the character's main weapon separately, adding partial breakdowns or multiple angles when necessary
- Paired with a brief weapon name and descriptive text
- Can include small supplementary elements such as faction emblems, element icons, character crests

7. Color palette area:
- Use 3~5 color blocks to display the character's main color scheme system
- The color palette should be consistent with the character's clothing, weapon, and effect colors
- Strengthen the character's visual recognizability

【Visual Style Requirements】
- The overall background is mainly light gray-white, fog white, and cool white, clean and restrained, with ample white space
- The page has the temperament of an official art book, game data page, and character specification board
- The image has both a exquisite illustration feel and a rational typography and manual feel
- Module boundaries are clear, layout alignment is explicit, and information zoning is reasonable
- The main subject is finely drawn, and the styles of expressions, actions, weapons, and three-view drawings are unified
- Light and shadow are clean, do not be overly realistic or overly heavy
- Maintain a light UI feel, modern feel, brand feel, and proposal feel
- Do not make it into a messy collage, nor an overly flashy poster

【Output Target】
Generate a character setting archive board suitable for serialized reuse, allowing viewers to see at a glance the character's image, professional positioning, skill style, equipment characteristics, and worldview affiliation. The overall work must simultaneously possess "strong visual appeal" and "high information organization".

【Execution Principles】
- If the user fills in completely, prioritize faithful execution of the user's settings;
- If the user only fills in partial content, complete the missing fields;
- If the user fills in very little, automatically combine a complete set of basic character settings;
- Whether manually set or automatically completed, the final character must have a unified, complete, and serially expandable visual logic.
